2. Complete (check-out) the session.
3. Confirm session status transition.
testCases.expectedResult: checkInTrainingSessionRecord then completeTrainingSessionRecord succeed from the map surface; session status advances accordingly; visit state reflected on the map.

testCases.title: Route plan stop model renders without provider-backed optimization
testCases.preconditions: Logged in on the map workspace with route plan stops in contracts data. Map tile / routing provider decision NOT yet made (parked dependency).
testCases.steps:
1. Open the route plan on the map workspace.
2. Confirm provider-neutral stop ordering renders.
3. Attempt provider-backed optimized route generation.
testCases.expectedResult: Stop model (TerritoryRoutePlanStopSummary) renders in a provider-neutral order; provider-backed optimization is unavailable — parked pending map/routing provider decision (OQ-TR-008/OQ-TR-007). Build provider-neutral path only.

testCases.title: GPS check-in geofence enforcement is parked
testCases.preconditions: Logged in as a TM on mobile/map. Geocoding provider + tolerance policy NOT decided (parked).
testCases.steps:
1. Perform a training check-in away from the account's mapped location.
2. Observe whether geofence tolerance blocks the check-in.
testCases.testData: Check-in coordinates far from account location.
testCases.expectedResult: Check-in is NOT blocked by geofence tolerance — strict GPS check-in / geofencing is out-of-scope for Phase 1 and parked pending geocoding provider + tolerance policy decision.

testCases.title: Acumatica purchase/order overlay on the map is parked
testCases.preconditions: Logged in on the territory map. Acumatica read-model integration NOT certified (parked).
testCases.steps: 1. Open the map and look for an Acumatica-backed sales/order overlay layer.
testCases.expectedResult: No live Acumatica sales/order overlay is present — explicitly out-of-scope Phase 1 and parked pending Acumatica read-model integration certification.

testCases.title: Unauthenticated request to any territory endpoint is rejected
testCases.preconditions: No valid session/token.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/territories/dashboard with no auth header.
2. POST /api/v1/territories/regions with no auth header.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 401 Unauthorized (requireAuthenticatedActor throws authentication error -> unauthorizedResponse); no data returned, no mutation.

testCases.title: Special characters and SQL/script payloads in territory name are stored safely
testCases.preconditions: Logged in as SUPER_ADMIN.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/territories with name containing an injection/script payload and unicode.
2. Read the territory back.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 201; name stored verbatim as data via parameterized Prisma client (no SQL executed, no table dropped); unicode preserved; code normalized to 'tricky'; output is not interpreted as script when rendered.

testCases.title: Code field normalization collapses non-alphanumerics and rejects empty result
testCases.preconditions: Logged in as SUPER_ADMIN.
testCases.steps:
1. POST region with code='  North--East  @@'.
2. POST region with code='@@@' (no alphanumerics).
testCases.testData: Case A code='  North--East  @@'; Case B code='@@@'
testCases.expectedResult: Case A: 201 with code normalized to 'north_east'. Case B: HTTP 400 'code is required' (normalizeCode produces empty string after stripping).

testCases.title: Concurrent coverage claims for the same state do not both succeed
testCases.preconditions: Logged in as SUPER_ADMIN. Two territories T1 and T2, neither covering FL.
testCases.steps:
1. Issue two near-simultaneous PUT coverage requests, both adding FL, one to T1 and one to T2.
2. Inspect both responses.
3. Read FL coverage owner.
testCases.expectedResult: Exactly one request succeeds (200); the other fails — either at validateCoverageConflicts (400 'Coverage already exists for US:FL') or via the unique countryCode_stateCode DB constraint inside the transaction. FL ends owned by exactly one territory; no double-assignment.

testCases.title: Calendar workspace loads real backend-wired events for a valid date range
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user with calendar module access; at least one lead with discoveryScheduledAt, one training session, and one consignment audit exist within the range.
testCases.steps:
1. Send GET /api/v1/calendar/workspace?startDate=2026-07-01T00:00:00Z&endDate=2026-07-31T23:59:59Z with a valid bearer token.
2. Inspect the 200 response body.
3. Open /calendar in the web app for the same range.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 200; response contains rangeStart, rangeEnd, summary, outlookConnection, and a non-empty items array of real events (no mock data). The /calendar workspace renders those events.

testCases.title: Empty state shown when no events exist in the selected range
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user; a date range chosen in which the user has zero visible events.
testCases.steps:
1. Request the workspace for a future range with no scheduled events (e.g. far-future month).
2. Inspect the items array.
3. Observe the calendar UI for that range.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 200 with items=[] and all summary counts 0. UI shows an empty-state message rather than a broken/blank grid. Note: UX-C-001 flags the explicit empty-state copy as still Open.

testCases.title: Workspace endpoint rejects unauthenticated request
testCases.preconditions: No valid session/bearer token.
testCases.steps:
1. Send GET /api/v1/calendar/workspace?startDate=...&endDate=... with no Authorization header.
2. Inspect the response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 401 Unauthorized; no event data returned.

testCases.title: Workspace endpoint rejects non-GET methods
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user.
testCases.steps:
1. Send POST (and PUT) to /api/v1/calendar/workspace with a valid range.
2. Inspect status and Allow header.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed with Allow: GET.

testCases.title: Missing startDate or endDate returns 400
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user.
testCases.steps:
1. Send GET /api/v1/calendar/workspace with only startDate (no endDate).
2. Repeat with only endDate.
3. Repeat with neither.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 with message 'startDate and endDate are required' in each case.

testCases.title: Invalid / non-ISO date string returns a clear 400
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user.
testCases.steps:
1. Send GET workspace with startDate=not-a-date&endDate=2026-07-31T00:00:00Z.
2. Inspect the error message.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 with message 'startDate must be a valid ISO date'.

testCases.title: endDate before startDate is rejected
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user.
testCases.steps:
1. Send GET workspace with endDate earlier than startDate.
2. Inspect the error.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 with message 'endDate must be on or after startDate'.

testCases.title: Range exactly 180 days is accepted; 181 days rejected (boundary)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user.
testCases.steps:
1. Send workspace request with a range spanning exactly 180 days.
2. Send a request spanning 181 days.
3. Compare results.
testCases.expectedResult: 180-day request returns HTTP 200. 181-day request returns HTTP 400 with message 'Calendar range cannot exceed 180 days'.

testCases.title: All four views (day, week, month, list) render the same real event data
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user with events in the loaded range.
testCases.steps:
1. Open /calendar; switch through Day, Week, Month, List in the view selector.
2. Verify each view renders events for its own time range/navigation.
3. Confirm week is presented as the recommended default for field users.
testCases.testData: Range containing >=5 events across multiple days
testCases.expectedResult: Each view renders real events correctly with no mock data; navigation (prev/next) updates the displayed range per view; week view is available and emphasized.

testCases.title: Day view grid spans 08:00-22:00; events outside window excluded from grid but in list
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user; an event scheduled at 07:00 and another at 22:30 the same day, plus one at 10:00.
testCases.steps:
1. Open Day view for that day.
2. Confirm the grid rows run 08:00 through 22:00.
3. Locate the 07:00 and 22:30 events.
4. Switch to List view.
testCases.expectedResult: The 10:00 event appears in the grid at the correct top offset/height; 07:00 and 22:30 events are excluded from the visual grid but still appear in List view (ASM-CAL-008).

testCases.title: Overlapping events are placed in adjacent lanes without text overlap
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user; three events overlapping in time on the same day.

3. Inspect lane placement.
testCases.expectedResult: Overlapping events render in separate adjacent lanes (auto-calculated lane count) with no overlapping text; each positioned at correct top offset and height.

testCases.title: Week view shows 7-day grid, highlights Today, and open-slot click pre-fills scheduler
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user with training.schedule or lead.intake_manage permission; current week loaded.
testCases.steps:

testCases.expectedResult: All 7 days visible with same 08:00-22:00 grid and overlap-lane logic; Today highlighted; clicking the open slot opens the scheduler modal pre-filled with that day and 14:00.

testCases.title: Month view caps 3 events per cell with '+N more' and supports keyboard activation
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user; a single day with 5+ events; mixed in/out-of-month days visible.
testCases.steps:

2. Inspect that day cell.
3. Tab to a day cell and press Enter, then press Space on another cell.

testCases.testData: Day with 5 events; adjacent-month spillover days
testCases.expectedResult: Cell shows 3 events plus '+2 more'; out-of-month cells rendered with reduced opacity (isCurrentMonth distinction); cells are tabIndex=0 and Enter/Space open the scheduler equivalently to a click.

testCases.title: List view shows sortable table with When, Type, Title, Owner, Linked record, Status
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user with events in range.

2. Verify all six columns present.

testCases.expectedResult: Table renders one row per filtered event with the six columns and type badge; empty state shown when no events match the active filters.

testCases.title: Five event families render with distinct color/icon/label and are merged chronologically

testCases.title: Event-family filter hides non-matching events without reload and updates attention counts

testCases.title: Attention panel shows today's count, 14-day upcoming, and unsynced (only when connected)

testCases.title: Discovery events sourced from Leads; closed leads excluded; status scheduled vs completed
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user; lead A with discoveryScheduledAt in range (open), lead B with discoveryCompletedAt in range (open), lead C CLOSED with discovery in range.
testCases.steps:

2. Identify the discovery_call events.
3. Verify lead A shows status 'scheduled', lead B shows 'completed'.
4. Confirm lead C is absent.
testCases.testData: Lead A scheduled, Lead B completed, Lead C lifecycleStatus=CLOSED
testCases.expectedResult: Discovery events appear for leads A and B with correct status; the CLOSED lead C is excluded (lifecycleStatus not CLOSED filter).

testCases.title: Training delivery mode classifies event type; endsAt derived from durationMinutes
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user; training sessions with activityKind=SITE_VISIT, deliveryMode=VIRTUAL/PHONE/HYBRID, and a classroom-type session.
testCases.steps:
1. Load workspace with the three training sessions.
2. Verify SITE_VISIT maps to on_site_visit, VIRTUAL/PHONE/HYBRID maps to virtual_training, others to account_training.
3. Verify endsAt = scheduledAt + max(durationMinutes,30) and trainer/account names show.
testCases.testData: SITE_VISIT 60m; VIRTUAL 45m; classroom 90m; one session durationMinutes=10
testCases.expectedResult: Event types classify per the delivery-mode rule; endsAt computed from durationMinutes with a 30-minute floor (10m session yields 30m duration); trainer and account names visible.

testCases.title: Consignment audit events sourced from sites/audits; EXITED sites excluded; correct link
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user with consignment access; an ACTIVE site with nextAuditDueAt in range, a site with a durable audit (scheduledFor) in range, and an EXITED site with an audit in range.
testCases.steps:
1. Load workspace covering the range.
2. Identify consignment_audit events.
3. Verify the ACTIVE site/audit events appear linking to /consignment/{siteId} with TM and account name.
4. Confirm the EXITED site is excluded.
testCases.testData: Active site nextAuditDueAt; durable audit scheduledFor; EXITED site
testCases.expectedResult: Audit events appear for non-exited sites with sourcePath /consignment/{siteId} and TM+account name visible; EXITED-site events are excluded.

testCases.title: Lead-backed consignment audit hint appears 90 days after anchor for eligible leads only
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user with consignment access; lead with consignmentInterestStatus=APPROVED, consignmentEntryTiming=AT_ONBOARDING, firstOrderAt set, not yet converted to a durable consignment site.
testCases.steps:
1. Seed the eligible lead with firstOrderAt such that anchor+90d falls in the queried range.
2. Load workspace.
3. Inspect the hint event note.
4. Repeat with a lead whose convertedAccount already has a consignment site and confirm no hint.
testCases.testData: firstOrderAt = range start minus 90d; APPROVED / AT_ONBOARDING
testCases.expectedResult: A consignment_audit hint event appears 90 days after firstOrderAt (or onboardingCompletedAt) with a note that it requires durable site creation; leads already converted to a consignment site produce no hint.

testCases.title: TM sees only their own book of leads, training, and consignment sites
testCases.preconditions: Two TMs (TM-1, TM-2) each owning distinct leads, training sessions (by trainer/account), and consignment sites in the same range.
testCases.steps:
1. As TM-1, load the workspace for the range.
2. Inspect the returned items.
3. Confirm none of TM-2's records appear.
testCases.testData: TM-1 token; TM-2 owns lead/training/site in range
testCases.expectedResult: TM-1 sees only their assigned leads, training sessions, and owned consignment sites; TM-2's records are absent (server-side scope via resolveLeadRecordScope / buildTrainingSessionRecordScope / buildConsignmentSiteRecordScope).

testCases.title: Regional Director sees own + region-owned records but not other regions
testCases.preconditions: RD owning Region A; consignment sites under Region A and Region B exist in range.
testCases.steps:
1. As the Region A RD, load the workspace.
2. Inspect consignment audit events.
3. Confirm Region B sites are absent.
testCases.expectedResult: RD sees sites where ownerRdUserId = self OR region.directorUserId = self; Region B sites are excluded.

testCases.title: Query manipulation cannot widen record scope beyond actor's book
testCases.preconditions: TM-1 authenticated; TM-2 owns records in range.
testCases.steps:
1. As TM-1, send a workspace request with the maximum 180-day range plus any extra query params attempting to spoof owner/territory.
2. Inspect the returned items for any of TM-2's records.
testCases.expectedResult: Scope is enforced server-side regardless of query params; no records outside TM-1's book are returned. The second-pass filterCalendarEventsForActor further blocks any leak.

testCases.title: Consignment audit events suppressed for actors lacking consignment.audit permission
testCases.preconditions: User with leads/training access but WITHOUT consignment module access or consignment.audit action; consignment audits exist in range.
testCases.steps:
1. As that user, load the workspace.
2. Inspect items for any consignment_audit events (both durable and lead-backed hint).
testCases.expectedResult: No consignment_audit events are returned (listConsignmentCalendarEvents returns [] and canActorViewCalendarEvent denies consignment-typed events, including lead-backed hints).

testCases.title: Schedule discovery call from calendar saves to lead, not standalone entry
testCases.preconditions: User with lead.intake_manage permission; a lead available to assign discovery.
testCases.steps:
1. Click an open slot to open the scheduler in discovery mode (date/time pre-filled).
2. Select a lead and confirm.
3. Save.
4. Reload the calendar and inspect the new event and the lead record.
testCases.expectedResult: Lead.discoveryScheduledAt is set to the chosen date/time; the calendar reloads and shows the new discovery_call event; no standalone calendar entity is created.

testCases.title: Schedule training session from calendar creates a TrainingSession linked to account
testCases.preconditions: User with training.schedule permission; an account, training type, and trainer available.
testCases.steps:
1. Open scheduler in training mode.
2. Choose account, training type, trainer, duration, date/time.
3. Save.
4. Reload calendar.
testCases.testData: Account=Beta Corp, type=Onboarding, trainer=Sam, duration=60, date=Thu 13:00
testCases.expectedResult: A TrainingSession record is created linked to the account with the chosen trainer/type/duration; the calendar reloads and shows the new training event.

testCases.title: User without scheduling permission cannot schedule discovery or training (default-deny)
testCases.preconditions: User WITHOUT lead.intake_manage and WITHOUT training.schedule (e.g. read-only/viewer role).
testCases.steps:
1. As that user, open /calendar.
2. Attempt to open the scheduler modal from an open slot.
3. Attempt the underlying schedule API call directly (scheduleLeadDiscovery / createTrainingSessionRecord).
testCases.expectedResult: canScheduleDiscovery and canScheduleTraining gates hide/disable the scheduler actions; direct API calls are rejected with 403 Forbidden. Default-deny holds.

testCases.title: Open-slot click in day/week grid pre-fills scheduler with slot date and hour
testCases.preconditions: User with a scheduling permission; Day or Week view open.
testCases.steps:
1. In Day view, click the open slot at 15:00.
2. Verify the scheduler opens with date and 15:00 pre-filled.
3. Repeat in Week view for a specific day column.
testCases.expectedResult: openSchedulerForDate is invoked with the slot's date/hour; the modal's date/time fields are pre-filled accordingly (data-testid calendar-open-slot).

testCases.title: Scheduler modal source-of-truth info banner (not yet built)
testCases.preconditions: User with scheduling permission opens the scheduler modal.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the scheduler modal.
2. Look for an informational banner explaining that scheduling creates a record in the source workflow (not a standalone calendar event).
testCases.expectedResult: Expected: a banner explains the Pulse source-of-truth model. Current build: banner is absent (UX-C-002 Open) — test should fail until implemented.

testCases.title: Recurring schedule toggle creates single occurrence with recurrence intent in note (parked expansion)
testCases.preconditions: User with scheduling permission; recurrence toggle present in scheduler modal.
testCases.steps:
1. Open scheduler; enable the recurrence toggle and pick a pattern.
2. Save.
3. Inspect the created record and the calendar.
testCases.expectedResult: A single occurrence is created with the recurrence intent captured in the note; true multi-occurrence expansion is parked pending BR-C-03 (UX-C-007 'Done (parked)').

testCases.title: Connect Outlook via OAuth with PKCE state, single-use, 10-minute expiry
testCases.preconditions: Microsoft Graph credentials provisioned (MICROSOFT_ENTRA_* and APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY set) so isConfigured=true; eligible/pilot user. PARKED in current env until credentials provisioned.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/calendar/outlook/connect; capture the authorization URL and state.
2. Verify state is a 32-byte base64url value and stateHash stored with a 10-minute expiry.
3. Complete the callback within the window; verify CalendarConnection upserted, tokens encrypted, audit entry created, redirect to /calendar with a status param.
4. Replay the same callback state again.
testCases.expectedResult: Connection succeeds; tokens stored encrypted; audit (SYNC) entry created; redirect to /calendar?status=connected. Replaying the consumed/expired state is rejected ('state was not recognized'/'expired') — single-use enforced.

testCases.title: OAuth callback rejects missing/invalid/expired state and provider error
testCases.preconditions: Graph credentials provisioned (PARKED until env set).
testCases.steps:
1. Call the callback with no code/state.
2. Call with an unknown state hash.
3. Call with a state whose record is expired or usedAt is set.
4. Call with error=access_denied.
testCases.expectedResult: Each case redirects back to /calendar with an error status and an appropriate message (missing code/state, state not recognized, state expired, or the provider error description); no connection is created.

testCases.title: Outlook access/refresh tokens stored encrypted and never exposed in responses or logs
testCases.preconditions: Graph credentials provisioned; a connected user (PARKED until env set).
testCases.steps:
1. Complete a connection.
2. Inspect the CalendarConnection row for accessTokenEncrypted / refreshTokenEncrypted.
3. Inspect GET /outlook/connection and workspace responses.
4. Inspect application logs around the sync/refresh operations.
testCases.expectedResult: Tokens are stored encrypted at rest using APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY; no plaintext access/refresh token appears in any API response or log line.

testCases.title: Auto-sync reflects newly scheduled discovery/training when policy auto-sync enabled
testCases.preconditions: Graph credentials provisioned; connected eligible user; policy autoSyncDiscoveryEnabled/autoSyncTrainingEnabled = true (PARKED until env set).
testCases.steps:
1. Schedule a discovery call from the calendar.
2. Confirm tryAutoSyncCalendarEventToOutlook fires and an Outlook event is created via Microsoft Graph.
3. Repeat for a training session with autoSyncTrainingEnabled on.
4. Disable autoSyncDiscoveryEnabled and schedule another discovery.
testCases.testData: Discovery + training schedules; toggle discovery auto-sync off
testCases.expectedResult: With auto-sync on per family, the event is created in Outlook automatically. With discovery auto-sync off, the new discovery is NOT auto-reflected (shouldAutoSyncOutlookEvent routes by source module).

testCases.title: Manual 'Sync to Outlook' from detail rail creates/updates binding and shows timestamp
testCases.preconditions: Graph credentials provisioned; connected eligible user; a leads or training event selected (PARKED until env set).
testCases.steps:
1. Select a discovery or training event; click 'Sync to Outlook'.
2. Verify success message and last-synced timestamp.
3. Re-select the synced event; confirm the button reads 'Update in Outlook' and patches the existing binding.
testCases.expectedResult: POST /api/v1/calendar/outlook/events/sync creates the Outlook event and CalendarEventBinding, shows success and last-synced time; a second sync patches the existing event rather than duplicating it.

testCases.title: Sync request for non-leads/training source module is rejected
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user; consignment audit event present.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/calendar/outlook/events/sync with sourceModule='consignment'.
2. POST with a missing/blank sourceRecordId or missing eventType.
3. Confirm the UI hides the Sync button for consignment events.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 'sourceModule, sourceRecordId, and eventType are required' for consignment or malformed bodies; the Sync button is not shown for consignment events. API enforces the leads/training-only restriction.

testCases.title: Manual sync of a lead/training record the actor cannot see is rejected (IDOR)
testCases.preconditions: Graph credentials provisioned; TM-1 connected; lead/training record owned by TM-2 (PARKED until env set).
testCases.steps:
1. As TM-1, POST /outlook/events/sync with sourceRecordId of TM-2's lead and eventType=discovery_call.
2. Repeat with TM-2's training session id.
testCases.expectedResult: resolveCalendarEventForSync applies the record-scope guard; the lookup misses and the request fails with 'Lead calendar event not found' / 'Training calendar event not found'. No foreign record is reflected into TM-1's Outlook.

testCases.title: Sync rejects mismatched or unsupported event type for the source record
testCases.preconditions: Graph credentials provisioned; connected user; a lead with a discovery event and a training session (PARKED until env set).
testCases.steps:
1. POST sync for sourceModule='leads' with eventType other than 'discovery_call'.
2. POST sync for a training record with an eventType that does not match its classified type.
testCases.expectedResult: Lead sync errors with 'Only discovery_call events are supported for lead calendar sync'; training sync errors with 'Requested event type does not match the current training session event type'.

testCases.title: Rescheduling patches and cancelling removes the Outlook reflection
testCases.preconditions: Graph credentials provisioned; connected user with a synced discovery/training event (PARKED until env set).
testCases.steps:
1. Reschedule the source event to a new date/time.
2. Verify the Outlook event is patched (PATCH) with new times.
3. Cancel the source event.
4. Verify tryAutoUnsyncCalendarEventFromOutlook removes the Outlook event.
testCases.testData: Move discovery to next day; then cancel
testCases.expectedResult: On reschedule the existing Outlook event is updated in place; on cancel the Outlook reflection is removed; both produce audit entries.

testCases.title: Teams online meeting created only for discovery/virtual training; join URL surfaced
testCases.preconditions: Graph credentials provisioned; connected user with meetingProvider=teams (PARKED until env set).
testCases.steps:
1. Sync a discovery_call event; inspect the Graph payload and stored binding.
2. Sync a virtual_training event.
3. Sync an account_training and an on_site_visit event.
4. Open the detail rail for the synced online meetings.
testCases.expectedResult: discovery_call and virtual_training are created with isOnlineMeeting=true and onlineMeetingProvider='teamsForBusiness', join URL stored in CalendarEventBinding and shown via 'Open meeting link'. account_training/on_site_visit are NOT created as online meetings. Default durations 30/120/60 apply when no endsAt.

testCases.title: Changing target calendar or meeting provider deletes and recreates the Outlook event
testCases.preconditions: Graph credentials provisioned; connected user with an event synced to calendar X using provider none (PARKED until env set).
testCases.steps:
1. Update the connection's targetCalendarId to calendar Y (or change meetingProvider to teams).
2. Re-sync the same event.
3. Inspect Outlook for the old event and new event.
testCases.testData: targetCalendarId X -> Y; provider none -> teams
testCases.expectedResult: shouldRecreate detects the target/provider change; the old Outlook event is deleted and a new one created in the new calendar/provider; binding updated to the new external event id.

testCases.title: Disconnect removes all event bindings and the connection
testCases.preconditions: Graph credentials provisioned; connected user with multiple synced bindings (PARKED until env set).
testCases.steps:
1. DELETE /api/v1/calendar/outlook/connection.
2. Reload the workspace.
3. Query CalendarEventBinding and CalendarConnection for the user.
testCases.expectedResult: All CalendarEventBinding rows for the connection are deleted then the CalendarConnection is deleted; workspace shows isConnected=false; an audit (LOGOUT) entry is created.

testCases.title: Transient sync failure is audit-logged and stored on binding without interrupting the user
testCases.preconditions: Graph credentials provisioned; connected user; Microsoft Graph returns a transient error on create/patch (PARKED until env set).
testCases.steps:
1. Trigger an auto-sync while Graph is failing.
2. Inspect the binding lastSyncError and the audit log.
3. Confirm the TM's scheduling flow completes without an interrupting error.
testCases.expectedResult: The failure is captured in lastSyncError on the binding/connection and an AuditEntry is written; the user's workflow is not interrupted by an error dialog; the detail rail surfaces the last sync error when present.

testCases.title: Workspace returns full outlookConnection summary; graceful degradation when unconfigured
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user. Run once with Graph credentials missing (current parked state) and once configured.
testCases.steps:
1. With Graph env vars missing, load the workspace.
2. Inspect outlookConnection (isConfigured, isConnected, connectionEmail, targetCalendarName, meetingProvider, policy).
3. Confirm Pulse events still load and Outlook UI is hidden/informational.
testCases.expectedResult: Workspace returns a fully typed outlookConnection with isConfigured=false; calendar still loads Pulse events successfully; Outlook-specific UI is hidden or shows an informational availability message (NFR-CAL-007).

testCases.title: Admin global enable/disable of Outlook sync via feature flag
testCases.preconditions: Admin user with admin integration permissions; Graph credentials provisioned.
testCases.steps:
1. As admin, disable the calendar.outlook.sync policy (allowUserConnections=false).
2. As a normal user, attempt to connect Outlook and load the workspace.
3. Re-enable and retry.
testCases.expectedResult: When disabled, users see an availability message ('disabled by an administrator') and cannot connect (canActorUseOutlookCalendar=false); when enabled, connection is allowed. Feature flag state updated and audited.

testCases.title: Pilot email list restricts who can connect; non-listed users blocked
testCases.preconditions: Admin sets pilotUserEmails to a specific list; Graph credentials provisioned.
testCases.steps:
1. Admin sets pilotUserEmails=['pilot@aqs.com'].
2. As pilot@aqs.com, check eligibility and attempt connect.
3. As other@aqs.com, check eligibility and attempt connect.
4. Test case-insensitivity (PILOT@AQS.COM).
testCases.expectedResult: Pilot user is eligible and can connect; non-listed user gets availabilityMessage 'pilot mode for approved users only' and cannot connect; email matching is case-insensitive/trimmed (normalizeEmailList).

testCases.title: Admin shared-calendar, default meeting provider, and per-family auto-sync toggles apply
testCases.preconditions: Admin user; Graph credentials provisioned.
testCases.steps:
1. Toggle sharedCalendarsEnabled false->true and verify shared calendars are filtered out when false (filterCalendarsByPolicy) and shown when true.
2. Set defaultMeetingProvider to 'teams' and verify a new connection inherits it but can be overridden per connection.
3. Toggle autoSyncDiscoveryEnabled off / autoSyncTrainingEnabled on and verify routing per source module.
testCases.expectedResult: Shared calendars hidden by default and shown only when enabled; default meeting provider inherited with per-connection override; auto-sync honored independently per family. All updates audited.

testCases.title: Integration health status returns status, numeric health score, and detail per config state
testCases.preconditions: Admin user.
testCases.steps:
1. Call listOutlookIntegrationStatuses with credentials missing.
2. With credentials present but disabled by admin.
3. With credentials present, enabled, no pilot.
4. With credentials present, enabled, pilot list set.
testCases.expectedResult: Returns status 'error' (health 20) when unconfigured, 'warning' (55) when disabled, 'connected' 100 when enabled with no pilot, and 'connected' 85 with a pilot list — each with a descriptive detail message.

testCases.title: Outlook settings header link visible only with admin.integration_view
testCases.preconditions: One user with admin.integration_view, one without.
testCases.steps:
1. As the user with admin.integration_view, open /calendar and look for the 'Outlook settings' header button.
2. Confirm it links to /admin/integrations?provider=calendar.
3. As the user without the permission, confirm the button is absent.
testCases.expectedResult: Button rendered (canViewCalendarIntegrations) and links correctly for the permitted user; hidden for the user lacking the permission (default-deny).

testCases.title: Workspace API responds within 2s for 30-day range; front-end paints within 3s
testCases.preconditions: Standard environment with representative data volume; 30-day range with events across all three source modules.
testCases.steps:
1. Measure GET /api/v1/calendar/workspace response time for a 30-day range (warm).
2. Measure initial calendar paint for list/month view on standard broadband.
3. Confirm time-grid views render without layout shift after data loads.
testCases.expectedResult: API responds within 2s (three source queries run in parallel via Promise.all); initial paint completes within 3s; no layout shift after data load.

testCases.title: Events with unicode, special characters, and very long titles render safely
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user; a lead/account whose name contains unicode, quotes, and HTML-like characters and a 255-char title.
testCases.steps: 1. Seed a lead named 'Açme & Co — 株式会社' with a 255-char discovery summary. 2. Load the workspace and open the event detail rail. 3. Inspect card, detail rail, and list rendering.
testCases.testData: companyName='Açme & Co 株式会社'; 255-char note
testCases.expectedResult: Title and notes render exactly as text with no HTML injection/XSS and no layout break; long titles are truncated/wrapped gracefully; the JSON response preserves the unicode characters.

testCases.title: Events exactly on range boundaries are inclusive; events outside excluded
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated user; one event with startsAt exactly equal to rangeStart, one exactly equal to rangeEnd, and one one second past rangeEnd.
testCases.steps:
1. Seed the three boundary events.
2. Load the workspace for [rangeStart, rangeEnd].
3. Inspect which appear.
testCases.expectedResult: Events at rangeStart and rangeEnd are included (gte/lte inclusive); the event one second past rangeEnd is excluded.

testCases.title: Ops creates a consignment site from an existing account (happy path)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS (has consignment.manage). A consignment-eligible Account exists with assigned TM and RD.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/consignment/sites with { accountId, name, primaryContactName/Email/Phone }.
2. Inspect the 201 response body.
3. GET /api/v1/consignment/sites and confirm the new site appears.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 201. Site created with status=onboarding_in_progress, acumaticaStatus=parked, baselineEstablishedAt null, ownerTm/ownerRd inherited from the account when not supplied. An AuditEntry (CREATE / CONSIGNMENT_SITE) is written with acumaticaBoundary=parked metadata.

testCases.title: Create site fails when accountId is missing
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/consignment/sites with body omitting accountId.
2. Observe the response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 with message 'accountId is required'. No site row created, no audit entry.

testCases.title: Create site fails when accountId references a non-existent account
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS. No account exists with the supplied id.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/consignment/sites with a bogus accountId.
2. Observe the response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 with message 'Account not found'. No site created.

testCases.title: Create site rejects a locationId that does not belong to the account
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS. Account A and a location belonging to Account B both exist.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/consignment/sites with accountId of A and locationId of B's location.
2. Observe the response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 with message 'locationId must belong to the selected account'. No site created.

testCases.title: Sales rep is denied all consignment access (default-deny)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as SALES_BD_REP (no consignment.* actions in role matrix). Consignment sites exist.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/consignment/sites.
2. GET /api/v1/consignment/dashboard.
3. POST /api/v1/consignment/sites.
testCases.testData: Valid bodies; role lacks consignment module/action grants
testCases.expectedResult: All return HTTP 403 (forbidden). Sales rep cannot view, list, or create consignment records.

testCases.title: Dealer portal user is explicitly blocked from consignment (internal-only)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as DEALER_PORTAL_USER. Consignment data exists.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/consignment/sites.
2. GET /api/v1/consignment/dashboard.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 403 with message indicating 'Consignment is internal-only in the current phase'. Confirms FR-CSG-045 dealer exclusion is enforced server-side.

testCases.title: TM sees only their own assigned sites in the list
testCases.preconditions: Two TMs (TM-A, TM-B). Site S1 owned by TM-A, site S2 owned by TM-B. Authenticated as TM-A.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/consignment/sites as TM-A.
2. Inspect returned site ids.
testCases.expectedResult: Response contains S1 only; S2 is excluded. siteScopeWhere restricts TM to ownerTmUserId === self. (FR-CSG-045 TM book isolation.)

testCases.title: TM cannot read another TM's site by id (IDOR / direct-object reference)
testCases.preconditions: Site S2 owned by TM-B. Authenticated as TM-A.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/consignment/sites/{S2.id} as TM-A.
2. Observe response.
testCases.testData: S2.id (a valid id outside TM-A's scope)
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 404 (not 403) — scope filter (siteScopeWhere) means the record is not found for TM-A, so existence is not leaked. No site data returned.

testCases.title: RD sees regional rollup (own RD-owned sites plus sites in their directed region)
testCases.preconditions: RD-X is region director of Region R. Site S3 has ownerRdUserId=RD-X; site S4 belongs to Region R (region.directorUserId=RD-X) but ownerRd null; site S5 in a different region. Authenticated as RD-X.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/consignment/sites as RD-X.
2. Inspect returned ids.
testCases.testData: S3, S4 in scope; S5 out of scope
testCases.expectedResult: Response includes S3 and S4 and excludes S5. RD scope OR-matches ownerRdUserId or region.directorUserId.

testCases.title: List sites supports status, assignedTm, dueWithinDays and search filters
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS. Sites exist across statuses with varied nextAuditDueAt and names.
testCases.steps:

2. Inspect results.
testCases.expectedResult: Only ACTIVE sites whose name/warehouseCode/account name match 'Acme' (case-insensitive) AND nextAuditDueAt <= now+14d are returned, ordered by nextAuditDueAt asc.

testCases.title: Closed/exited sites are hidden unless includeExited/includeClosed is set
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS. At least one EXITED site and several active sites.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/consignment/sites (default).

testCases.expectedResult: Default response excludes EXITED sites; with includeExited=true the EXITED site is included. Confirms the default status!=EXITED filter.

testCases.title: List limit is clamped to the 1..200 range
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS. More than 200 sites in scope.

2. GET /api/v1/consignment/sites?limit=0.
3. GET /api/v1/consignment/sites?limit=abc.
testCases.expectedResult: limit=999 returns at most 200 rows (MAX_LIMIT); limit=0 and non-numeric fall back to the default (50). No error thrown.

testCases.title: Upload signed AGREEMENT document and mark it current
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS (consignment.document_manage). A site exists.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/consignment/sites/{siteId}/documents with formType=agreement, status=signed, documentUrl, signedAt.
2. GET the site documents.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 201. Form created with isCurrent=true; any prior current agreement for the site is flipped to isCurrent=false. AuditEntry (CREATE / CONSIGNMENT_FORM) written.

testCases.title: Completing a signed BLUE form establishes the baseline and schedules first ROSE +90d
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS. Site exists with a signed agreement, baselineEstablishedAt null.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /documents with formType=blue, status=signed, signedAt=2026-06-10.
2. GET the site detail.
testCases.expectedResult: Site baselineEstablishedAt set to the BLUE signed/approved date, status moves to baseline_pending, and nextAuditDueAt = signedAt + 90 days. Confirms BLUE baseline activation.

testCases.title: Site cannot be activated without signed agreement, BLUE baseline, and warehouse reference
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS. Site in onboarding_in_progress with no agreement, no BLUE baseline, no warehouseCode.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/consignment/sites/{siteId} with { status: 'active' }.
2. Observe the response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 listing the missing blockers: 'signed agreement, BLUE baseline evidence, warehouse reference'. Site status unchanged. (Gate 1 / Acumatica-first activation guard.)

testCases.title: Site activates once agreement, BLUE baseline and warehouse reference are present
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS. Site has signed agreement, BLUE baseline (baselineEstablishedAt set), and warehouseCode populated.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/consignment/sites/{siteId} with { status: 'active' }.
2. GET the site detail.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 200, status=active, activeSince stamped to now. AuditEntry (UPDATE / CONSIGNMENT_SITE) records before/after snapshot.

testCases.title: TM cannot create or mutate a consignment site (manage denied)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as TERRITORY_MANAGER (has consignment.view + consignment.audit, NOT consignment.manage).
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/consignment/sites.
2. PATCH /api/v1/consignment/sites/{ownSite}.
testCases.testData: Valid create/patch bodies for a site the TM owns
testCases.expectedResult: Both return HTTP 403. Site creation/management is restricted to consignment.manage holders (Ops/Admin) even for a TM's own site.

testCases.title: Transition to ready_for_warehouse creates a BLOCKED warehouse-setup work item (Acumatica parked)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS. Site in onboarding_in_progress.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/consignment/sites/{siteId} with { status: 'ready_for_warehouse' }.
2. GET the site detail and inspect workItems.
testCases.expectedResult: Status moves to ready_for_warehouse and a ConsignmentWorkItem of type WAREHOUSE_SETUP with status=BLOCKED is created ('Create Acumatica consignment warehouse when access is certified'), reflecting the parked ERP boundary.

testCases.title: Create a scheduled ROSE audit for a site
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as TERRITORY_MANAGER who owns the site (consignment.audit). Active site exists.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/consignment/sites/{siteId}/audits with scheduledFor in the future.
2. GET the site audits.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 201. Audit created in scheduled/open state; site nextAuditDueAt updated to the scheduledFor date. Audit is visible to the owning TM.

testCases.title: Create audit rejects an invalid/missing scheduledFor date
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as a consignment.audit holder owning the site.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /sites/{siteId}/audits with scheduledFor='not-a-date'.
2. POST again omitting scheduledFor.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 with message 'scheduledFor must be a valid ISO date'. No audit created.

testCases.title: Complete ROSE audit with variance auto-creates discrepancy case and variance-review work item
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as the owning TM. A scheduled audit exists for an active site.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/consignment/audits/{auditId} with status=completed, completedAt, and lines where actual<expected for at least one SKU.
2. GET the site detail.
testCases.expectedResult: Audit status=completed, reconciliationStatus=open (variance present). varianceQuantity computed = actual-expected (-3). A ConsignmentDiscrepancyCase (IN_REVIEW, poFollowUp NOT_REQUIRED) and a VARIANCE_REVIEW work item are created. site.lastAuditCompletedAt set and nextAuditDueAt = completedAt+90d.

testCases.title: Complete clean ROSE audit (no variance) marks reconciliation resolved and no discrepancy
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as the owning TM. Scheduled audit exists.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /audits/{auditId} status=completed with lines where actual==expected for every SKU.
2. GET the site detail.
testCases.expectedResult: Audit completed, reconciliationStatus=resolved, no discrepancy case and no variance-review work item created. nextAuditDueAt reset to completedAt+90d.

testCases.title: Next-audit timer resets exactly 90 days from completion date
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as the owning TM. Scheduled audit exists.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /audits/{auditId} status=completed with completedAt='2026-06-29T00:00:00Z'.
2. GET the site and read nextAuditDueAt.
testCases.expectedResult: site.nextAuditDueAt = 2026-09-27T00:00:00Z (UTC + exactly 90 calendar days). Confirms 90-day cadence reset from completion, not scheduled date.

testCases.title: Upload audit photo evidence (valid image within size cap)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as the owning TM (consignment.audit). A non-cancelled audit exists. Evidence storage configured.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/consignment/audits/{auditId}/evidence with fileName, mimeType=image/jpeg, contentBase64 (<4MB), purpose=discrepancy.
2. GET the audit evidence count.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 201. Evidence stored, sha256 + sizeBytes recorded, discrepancyEvidenceCount increments. AuditEntry written with storageOwner=pulse_crm.

testCases.title: Evidence upload rejects non-image mime type
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as a consignment.audit holder. Audit exists.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /audits/{auditId}/evidence with mimeType=application/pdf and valid base64.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 with 'ROSE evidence upload accepts photos only'. Only image/jpeg|png|webp|heic|heif are accepted. No evidence stored.

testCases.title: Evidence upload rejects photo over 4 MB (boundary)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as a consignment.audit holder. Audit exists.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /audits/{auditId}/evidence with contentBase64 decoding to >4 MB.
2. Test exactly 4 MB (should pass) and 4 MB + 1 byte (should fail).
testCases.testData: contentBase64 decoding to ~4.5 MB; boundary at 4 MB
testCases.expectedResult: Payload >4 MB returns HTTP 400 'ROSE evidence photo cannot exceed 4 MB'. A payload at or below 4 MB succeeds. Confirms the CONSIGNMENT_EVIDENCE_MAX_BYTES boundary.

testCases.title: Evidence cannot be uploaded to a cancelled audit
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as a consignment.audit holder. Audit exists in CANCELLED status.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH the audit to status=cancelled.
2. POST /audits/{auditId}/evidence with a valid photo.
testCases.testData: Valid image payload against a cancelled audit
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 'Evidence cannot be uploaded to a cancelled ROSE audit'. No evidence stored.

testCases.title: True-up with po_required outcome starts the 5-business-day PO clock
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS (consignment.manage). A COMPLETED audit with at least one varianced line exists.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/consignment/audits/{auditId}/true-up with outcome=po_required, confirmedAt.
2. GET the site detail and inspect the discrepancy case + work items.
testCases.expectedResult: Discrepancy moves to PO_REQUIRED, poFollowUpStatus=REQUIRED, trueUpConfirmedAt set, poDueAt = confirmedAt + 5 business days (skipping weekends). A PO_FOLLOW_UP work item (high priority, dueAt=poDueAt) is created and audit.reconciliationStatus=true_up_confirmed. AuditEntry logs poClockStarted=true.

testCases.title: PO due date crosses a weekend correctly (business-day boundary)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.manage holder. COMPLETED audit with variance.
testCases.steps:
1. POST true-up with outcome=po_required and confirmedAt on a Wednesday.
2. Read poDueAt from the discrepancy case.
testCases.expectedResult: poDueAt = the following Wednesday 2026-07-08 (5 business days = Thu, Fri, Mon, Tue, Wed), proving weekend days are excluded by addBusinessDays.

testCases.title: True-up does not start a PO clock when outcome is resolved_no_po (variance explained)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.manage holder. COMPLETED audit with variance that open POs/in-transit explain.
testCases.steps:
1. POST true-up with outcome=resolved_no_po.
2. GET site detail and inspect discrepancy + work items.
testCases.expectedResult: Discrepancy status=RESOLVED, poFollowUpStatus=NOT_REQUIRED, poDueAt null, no PO_FOLLOW_UP work item created, audit.reconciliationStatus=resolved. Confirms the clock starts only on real unresolved consumption.

testCases.title: True-up rejected when the audit is not yet completed
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.manage holder. Audit exists in scheduled/in_progress (not completed).
testCases.steps:
1. POST /audits/{auditId}/true-up with outcome=po_required.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 'ROSE audit must be completed before true-up can be confirmed'. No discrepancy/PO clock created. Enforces audit-then-reconciliation ordering (FR-CSG-041).

testCases.title: True-up rejected when the completed audit has zero variance
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.manage holder. COMPLETED audit where every line actual==expected.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /audits/{auditId}/true-up with any outcome.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 'True-up confirmation requires a completed audit variance'. No PO clock starts on a clean audit.

testCases.title: True-up with write_off outcome waives the PO follow-up
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.manage holder. COMPLETED audit with variance.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /audits/{auditId}/true-up with outcome=write_off.
2. GET site detail and inspect discrepancy.
testCases.expectedResult: Discrepancy status=WRITTEN_OFF, poFollowUpStatus=WAIVED, reconciliationStatus=resolved, reasonCode recorded. No PO_FOLLOW_UP work item created. Note: write-off financial policy itself is OQ-CSG-02 (open).

testCases.title: True-up rejects an unknown outcome enum value
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.manage holder. COMPLETED audit with variance.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /audits/{auditId}/true-up with outcome='maybe'.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 'outcome must be po_required, resolved_no_po, or write_off'. No state change.

testCases.title: TM cannot confirm true-up (manage-only)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as TERRITORY_MANAGER owning the site. COMPLETED audit with variance.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /audits/{auditId}/true-up as TM.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 403. True-up requires consignment.manage (Ops/Admin); TM mobile flow does the audit, back-office owns true-up (FR-CSG-055 split).

testCases.title: Marking PO received closes the case and recalcs baseline when it is the last PO-required discrepancy
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.manage holder. A discrepancy in PO_REQUIRED state is the only open PO-required discrepancy for its audit; site is active.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/consignment/discrepancies/{discrepancyId} with receivedAt and externalPoRef.
2. GET the site detail.
testCases.expectedResult: Discrepancy status=PO_RECEIVED, PO_FOLLOW_UP work item completed. Because it is the last PO-required discrepancy, site.baselineEstablishedAt=receivedAt and nextAuditDueAt=receivedAt+90d, audit.reconciliationStatus=resolved. AuditEntry logs trigger=po_received_baseline_recalc.

testCases.title: Mark-received rejected for a discrepancy not in PO-required state
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.manage holder. A discrepancy in IN_REVIEW or RESOLVED (not PO_REQUIRED).
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /discrepancies/{discrepancyId} with receivedAt.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 'Only PO-required discrepancies can be marked received'. No baseline recalc.

testCases.title: Mark-received returns not-found for a non-existent discrepancy id
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.manage holder.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/consignment/discrepancies/{bogusId} with receivedAt.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 404 (message contains 'not found'). No state change.

testCases.title: Create a PURPLE baseline adjustment (happy path)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS (consignment.document_manage). Active site exists.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/consignment/sites/{siteId}/adjustments with currentTotal, addQuantity.
2. GET site detail and inspect adjustments + work items.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 201. A PURPLE ConsignmentForm (status=current) and an adjustment (status=requested, proposedTotal=125) are created, plus an ADJUSTMENT_REVIEW work item. AuditEntry metadata marks acumaticaInventoryAdjustment=parked.

testCases.title: PURPLE adjustment validation: no-op, removeQuantity>currentTotal, and unchanged total rejected
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.document_manage holder. Active site.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /adjustments with currentTotal=100, addQuantity=0, removeQuantity=0 (no proposedTotal).
2. POST /adjustments with currentTotal=10, removeQuantity=20.
3. POST /adjustments with currentTotal=100, proposedTotal=100.
testCases.expectedResult: Step 1 -> 400 'PURPLE adjustment must change the manual baseline total'. Step 2 -> 400 'removeQuantity cannot exceed currentTotal'. Step 3 -> 400 'PURPLE adjustment proposedTotal must differ from currentTotal'. Negative/NaN quantities also rejected by non-negative-integer normalization.

testCases.title: Apply a requested PURPLE adjustment updates the manual baseline
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS (consignment.manage). A requested adjustment exists; site.manualBaselineQuantity is null or equals currentTotal.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/consignment/adjustments/{adjustmentId}/apply with appliedAt.
2. GET site detail.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 200. Adjustment status=applied, site.manualBaselineQuantity=proposedTotal, baselineEstablishedAt=appliedAt, ADJUSTMENT_REVIEW work item completed.

testCases.title: Apply rejected when adjustment already applied or currentTotal drifted (TOCTOU/state guard)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.manage holder. Adjustment already APPLIED; separately, an adjustment whose currentTotal no longer matches site.manualBaselineQuantity.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /adjustments/{appliedId}/apply.
2. Change site manualBaselineQuantity, then POST /adjustments/{requestedId}/apply.
testCases.testData: Re-apply an APPLIED adjustment; apply a stale-currentTotal adjustment
testCases.expectedResult: Step 1 -> 400 'Only requested PURPLE adjustments can be applied'. Step 2 -> 400 'PURPLE adjustment currentTotal no longer matches the site manual baseline'. Guards against double-apply and concurrent baseline drift.

testCases.title: Start SAND exit moves site to exiting and creates exit record + review work item
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS (consignment.manage). Active site exists.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/consignment/sites/{siteId}/exit with noticeGivenAt, plannedExitAt.
2. GET site detail.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 201. A SAND ConsignmentForm and a ConsignmentExit (status=notice_given) are created, site status=exiting, and an EXIT_REVIEW work item (high) is opened. AuditEntry metadata marks acumaticaSettlementPosting=parked.

testCases.title: Cannot start a SAND exit on an already-exited site
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.manage holder. Site already in EXITED status.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /sites/{siteId}/exit.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 'Exited consignment sites cannot start another SAND exit'.

testCases.title: Close SAND exit requires return qty, retained qty, or settlement reference
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.manage holder. An open exit (notice_given) exists.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/consignment/exits/{exitId}/close with all of returnQuantity/retainedQuantity omitted and no settlementReference.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 'SAND closure needs return quantity, retained quantity, or settlement reference'. Site remains exiting.

testCases.title: Close SAND exit sets site EXITED and is idempotent on a closed exit
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.manage holder. Open exit exists.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /exits/{exitId}/close with settlementReference and finalReconciliationAt.
2. POST /exits/{exitId}/close again.
3. GET site detail.
testCases.expectedResult: First call: exit status=closed, site status=exited, exitedAt set, open exit/PO/variance work items completed. Second call returns 200 with the already-closed site unchanged (idempotent). AuditEntry written on close.

testCases.title: Audit due/overdue alert windows generate the correct alert types
testCases.preconditions: Scheduler/scanner (scanConsignmentOperationalAlerts) runnable. Sites with audits scheduled at T-14, T-7, T-0, T+7, T+14 relative to now.
testCases.steps:
1. Run the alert scan.
2. Inspect persisted ConsignmentOperationalAlert rows.
testCases.testData: Audits dated -14d, -7d, today, +7d overdue, +14d overdue from now
testCases.expectedResult: Exactly one alert per window: AUDIT_DUE_FOURTEEN_DAYS, AUDIT_DUE_SEVEN_DAYS, AUDIT_DUE_TODAY, AUDIT_OVERDUE_SEVEN_DAYS (TM+RD), AUDIT_OVERDUE_FOURTEEN_DAYS (Sales Leadership), all status=PENDING.

testCases.title: Re-running the alert scanner is idempotent (dedupeKey)
testCases.preconditions: Alert scanner already produced alerts for a fixed set of sites/windows.
testCases.steps:
1. Run the alert scan.
2. Run the alert scan again with the same clock/state.
3. Count alert rows per dedupeKey.
testCases.testData: Same now() and site state across two runs
testCases.expectedResult: No duplicate alerts are created on the second run; each dedupeKey yields exactly one ConsignmentOperationalAlert (unique constraint enforced).

testCases.title: PO clock alerts fire at start, T-3, T-1, +5 and +10 overdue
testCases.preconditions: Discrepancies in PO_REQUIRED with trueUpConfirmedAt/poDueAt at the relevant offsets from now.
testCases.steps:
1. Run the alert scan with PO clocks at start (true-up <24h), 3d remaining, 1d remaining, 5d overdue, 10d overdue.
2. Inspect alert types.
testCases.testData: poDueAt offsets: +3d, +1d; trueUp within 24h; overdue by 5d and 10d
testCases.expectedResult: PO_CLOCK_START, PO_CLOCK_THREE_DAYS_REMAINING, PO_CLOCK_ONE_DAY_REMAINING, PO_OVERDUE_FIVE_DAYS (TM+RD), PO_OVERDUE_TEN_DAYS (Sales Leadership) alerts are produced as PENDING.

testCases.title: Email/Graph delivery of consignment alerts remains parked (in-app only)
testCases.preconditions: PENDING ConsignmentOperationalAlert rows exist. Microsoft Graph sendMail credentials are NOT certified (parked dependency, same as lead alerts).
testCases.steps:
1. Confirm alerts surface in the in-app Next Site Work queue / dashboard pendingAlerts.
2. Confirm no email delivery dispatcher runs.
testCases.expectedResult: Alerts are visible in-app via the dashboard pendingAlerts, but no email is sent — rows stay PENDING until Graph is certified. Test documents the parked delivery dependency.

testCases.title: Acumatica inventory read-model sync with last-sync timestamp and stale warning
testCases.preconditions: Acumatica sandbox/endpoint certification NOT available (parked). Site has acumaticaStatus parked.
testCases.steps:
1. Attempt to sync consignment warehouse inventory from Acumatica.
2. Open a ROSE audit review screen.
testCases.expectedResult: Sync is not executed (parked); the audit context surfaces last-sync timestamp + stale-data warning and the TM may still proceed with manual count. Every Acumatica-sourced number carries sourceRef/lastSyncedAt/syncStatus per boundary rule 4A.6. Numeric 15-min SLA is an open question (OQ-CSG-06).

testCases.title: Pulse links/references the Acumatica-posted PO but never posts it
testCases.preconditions: Acumatica PO/order endpoint certification NOT available (parked). A PO_REQUIRED discrepancy exists.
testCases.steps:
1. Mark PO received in Pulse with externalPoRef.
2. Verify Pulse does not call Acumatica to post the PO.
testCases.expectedResult: Pulse closes its own work item and records externalPoRef as a manual reference only; no PO is posted to Acumatica (boundary rule: Pulse never posts a PO). Acumatica posting/inventory baseline-in-ERP remains parked.

testCases.title: Warehouse creation, TR transfer and receipt posting are Acumatica-owned (parked)
testCases.preconditions: Acumatica sandbox NOT available. Site in ready_for_warehouse.
testCases.steps:
1. Attempt to advance the site through warehouse creation / TR / receipt.
2. Inspect acumaticaStatus and work items.
testCases.testData: Site without a real warehouse ID
testCases.expectedResult: acumaticaStatus stays PARKED; the site cannot leave onboarding/ready states into active without a real warehouseCode/warehouse ID (Pulse never invents one). Warehouse-setup work item stays BLOCKED. Admin-exception path is audit-logged.

testCases.title: All consignment endpoints require authentication
testCases.preconditions: No/invalid bearer token.
testCases.steps:
1. Call GET /api/v1/consignment/sites, /dashboard, and a POST endpoint without a valid token.
2. Observe responses.
testCases.expectedResult: All return HTTP 401 (unauthorized). No data is returned and no mutation occurs.

testCases.title: Raw payment-card data in notes fields is rejected (PCI)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as consignment.manage/document_manage holder. Site/audit exists.
testCases.steps:
1. POST a document/adjustment/exit/true-up/audit with notes containing a raw 16-digit PAN (e.g. 4111111111111111).
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 400 from assertNoRawPaymentCardData (raw card data rejected). No record is persisted with the PAN. Applies to true-up, document, adjustment, exit, and audit notes.

testCases.title: Mutations write immutable AuditEntry records with actor and before/after
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS. A site exists.
testCases.steps:
1. Create a site, complete an audit, confirm true-up, apply an adjustment, close an exit.
2. Query AuditEntry rows for the entities.
testCases.testData: A sequence of mutations across one site
testCases.expectedResult: Each mutation produces an AuditEntry capturing actorUserId, action, entityType/entityId and before/after snapshots (e.g. CONSIGNMENT_SITE, CONSIGNMENT_AUDIT, CONSIGNMENT_TRUE_UP, CONSIGNMENT_ADJUSTMENT, CONSIGNMENT_EXIT), with parked-boundary metadata where relevant.

testCases.title: Account read-model surfaces consignment participation and drill-down
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated with consignment.view. An account has one or more consignment sites.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/consignment/accounts/{accountId}.
2. Inspect the returned read model.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 200 with the account consignment read model (active/onboarding/exited counts and site links) enabling the account-page indicator and drill-down. Note: UX placement of the indicator in the account hero (FR-CSG-050 / UX-CSG-002) is a separate web-UI item.

testCases.title: Account read-model returns not-found for an account with no consignment footprint
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated with consignment.view. Account exists but has no consignment site.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/consignment/accounts/{accountId}.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 404 (AccountConsignmentReadModel not found). The account page should then show no consignment indicator.

testCases.title: Server-owned dashboard computes scoped KPIs from the database
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS. Sites across active/ready/exited with audits, discrepancies and PO follow-ups.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/consignment/dashboard.
2. Inspect metrics, onboardingPipeline, auditDueBuckets, workQueue, pendingAlerts.
testCases.expectedResult: Returns active/overdue counts, auditComplianceRatePct, onTimeFirstBaselinePct, overduePoCount, meanPoCycleDays, exitCompletionRatePct, plus onboarding pipeline and due buckets — all computed via siteScopeWhere (no client truncation). inventoryValueBySite is flagged parked.

testCases.title: Inventory-value and revenue KPIs are parked behind Acumatica truth
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS. Acumatica inventory truth not available.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/consignment/dashboard.
2. Inspect the inventory value / revenue KPIs.
testCases.expectedResult: inventoryValueBySiteParked=true; Site Inventory Value, Total Consignment Value and Consignment Revenue surface as explicit 'Parked' cards rather than fabricated numbers, honoring the financial-truth boundary.

testCases.title: Dashboard metrics are role-scoped (TM dashboard shows only own book)
testCases.preconditions: TM-A owns 3 sites; total program has 30 sites. Authenticated as TM-A.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/consignment/dashboard as TM-A.
2. Compare counts to the Ops dashboard.
testCases.expectedResult: TM-A's activeSites and related counts reflect only their 3 sites; Ops/Exec dashboards reflect all 30. Confirms server-side scoping of aggregate metrics, not just lists.

testCases.title: Unicode/special characters in notes and product names persist and round-trip safely
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as a consignment.audit holder. Audit exists.
testCases.steps:
1. Complete an audit with a line productName and notes containing unicode/emoji and SQL-ish characters.
2. GET the audit and inspect the stored values.
testCases.testData: productName: "Régulateur ½\" — ñ", notes: "'; DROP TABLE--"
testCases.expectedResult: Values are stored and returned verbatim (parameterized queries via Prisma; no injection, no truncation/corruption). Trimming removes only surrounding whitespace.

testCases.title: TM completes a full offline ROSE audit on mobile and syncs durable results
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as TERRITORY_MANAGER on the mobile app (use-consignment-rose-audit hook). Assigned active site with expected inventory loaded.
testCases.steps:
1. Go offline; run the 7-step ROSE flow (review, observe, scan/manual count, evaluate, exceptions, report, attest) capturing photos and notes.
2. Reconnect and let the draft queue sync.
3. Verify the server audit + lines + evidence + attestation.
testCases.testData: Offline counts with one varianced SKU, two photos, TM attestation
testCases.expectedResult: On reconnect the audit, lines, variance, evidence and TM attestation are persisted server-side; discrepancy case auto-created for the variance. Offline completion works for the full flow (NFR-CSG-01 8h offline target).

testCases.title: Barcode scan no-match falls back to manual entry flagged for back-office
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as TM on mobile during a ROSE audit. Scanned barcode has no matching SKU.
testCases.steps:
1. Scan a barcode with no system match.
2. Use the manual-entry fallback.
3. Complete the audit.
testCases.expectedResult: TM receives an 'Item not found — enter manually' prompt; the manually entered line is recorded and flagged for back-office validation post-audit. Barcode standard itself is OQ-CSG-01 (open).

testCases.title: Offline sync conflict surfaces a resolution screen and does not auto-commit
testCases.preconditions: TM completes an audit offline while server-side state for the same audit changes during the offline window.
testCases.steps:
1. Submit the offline audit.
2. On reconnect, observe conflict handling.
testCases.testData: Server state diverged from offline draft
testCases.expectedResult: On reconnect a conflict-resolution view shows offline count vs server state; a back-office user must approve the merge — the audit is not silently auto-committed (per EH-CSG-02). Verify current implementation depth.

testCases.title: Operational queue lists scoped work items linked to site/audit/PO/form
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS. Sites have open work items (variance review, PO follow-up, exit review).
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/consignment/ops?status=...&auditStatus=...
2. Inspect returned queue entries.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 200 with work-queue entries (owner, status, linked site/audit/PO/form) for sites within the actor's scope; filters narrow by site status and audit status. TM sees only their own sites' items.

testCases.title: Unsupported methods return 405 with Allow header
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS.
testCases.steps:

2. PUT /api/v1/consignment/dashboard.
testCases.testData: DELETE / PUT on collection and dashboard routes
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 405 Method Not Allowed listing permitted methods (e.g. sites: GET, POST). No side effects.

testCases.title: Unknown site/audit ids return 404 not-found
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS.
testCases.steps:

2. PATCH /api/v1/consignment/audits/{bogusId}.
3. GET /api/v1/consignment/sites/{bogusId}/readiness.
testCases.expectedResult: All return HTTP 404 (entity not found). Error path maps 'not found' messages to 404 rather than 400.

testCases.title: Account created on first-order activation carries sourceLeadId, territory and lead context forward
testCases.preconditions: A qualified lead has completed discovery/CIS/onboarding and reaches the first-order activation boundary. Lead has territory, region, shipping centre, TM/RD assignment, known contacts and locations.
testCases.steps:
1. Trigger the first-order activation event for the lead.
2. Inspect the newly created account record via GET /api/v1/accounts/{id}.
3. Inspect the originating lead record.
testCases.testData: Lead with sourceLeadId=LEAD-1001, territory=TX-Central, TM=user-tm1, 2 contacts, 1 location
testCases.expectedResult: Account is created with sourceLeadId populated (=LEAD-1001); territory/region/shipping-centre/TM/RD carry forward; known contacts and locations are present on the account; lifecycle=Active; the originating lead still exists and is not deleted.

testCases.title: SUPER_ADMIN can create an account via the bootstrap path with a valid displayName
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as SUPER_ADMIN.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/accounts with body {"displayName":"Acme HVAC"}.
2. Inspect the response and the audit log.
testCases.expectedResult: 201 Created; account returned with displayName=Acme HVAC, lifecycleStatus=Active, isActive=true; an audit entry of action CREATE / entityType ACCOUNT is written with actorRole=SUPER_ADMIN.

testCases.title: Non-SUPER_ADMIN role with customer.create action is still blocked from manual creation by service guard
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as TERRITORY_MANAGER (or SALES_BD_REP / SALES_BD_LEADERSHIP / ADMIN_CSR_OPS) — roles that hold the customer.create action grant but are not SUPER_ADMIN.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/accounts with body {"displayName":"Backdoor Co"}.
2. Observe the response.
testCases.expectedResult: Request is rejected (400 Bad Request) with message indicating direct customer creation is reserved for bootstrap/migration and to convert from lead on first order. No account is created. (Layered guard: action grant alone is insufficient; service enforces role===SUPER_ADMIN.)

testCases.title: Role without customer.create action (FINANCE / EXECUTIVE / REGIONAL_DIRECTOR) is denied at authorization layer
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as FINANCE (repeat for EXECUTIVE, REGIONAL_DIRECTOR, TRAINING_OPS, DEALER_PORTAL_USER).
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/accounts with body {"displayName":"Denied Co"}.
2. Observe the response.
testCases.expectedResult: 403 Forbidden (access denied) returned by the customer.create action guard before the SUPER_ADMIN service check; no account created.

testCases.title: Create account rejected when displayName is empty or whitespace-only
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as SUPER_ADMIN.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/accounts with body {"displayName":"   "}.
2. Repeat with displayName missing entirely.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 Bad Request with message 'displayName is required'; no account created in either case.

testCases.title: Needs-follow-up queue surfaces accounts with At Risk status, missing territory, zero contacts, or zero locations with next-action label
testCases.preconditions: Directory seeded with: an At Risk account, an account with no territory, an account with zero contacts, an account with zero locations, and a fully-complete Active account.
testCases.steps:
1. Open Accounts and land on the 'Needs follow-up' view.
2. Review each row's next-action label.
3. Confirm the complete Active account does NOT appear.
testCases.expectedResult: Four flagged accounts appear, each with a plain next-action label (e.g. 'Review risk', 'Assign territory', 'Add a contact', 'Add a location'); the complete Active account is excluded from the queue.

testCases.feature: Account Directory — All Accounts View & Summary Counts
testCases.title: All-accounts directory shows owner, territory, contact count, location count, lifecycle, last-updated and manager summary counts
testCases.preconditions: Several accounts exist with varied owners, territories, lifecycle states and lead-sourced flags. Authenticated as a global-visibility role (e.g. SALES_BD_LEADERSHIP).
testCases.steps:
1. Switch to 'All accounts' view.
2. Inspect a row's displayed columns.
3. Inspect the summary counts strip.
testCases.testData: Mixed account population (some At Risk, some territory-assigned, some lead-sourced)
testCases.expectedResult: Each row shows owner, territory, contact count, location count, lifecycle and last-updated; summary counts (At Risk, territory-assigned, lead-sourced, active) are displayed and reconcile with the data.

testCases.title: Lifecycle filter returns only accounts in the selected state; invalid lifecycle value is handled
testCases.preconditions: Accounts exist across Active / At Risk / Inactive / Churned. Authenticated as customer.view role.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/accounts?lifecycleStatus=at_risk.
2. GET /api/v1/accounts?lifecycleStatus=churned&includeInactive=true.
3. GET /api/v1/accounts?lifecycleStatus=bogus_value.
testCases.testData: lifecycleStatus in {active, at_risk, inactive, churned, bogus_value}
testCases.expectedResult: Filtered results contain only accounts in the requested lifecycle state; churned/inactive require includeInactive=true to appear (isActive=false); an unrecognised lifecycleStatus value is rejected with 400 Bad Request rather than returning all rows.

testCases.title: Partial case-insensitive search matches display name, legal name and account number
testCases.preconditions: Accounts seeded: displayName 'Northwind Plumbing', legalName 'NW Plumbing Inc', accountNumber 'ACC-00042'.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/accounts?search=north.
2. GET /api/v1/accounts?search=NW%20Plumbing.
3. GET /api/v1/accounts?search=00042.
testCases.expectedResult: Each search returns the Northwind Plumbing account; matching is partial and case-insensitive across displayName, legalName and accountNumber.

testCases.title: Pagination limit defaults, caps at 100, and rejects invalid limit/offset
testCases.preconditions: More than 150 accounts exist (scalability seed). Authenticated as global-visibility role.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/accounts (no limit) — confirm default page size.
2. GET /api/v1/accounts?limit=500 — confirm cap.
3. GET /api/v1/accounts?limit=0 and ?limit=-5.
4. GET /api/v1/accounts?offset=-1.
5. GET /api/v1/accounts?limit=50&offset=50 — confirm second page.
testCases.expectedResult: Default page size is 25; limit is capped at 100 even when 500 requested; limit<=0 returns 400 'limit must be a positive integer'; negative offset returns 400 'offset must be a non-negative integer'; offset=50 returns the next page with correct total. NOTE: PRD FR-ACC-004 AC2 states page size >=50 and UX-A-010 cites a 200 hard limit; actual API default 25 / cap 100 — flag as spec-vs-build discrepancy.

testCases.title: Search handles special characters, unicode and SQL-injection-style input safely
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as customer.view role. An account named 'Café Niño & Sons' exists.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/accounts?search=Caf%C3%A9%20Ni%C3%B1o (unicode).
2. GET /api/v1/accounts?search=%27%20OR%201%3D1%20--  (' OR 1=1 --).
3. GET /api/v1/accounts?search=%25_  (% and _ wildcards).
testCases.expectedResult: Unicode search returns the matching account; the injection string is treated as a literal search term (parameterised query) returning no spurious rows and causing no error; SQL wildcards are treated literally, not as operators.

testCases.title: Workspace exposes Profile/Contacts/Locations tabs plus six More-drawer panels with URL tab persistence
testCases.preconditions: An account exists. Authenticated as customer.view role.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the account detail page.
2. Confirm the three primary tabs.
3. Open the 'More' drawer and enumerate panels.
4. Navigate to a secondary panel and copy the URL; reload.
testCases.expectedResult: Profile, Contacts and Locations tabs are present by default; the More drawer exposes readiness, consignment, activity & documents, payment methods, training and dealer portal (6 panels); the active tab is reflected in ?tab= and is restored on reload (deep-link). UX-A-014 done.

testCases.title: Authorized role edits profile fields including separate affinity and ownership group selections
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Authenticated as a customer.edit role in scope (e.g. SALES_BD_REP for an in-book account, or SUPER_ADMIN).
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/accounts/{id} updating displayName, legalName, accountType, affinityGroupSelection=group + affinityGroupId, ownershipGroupSelection=none.
2. GET the account and the audit log.
testCases.testData: { displayName:'Acme HVAC West', legalName:'Acme HVAC LLC', accountType:'Distributor', affinityGroupSelection:'group', affinityGroupId:'AFF-1', ownershipGroupSelection:'none' }
testCases.expectedResult: 200 OK; fields persisted; affinity resolves to the connected group, ownership set to None/Independent (disconnected); affinity and ownership are independent dimensions; an UPDATE audit entry records before/after state.
