testCases.title: Update with empty displayName and unknown brand label are rejected
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Authenticated as customer.edit role in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/accounts/{id} with {"displayName":"  "}.
2. PATCH /api/v1/accounts/{id} with {"brandLabelId":"does-not-exist"}.
testCases.expectedResult: First request returns 400 'displayName cannot be empty'; second returns 400 'Brand label not found: does-not-exist'; account is unchanged in both cases.

testCases.title: Affinity and ownership groups are governed catalogue references reconciled with Acumatica attribute list
testCases.preconditions: Reference catalogues for affinity and ownership groups are loaded. Acumatica attribute list available for comparison.
testCases.steps:
1. Retrieve the affinity group catalogue options.
2. Compare against the Acumatica Attributes affinity-group list.
3. Attempt to set affinityGroupCode to a value not in the catalogue.
testCases.testData: Affinity catalogue vs Acumatica attribute export
testCases.expectedResult: Both fields present governed dropdowns (not free text) and allow None/Independent; an unrecognised code is resolved/rejected rather than silently free-texted. NOTE: PRD marks catalogue-vs-Acumatica completeness as Partial (reconciliation not yet verified) — record any mismatch.

testCases.title: Source lead link is shown and navigates to the originating lead; placeholder shown when absent
testCases.preconditions: One account with sourceLeadId set (conversion-born) and one account without (bootstrap-origin).
testCases.steps:
1. Open the conversion-born account overview and click the source-lead link.
2. Open the bootstrap account overview.
testCases.expectedResult: Account A shows a source-lead link navigating to /leads/LEAD-1001. Account B: PRD requires a contextual placeholder when no source lead exists — UX-A-008 confirms this is OPEN (no placeholder rendered), so expect the link area to be missing/blank — mark as a known gap.

testCases.title: Create, edit, soft-deactivate and reactivate a contact succeed for authorized role
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Authenticated as contact.create / customer.edit role in scope (e.g. TERRITORY_MANAGER for own-book account).
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/accounts/{id}/contacts with firstName/lastName.
2. PATCH the contact to change title and email.
3. PATCH isActive=false (soft-deactivate).
4. PATCH isActive=true (reactivate).
5. GET /api/v1/accounts/{id}/contacts.
testCases.expectedResult: Contact created (201); edits persist; email is stored lowercased ('dana@acme.com'); soft-deactivate sets isActive=false but the record remains listed; reactivate restores it; no hard delete occurs; each mutation writes an audit entry.

testCases.title: Contact create rejected when firstName or lastName missing/blank
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Authenticated as contact.create role in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. POST contact with {firstName:'Dana'} (no lastName).
2. POST contact with {firstName:'  ', lastName:'  '}.
testCases.expectedResult: Both return 400 'firstName and lastName are required'; no contact created.

testCases.title: Deactivating the sole primary contact auto-promotes a fallback active contact rather than leaving no primary
testCases.preconditions: Account has a primary contact (C1) and at least one other active contact (C2). Authenticated as customer.edit role in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH C1 with isActive=false (deactivate the sole primary).
2. GET /api/v1/accounts/{id}/contacts.
3. Repeat on an account where C1 is the ONLY active contact.
testCases.testData: Account with C1(primary,active), C2(active); second account with only C1(primary)
testCases.expectedResult: When a fallback exists, C2 is auto-promoted to primary (ensurePrimaryActiveContact) so exactly one active primary remains. When no fallback exists, deactivation leaves the account with no active primary. NOTE: PRD/BR-A-05 expect removal to be REJECTED unless a replacement is designated — the API instead auto-reassigns and the UI guard (UX-A-005) is still OPEN — record the behavioural gap.

testCases.title: Setting a new primary contact demotes the previous primary (single-primary invariant)
testCases.preconditions: Account has C1 (primary) and C2 (not primary), both active. Authenticated as customer.edit role in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH C2 with isPrimary=true.
2. GET contacts and inspect both records.
testCases.expectedResult: C2 becomes primary and C1 is demoted to isPrimary=false in the same transaction; exactly one primary exists.

testCases.title: Editing a contact under the wrong account id returns not found (no cross-account access)
testCases.preconditions: Contact C1 belongs to Account A. Account B exists. Authenticated as customer.edit role with access to both.
testCases.steps: 1. PATCH /api/v1/accounts/{B-id}/contacts/{C1-id} with any change.
testCases.testData: Account B id, contact C1 of Account A
testCases.expectedResult: 404 'Contact not found' — the contact is looked up scoped to the path account id, so it cannot be edited via a mismatched account.

testCases.title: Linking a contact to a location belonging to a different account is rejected
testCases.preconditions: Account A has contact C1. Location L9 belongs to Account B. Authenticated as customer.edit role.
testCases.steps: 1. POST/PATCH contact on Account A with locationId=L9.
testCases.testData: Account A, locationId=L9 (belongs to Account B)
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'locationId does not belong to this account'; contact link not set.

testCases.title: Management contacts are displayed ahead of technician contacts
testCases.preconditions: Account has 1 primary/management contact plus 14 technician contacts.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the Contacts tab.
2. Observe ordering (primary first).
testCases.expectedResult: Primary/management contacts sort to the top (isPrimary desc, then createdAt) so the management contact is not buried beneath technicians. NOTE: role-based management-vs-technician ranking depends on the governed role catalogue (FR-ACC-009, Not-built); current sort is primary-first only.

testCases.title: Contact role uses governed catalogue (Primary/Owner-GM/Ordering/Billing/Accounting-AP/Technical) not free text
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Authenticated as contact.create role.
testCases.steps:
1. Create a contact and inspect the role input.
2. Attempt to save an arbitrary free-text role.
testCases.expectedResult: EXPECTED (target): role presents a governed dropdown and rejects values outside the catalogue. ACTUAL: roleCode is stored as free text with no validation (UX-A-004 open) — mark as Not-built and assert the gap.

testCases.title: Create/edit/soft-deactivate/reactivate location and capture US/Canada address with billing-vs-shipping intent
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Authenticated as location.create / customer.edit role in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/accounts/{id}/locations with name, line1, city, state, postalCode, countryCode=ca, locationType=billing.
2. PATCH the location to change city.
3. PATCH isActive=false then isActive=true.
4. GET locations.
testCases.testData: { name:'Warehouse 1', line1:'10 King St', city:'Toronto', state:'ON', postalCode:'M5H 1A1', countryCode:'ca', locationType:'billing' }
testCases.expectedResult: Location created (201); countryCode stored uppercased ('CA'); locationType=billing round-trips (stored via name-prefix convention per UX-A-012); soft-deactivate/reactivate preserve the record; audit entries written; territory assignment refreshed after create/update.

testCases.title: Location create rejected when no identity (locationCode, name or line1) is provided
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Authenticated as location.create role in scope.
testCases.steps: 1. POST /api/v1/accounts/{id}/locations with only {city:'Dallas', state:'TX'}.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'locationCode, name, or line1 is required'; no location created.

testCases.title: First location auto-becomes primary; setting a new primary demotes the previous; deactivating sole primary promotes fallback
testCases.preconditions: Account has no locations. Authenticated as location.create / customer.edit role in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. POST first location (no isPrimary specified).
2. POST a second location with isPrimary=true.
3. PATCH the new primary with isActive=false.
4. GET locations after each step.
testCases.expectedResult: L1 is auto-primary (account had zero locations); making L2 primary demotes L1; deactivating the sole active primary promotes the next active location (ensurePrimaryActiveLocation) so at most one primary remains among active locations.

testCases.title: Editing a location via a mismatched account id returns not found
testCases.preconditions: Location L1 belongs to Account A. Account B exists. Authenticated as customer.edit role.
testCases.steps: 1. PATCH /api/v1/accounts/{B-id}/locations/{L1-id}.
testCases.testData: Account B id with Account A location L1
testCases.expectedResult: 404 'Location not found' — location is resolved scoped to the path account; no cross-account edit.

testCases.title: Valid lifecycle transitions are enforced and invalid transitions rejected
testCases.preconditions: Active account exists. Authenticated as customer.edit role in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /accounts/{id}/lifecycle Active->At Risk (valid).
2. At Risk->Inactive (valid).
3. Inactive->Churned with reason (valid).
4. Attempt Active->Churned directly (invalid).
5. Attempt At Risk->Churned directly (invalid).
testCases.expectedResult: Steps 1-3 succeed (200) and update lifecycleStatusChangedAt; steps 4-5 return 400 'Lifecycle transition is not allowed: ...'. Allowed map: Active->{At Risk,Inactive}; At Risk->{Active,Inactive}; Inactive->{Active,Churned}; Churned->{Active}.

testCases.title: Reason note enforcement on consequential transitions (Churned requires note; Inactive does not — gap)
testCases.preconditions: Account in Inactive state (for Churn) and an Active account (for Inactive). Authenticated as customer.edit role in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH lifecycle Inactive->Churned WITHOUT lifecycleReasonNote.
2. PATCH lifecycle Inactive->Churned WITH a reason note.
3. PATCH lifecycle Active->Inactive WITHOUT a reason note.
testCases.testData: Churn with/without note; Inactive without note
testCases.expectedResult: Step 1 returns 400 'A lifecycle note is required before an account can be marked as churned'; step 2 succeeds. Step 3 SUCCEEDS even without a note — but FR-ACC-011 AC2 requires a reason on Inactive too (and UX-A-003 confirms reason-not-required on At Risk/Inactive is OPEN) — record this as a known gap.

testCases.title: Lifecycle status drives isActive but stays a distinct field from the archive flag
testCases.preconditions: Active account. Authenticated as customer.edit role in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. Transition to Inactive; GET account.
2. Transition to Churned (with note); GET account.
3. Transition back to Active; GET account.
testCases.expectedResult: lifecycleStatus is tracked separately from isActive; Inactive/Churned set isActive=false while Active/At Risk set isActive=true; lifecycleReasonNote and lifecycleStatusChangedAt persist; churn/risk remain visible (not hidden by the archive flag).

testCases.title: Each lifecycle transition writes an immutable audit entry with status, changed-at, changed-by and reason
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Authenticated as customer.edit role in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. Transition lifecycle Active->At Risk.
2. Inspect the audit log / account activity review for the change.
testCases.expectedResult: An UPDATE audit entry (workflow=account_lifecycle) records before/after lifecycleStatus, changed-by (actorUserId), timestamp and reason note (if any); it surfaces in the activity review (UX-A-011 done).

testCases.title: Reassigning account owner/TM does not re-attribute prior activity authorship
testCases.preconditions: Account has activity entries authored by user-tm1. Authenticated as a role permitted to reassign (e.g. SUPER_ADMIN / territory.reassign holder).
testCases.steps:
1. Record authorId/authorName on existing activity entries.
2. Reassign the account owner/TM from user-tm1 to user-tm2.
3. Re-inspect the prior activity entries as user-tm2.
testCases.testData: Pre-existing notes by user-tm1; reassign to user-tm2
testCases.expectedResult: Prior entries retain their original immutable authorId/authorName (user-tm1) after reassignment; the new assignee sees original attribution; the reassignment itself is logged as a separate audit event.

testCases.title: Account profile shows territory/region/shipping-centre/TM/RD and assignment method
testCases.preconditions: Account assigned to a territory with region, shipping centre, TM and RD. Authenticated as customer.view role in scope.
testCases.steps: 1. GET /api/v1/accounts/{id} and inspect ownership fields.
testCases.testData: Account with territory=TX-Central, TM=user-tm1, RD=user-rd1, assignmentMethod=manual_override
testCases.expectedResult: Territory, region, shipping-centre, TM name and RD name are displayed along with the assignment-method label (default_state / manual_override / system).

testCases.title: Finance registers a manual tokenized payment reference and sets it default
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Authenticated as FINANCE (or SUPER_ADMIN).
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/accounts/{id}/payment-methods with provider, vaultToken, last4, brand, billingZip, isDefault=true.
2. GET /api/v1/accounts/{id}/payment-methods.
testCases.testData: { provider:'moneris', vaultToken:'tok_abc123', last4:'4242', brand:'Visa', billingZip:'75001', isDefault:true }
testCases.expectedResult: 201 Created storing only tokenized reference + masked descriptors (last4, brand, billingZip); isDefault=true; an audit entry (source=manual) is written; raw card/bank numbers are not present anywhere in the record.

testCases.feature: Tokenized Payment References — Raw card rejection
testCases.title: Attempt to submit a raw 13-19 digit card number must be rejected at the API boundary
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Authenticated as FINANCE.
testCases.steps:
1. POST payment-methods with last4='4111111111111111' (full PAN) and/or vaultToken containing a 16-digit number.
2. POST with vaultCustomerRef='4012888888881881'.
3. Inspect response and stored value / logs.
testCases.expectedResult: EXPECTED per FR-ACC-014 AC2 / NFR-ACC-003: any field containing 13-19 consecutive digits is rejected with a validation error and never stored or logged. ACTUAL: the service performs NO digit-pattern (PAN) rejection — last4/vaultToken/vaultCustomerRef are accepted as free strings — so a raw PAN would be stored. This is a security gap; mark Not-built and raise a defect.

testCases.title: Manual payment method rejected when no tokenized reference is supplied
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Authenticated as FINANCE.
testCases.steps: 1. POST payment-methods with only {provider:'moneris', billingZip:'75001'} (no vaultToken/vaultCustomerRef/externalPaymentMethodRef).
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'At least one tokenized payment reference is required'; no record created.

testCases.feature: Tokenized Payment References — Single default invariant
testCases.title: Registering or promoting a default payment method clears the previous default; deactivating default promotes a fallback
testCases.preconditions: Account has PM1 (default, active). Authenticated as FINANCE.
testCases.steps:
1. POST PM2 with isDefault=true.
2. GET payment methods.
3. PATCH PM2 isActive=false.
4. GET payment methods.
testCases.testData: PM1 default; add PM2 default; then deactivate PM2
testCases.expectedResult: Creating PM2 as default clears PM1's default flag (single default per account); deactivating the default PM promotes the next active reference to default (ensureDefaultActiveAccountPaymentMethod); never more than one active default.

testCases.title: Promoting a CIS vault reference belonging to a different source lead is rejected
testCases.preconditions: Account A has sourceLeadId=LEAD-1001. A CIS vault reference belongs to a CIS package for LEAD-2002. Authenticated as FINANCE.
testCases.steps:
1. POST payment-methods on Account A with sourceCisVaultReferenceId pointing at the LEAD-2002 reference.
2. POST with a non-existent sourceCisVaultReferenceId.
testCases.expectedResult: First returns 400 'sourceCisVaultReferenceId does not belong to this account source lead'; second returns 400 'sourceCisVaultReferenceId was not found'. A reference for the correct source lead would promote successfully (idempotent update if already promoted).

testCases.title: Sales/TM/RD/Executive roles cannot view or manage payment methods; only Finance/Super Admin manage
testCases.preconditions: Account exists with a payment method. Tokens for SALES_BD_REP, TERRITORY_MANAGER, REGIONAL_DIRECTOR, EXECUTIVE, FINANCE available.
testCases.steps:
1. As SALES_BD_REP: GET /accounts/{id}/payment-methods and POST a new one.
2. As TERRITORY_MANAGER and REGIONAL_DIRECTOR: GET payment-methods.
3. As EXECUTIVE: GET (financials_view) and POST (financials_manage).
4. As FINANCE: GET and POST.
testCases.expectedResult: SALES_BD_REP/TM/RD are denied GET (no customer.financials_view) and POST (no customer.financials_manage) with 403. EXECUTIVE can GET (financials_view) but POST is 403 (no manage). FINANCE (and SUPER_ADMIN) can both GET and POST. Default-deny holds.

testCases.title: Approving a reviewed voice note writes account activity and optional follow-up; rejection writes nothing
testCases.preconditions: A pending mobile voice note targets an account. Authenticated as a back-office reviewer role.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the Field Activity Review queue.
2. Open a pending note, edit summary/sentiment/tags/follow-up.
3. Approve one note (optionally create a follow-up).
4. Reject a second note.
5. Inspect the target account activity.
testCases.testData: Pending note A (approve + follow-up), pending note B (reject)
testCases.expectedResult: Approval writes a structured activity entry to the target account and optionally creates a governed follow-up; rejection discards the note with nothing written to the account; queue reflects updated review statuses. NOTE: UX-A-007 (queue not linked from account detail) remains open.

testCases.title: Readiness checklist separates ready / needs-attention / parked items and drives follow-up membership
testCases.preconditions: Account missing a contact and territory; Acumatica/payment-vault dependencies parked. Authenticated as customer.view role in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/accounts/{id} and inspect readiness summary.
2. Cross-check the follow-up queue.
testCases.testData: Account with no contacts, no territory
testCases.expectedResult: Readiness checks show statuses ready/needs_attention/parked; Pulse-owned gaps (contact, territory) are needs_attention while Acumatica/vault items are parked; the needs-attention items cause the account to appear in the Needs-follow-up queue.

testCases.title: Activity timeline aggregates profile/contact/location/payment/lifecycle/lead events, append-only and immutable
testCases.preconditions: Account has had profile edits, a contact change, a location change, a payment method change and a lifecycle transition. Authenticated as customer.view role in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/accounts/{id} and inspect activityReview.recentEvents.
2. Attempt to mutate a past timeline entry.
testCases.expectedResult: Timeline lists entity type, action, actor and timestamp for each event; lifecycle transitions show the reason note when present; the timeline is append-only and immutable (no edit/delete of prior entries).

testCases.title: Territory Manager sees and edits only accounts in their own book; out-of-scope account reads as not found
testCases.preconditions: TM user-tm1 owns Account A (assignedTmUserId=user-tm1). Account Z is owned by another TM and not in user-tm1's territory. Authenticated as TERRITORY_MANAGER user-tm1.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/accounts (list) — confirm Z absent.
2. GET /api/v1/accounts/{Z-id} (direct IDOR attempt).
3. PATCH /api/v1/accounts/{Z-id}.
4. POST contact/location on Account Z.
testCases.testData: user-tm1; Account A (in book), Account Z (out of book)
testCases.expectedResult: List returns only in-book accounts (A present, Z absent); direct GET of Z returns 404 Not Found (not 403, so the id cannot be probed); PATCH and child-resource POST on Z return 404 'Account not found' via assertAccountMutationInScope. RD is scoped to its region analogously.

testCases.title: Executive has read-only access; Finance cannot edit profile; default-deny for unauthorized roles
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Tokens for EXECUTIVE, FINANCE, DEALER_PORTAL_USER, TRAINING_OPS, REGIONAL_DIRECTOR available.
testCases.steps:
1. As EXECUTIVE: GET account (view) then PATCH account (edit).
2. As FINANCE: PATCH account profile.
3. As REGIONAL_DIRECTOR: PATCH account; POST contact.
4. As DEALER_PORTAL_USER / TRAINING_OPS: GET account.
testCases.expectedResult: EXECUTIVE can GET but PATCH returns 403 (no customer.edit); FINANCE PATCH profile returns 403 (no customer.edit); REGIONAL_DIRECTOR has customer.view only — PATCH/contact.create return 403; DEALER_PORTAL_USER and TRAINING_OPS lack the customers module/customer.view and are denied (403). Default-deny enforced for any role missing the required action.

testCases.title: Unauthenticated and malformed-token requests to account endpoints are rejected
testCases.preconditions: Account endpoints deployed.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/accounts with no Authorization header.
2. GET /api/v1/accounts/{id} with an expired/garbage token.
3. POST /api/v1/accounts unauthenticated.
testCases.expectedResult: All return 401 Unauthorized; no account data is returned and no mutation occurs.

testCases.title: Operations on a non-existent account id and unsupported HTTP methods return correct errors
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as a global-visibility role (e.g. SUPER_ADMIN).
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/accounts/non-existent-id.
2. PATCH /api/v1/accounts/non-existent-id.
3. DELETE /api/v1/accounts/{valid-id} (unsupported method).
4. PUT /api/v1/accounts/{id}/lifecycle.
testCases.expectedResult: GET non-existent returns 404; PATCH non-existent returns 404 'Account not found'; DELETE and PUT return 405 Method Not Allowed with an Allow header listing supported methods.

testCases.title: Very long, unicode, and whitespace-padded field values are handled on profile/contact/location
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Authenticated as in-scope editor role.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH account displayName with a 5,000-character string.
2. Create a contact with unicode name 'José Müller' and surrounding whitespace.
3. Create a location name with emoji/unicode.
testCases.expectedResult: Leading/trailing whitespace is trimmed on persisted values; unicode is preserved correctly (no mojibake); over-length input is either accepted intact or rejected with a clear length error consistently (document the actual column limit behaviour) — no truncation that corrupts data and no 500 error.

testCases.title: Malformed email and phone values on contacts (format validation gap)
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Authenticated as contact.create role in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. POST contact with email='not-an-email' and phone='abc-not-a-number'.
2. GET the contact.
testCases.expectedResult: EXPECTED (target): malformed email/phone are rejected with a format validation error. ACTUAL: the service only trims and lowercases email and trims phone with no format check — 'not-an-email' is stored as-is. Mark format validation as Not-built and record the gap.

testCases.title: Concurrent set-primary requests do not leave two primaries or zero primaries
testCases.preconditions: Account with contacts C1(primary), C2, C3 active. Authenticated as in-scope editor role.
testCases.steps:
1. Fire two near-simultaneous PATCH requests: C2 isPrimary=true and C3 isPrimary=true.
2. After both settle, GET contacts.
3. Repeat the analogous race for locations.
testCases.testData: Parallel PATCH C2 and C3 to primary
testCases.expectedResult: After the race exactly one contact is primary (the transactional demote-then-set keeps the single-primary invariant); no state with two primaries or zero active primaries. Same invariant holds for locations and for the single-default payment method.

testCases.title: Acumatica customer ID, sync status badge and manual re-sync are parked behind the integration boundary
testCases.preconditions: Acumatica integration boundary is NOT yet certified. acumaticaStatus field exists in schema. Authenticated as customer.view role.
testCases.steps:
1. Open an account workspace.
2. Inspect the Acumatica/financial area.
3. Attempt a manual re-sync action.
testCases.expectedResult: No live customer-ID write/sync occurs; financial/order/pricing context is shown as visibly parked (placeholder per UX-A-009) and read-only; re-sync action is unavailable/disabled. Test remains parked until Acumatica endpoints and field mappings are certified.

testCases.title: Month-over-month sales-trend view depends on Acumatica order history and is parked
testCases.preconditions: Acumatica order-history signal not live. Authenticated as customer.view role.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the account Sales/trend area.
2. Attempt to filter by 6/12/24/36 months / lifetime.
testCases.expectedResult: Sales-trend charting is not available (parked placeholder); no fabricated financials are shown. Resumes when Acumatica order history is live.

testCases.title: Column-mapped CSV import of affinity member lists with dedup and result counts
testCases.preconditions: Import capability would accept a CSV/Excel of buying-group members. Authenticated as an authorized import role.
testCases.steps:
1. Upload a member-list CSV.
2. Map columns (company name, email, phone, address, member ID) to fields.
3. Run import and review created/updated/skipped counts.
testCases.testData: CSV with 20 rows, 3 duplicates of existing accounts/leads
testCases.expectedResult: EXPECTED: import maps columns, dedups against existing accounts/leads on email or account name, and reports created/updated/skipped counts. ACTUAL: feature is Not-built (P2) — verify the import UI/endpoint is absent and the requirement is tracked for a later phase.

testCases.title: Profile PATCH with no changed fields is a no-op and a real change writes a before/after audit entry
testCases.preconditions: Account exists. Authenticated as in-scope editor role.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/accounts/{id} with an empty body {}.
2. PATCH with a single changed field (accountType).
3. Inspect the audit log after each.
testCases.expectedResult: Empty/no-effective-change PATCH returns 200 with the unchanged account and writes NO audit entry; the real change persists and writes one UPDATE audit entry capturing before and after state (actor, timestamp).

testCases.title: Issue a unique tokenized CIS link from a discovery-complete lead
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP; a lead owned/visible to the actor in stage DISCOVERY_COMPLETED with no prior CIS package.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/leads/{leadId}/cis/send-link with body {recipientEmail, note}.
2. Inspect the response and the persisted CisPackage.
3. Capture the returned publicUrl token.
testCases.testData: leadId=lead-discovery-complete; recipientEmail=owner@acme.test; note="Sent after discovery call"
testCases.expectedResult: 200; a new CisPackage is created with status link_sent, externalLinkSentCount=1, externalLinkExpiresAt ~30 days out; response includes publicUrl with a cryptographically unique token (>=128 bits entropy), expiresAt, deliveryMode=manual_copy; a link_sent CisPackageEvent and CREATE audit entry are written.

testCases.title: Reject CIS link issuance when discovery is not complete (server-side gate)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP; a visible lead in a pre-discovery stage (e.g. NEW or DISCOVERY_CALL_SCHEDULED).
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/leads/{leadId}/cis/send-link.
2. Observe response status and message.
3. Confirm no CisPackage was created and lead stage is unchanged.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 Bad Request with message 'CIS cannot be issued until discovery is completed for this lead'; no CisPackage, no event, no lead-stage advance. Gate is enforced server-side (CIS_SENDABLE_LEAD_STAGES) and cannot be bypassed by direct API call.

testCases.title: Resend creates a fresh token, new expiry, and invalidates the prior active token
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP; a lead with an existing DIGITAL_LINK package in link_sent/draft_in_progress (active editable) state; capture the original token T1.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/public/cis/{T1} and confirm it resolves.
2. POST /api/v1/leads/{leadId}/cis/resend-link.
3. Capture new token T2; GET /api/v1/public/cis/{T1} again; GET /api/v1/public/cis/{T2}.
testCases.expectedResult: Resend reuses the same package, sets a new externalLinkTokenHash + new expiry, increments externalLinkSentCount; T2 resolves; the old token T1 now returns 404 'CIS link not found or expired'; a link_resent event is logged with actor and timestamp.

testCases.title: Expired public CIS link is rejected within the request cycle
testCases.preconditions: A CisPackage whose externalLinkExpiresAt is set to a past timestamp (older than 30 days / manually expired).
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/public/cis/{expiredToken}.
2. POST /api/v1/public/cis/{expiredToken}/save-draft.
3. POST /api/v1/public/cis/{expiredToken}/submit.
testCases.expectedResult: All three return 404 'CIS link not found or expired'; no caching of valid-token state past expiry; expiry is evaluated server-side on every request (single request-response cycle).

testCases.title: Send count and last-sent timestamp increment on each (re)send
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP; a lead with an active editable DIGITAL_LINK package, externalLinkSentCount=1.
testCases.steps:
1. POST resend-link twice.
2. GET /api/v1/leads/{leadId}/cis and read the package summary.
testCases.expectedResult: externalLinkSentCount=3, externalLinkLastSentAt updated to the latest send time on each resend; package summary exposes send count and last-sent. (Note: link-expiry-date display in LeadCisPanel is an open UI gap — UX-CIS-004.)

testCases.title: send-link / resend-link reject non-POST methods
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP; a discovery-complete lead.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/leads/{leadId}/cis/send-link.
2. DELETE /api/v1/leads/{leadId}/cis/resend-link.
testCases.expectedResult: 405 Method Not Allowed with Allow: POST for both; no state change.

testCases.title: Territory Manager cannot access the CIS module (default-deny at module gate)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated TERRITORY_MANAGER (role lacks 'cis' module and lead.intake_manage).
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/leads/{leadId}/cis/send-link on a lead in the TM's book.
2. GET /api/v1/leads/{leadId}/cis.
testCases.expectedResult: 403 Forbidden on both — assertModuleAccess('cis') / assertActionAccess fail before any record logic. TM/RD/DEALER_PORTAL_USER are not granted the cis module, so all CIS endpoints are denied by default.

testCases.title: Sales/BD Rep cannot record a finance decision
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP (has cis + lead.intake_manage but NOT lead.finance_decide); a package in finance_pending.
testCases.steps: 1. POST /api/v1/cis/{cisPackageId}/finance-decision with decision=approved.
testCases.expectedResult: 403 Forbidden (assertActionAccess 'lead.finance_decide' denies). Only FINANCE and SUPER_ADMIN may record a finance decision; no decision is written.

testCases.title: Finance role cannot perform Sales/BD sign-off or submit-to-finance
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated FINANCE (has finance_decide/finance_queue_view but NOT lead.intake_manage); a package in submitted state.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/cis/{cisPackageId}/review-signoff.
2. POST /api/v1/cis/{cisPackageId}/submit-to-finance.
testCases.expectedResult: 403 Forbidden on both — sign-off and submit-to-finance require lead.intake_manage, which FINANCE does not hold. Separation of duties between Sales/BD intake and Finance decisioning is enforced server-side.

testCases.title: Payment and AP fields are masked for non-finance roles, returned for finance
testCases.preconditions: A submitted package with paymentMethod, cardOnFileAuthorized, apContactName, apDirectPhone, apEmail populated.
testCases.steps:
1. As SALES_BD_REP, GET /api/v1/cis/{cisPackageId}; inspect formData.
2. As FINANCE, GET the same package; inspect formData.
testCases.expectedResult: For SALES_BD_REP the response omits apContactName, apDirectPhone, apEmail, paymentMethod, achAuthorized, cardOnFileAuthorized (maskCisFormFinancialFields strips them server-side). For FINANCE (customer.financials_view) all fields are present. Masking is server-side, not client-only.

testCases.title: Unauthenticated request to internal CIS routes is rejected
testCases.preconditions: No valid session/bearer token.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/leads/{leadId}/cis/send-link with no auth header.
2. GET /api/v1/cis/finance-queue with no auth header.
testCases.expectedResult: 401 Unauthorized on both; no business logic executes. Authentication is required on every internal/finance route (requireAuthenticatedActor).

testCases.title: IDOR: in-scope role cannot act on a CIS package outside its lead visibility
testCases.preconditions: Two SALES_BD_REP-equivalent record-scoped contexts are not applicable to global Sales; use a record-scoped actor whose lead scope excludes the target. Target cisPackageId belongs to a lead outside the actor's resolveLeadRecordScope.
testCases.steps:
1. As the scoped actor, POST /api/v1/cis/{otherCisPackageId}/review-signoff.
2. POST /api/v1/cis/{otherCisPackageId}/submit-to-finance.
3. GET /api/v1/leads/{otherLeadId}/cis.
testCases.expectedResult: All scoped mutations resolve out-of-scope records as not-found (buildScopedCisPackageWhere applies the lead scope), returning 404 'CIS package not found' rather than acting on the record — no information disclosure, no cross-book write.

testCases.title: Prospect retrieves the public CIS package via valid token
testCases.preconditions: A CisPackage in link_sent state with a valid, unexpired token.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/public/cis/{token}.
2. Inspect the returned public package.
testCases.expectedResult: 200; returns leadCompanyName, leadContactDisplayName, status, entryMethod, externalLinkExpiresAt, paymentStatus, esignStatus, cardOnFileRequired=true, and prefilled formData (from lead). No internal/finance-only fields are exposed on the public surface.

testCases.title: Save-draft persists partial data and is reloadable via the same link
testCases.preconditions: A CisPackage in link_sent/draft_in_progress (active editable) state with a valid token.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/public/cis/{token}/save-draft with partial formData.
2. GET /api/v1/public/cis/{token} and confirm saved values.
testCases.expectedResult: 200; partial fields persist and reload through the same link; package remains editable; lastSavedAt is updated. (Note: 'progress saved' banner + return-link UI is an open gap — UX-CIS-003 / FR-CIS-011.)

testCases.title: Submit a complete CIS locks the package and records signature metadata
testCases.preconditions: A CisPackage in active editable state with a valid token; all required fields available to submit.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/public/cis/{token}/submit with a complete formData incl. signature + cardOnFileAuthorized=true.
2. GET /api/v1/public/cis/{token} again.
testCases.testData: formData={primaryContactName, primaryContactEmail:"jane@acme.test", primaryContactCellPhone:"+15125550100", legalCompanyName, physicalAddress, physicalCity, physicalState:"TX", physicalZip:"78701", companyPhone, typeOfBusiness:"HVAC", paymentMethod:"NET_30", cardOnFileAuthorized:true, signatureCapturedAt:set}
testCases.expectedResult: 200; status -> submitted, submittedAt + esignStatus SIGNED set, signatureCapturedAt defaulted to now if absent, submittedByProspectAt set, lead.cisSubmittedAt set; a 'submitted' event (actorType prospect) and UPDATE audit entry written. Subsequent save-draft/submit on the same token return 'CIS package can no longer be edited/submitted'.

testCases.title: Re-submitting an already-submitted (locked) package is rejected
testCases.preconditions: A CisPackage already in submitted (or later) state with a token that is no longer in ACTIVE_EDITABLE_CIS_STATUSES.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/public/cis/{token}/submit.
2. POST /api/v1/public/cis/{token}/save-draft.
testCases.expectedResult: Submit returns 'CIS package can no longer be submitted'; save-draft returns 'CIS package can no longer be edited'. Lock is enforced server-side; prospect edits after submit require a new/reissued link.

testCases.title: Submit rejected when required fields are missing
testCases.preconditions: A CisPackage in active editable state with a valid token.
testCases.steps: 1. POST submit with formData missing legalCompanyName (and/or primaryContactCellPhone, physicalState, companyPhone, typeOfBusiness).
testCases.expectedResult: 400 with message '<field> is required' (e.g. 'legalCompanyName is required'). Required set enforced server-side: primaryContactName, primaryContactEmail, primaryContactCellPhone, legalCompanyName, physicalAddress, physicalCity, physicalState, physicalZip, companyPhone, typeOfBusiness, plus paymentMethod, cardOnFileAuthorized, signature. No section can be skipped.

testCases.title: Submit rejected for invalid email format on any contact field
testCases.preconditions: A CisPackage in active editable state; all required fields present except a malformed email.
testCases.steps:
1. POST submit with primaryContactEmail='jane[at]acme'.
2. Repeat with a valid primaryContactEmail but apEmail='notanemail'.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'primaryContactEmail must be a valid email' (and similarly for ownerManagerEmail / orderingContactEmail / apEmail). Email format validated with regex on all four contact emails.

testCases.title: Submit rejected when authorization signature is missing
testCases.preconditions: A CisPackage in active editable state; all required fields present, cardOnFileAuthorized=true, but no signatureCapturedAt and no checkbox-driven signature.
testCases.steps: 1. POST submit with hasSignature=false / signatureCapturedAt unset.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'Signature is required'. Section 2 authorization acknowledgement is mandatory before the package can lock and move into review.

testCases.title: Submit rejected when card-on-file acknowledgement is not true
testCases.preconditions: A CisPackage in active editable state; all required fields present and signature set, but cardOnFileAuthorized=false.
testCases.steps: 1. POST submit with cardOnFileAuthorized=false.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'cardOnFileAuthorized is required'. (Reflects current built behaviour — note 2026-04-20 scope signal to eliminate/defer the card-on-file requirement is pending PM confirmation; if retracted this assertion changes.)

testCases.title: monthsInBusiness boundary (0-11) and numOfTechs non-negative enforced
testCases.preconditions: A CisPackage in active editable state; otherwise-valid complete form.
testCases.steps:
1. Submit with monthsInBusiness=12.
2. Submit with monthsInBusiness=-1.
3. Submit with numOfTechs=-5.
4. Submit with monthsInBusiness=0 and numOfTechs=0 (valid boundary).
testCases.expectedResult: Steps 1-2 -> 400 'monthsInBusiness must be between 0 and 11'; step 3 -> 400 'numOfTechs must be zero or greater'; step 4 succeeds (0 is a valid lower boundary for both).

testCases.title: US state and territory picker accepts all 50 states plus AS, GU, MP, PR, VI
testCases.preconditions: Public CIS form (CisPublicForm) loaded for a valid token.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the physical and billing state pickers.
2. Verify the option list.
3. Submit a draft with physicalState=PR and billingState=GU.
testCases.expectedResult: Picker offers all 50 states plus the five recognized US territories AS, GU, MP, PR, VI (per BR-CIS-09 / UX-CIS-001 Done); territory codes persist and round-trip correctly.

testCases.title: Free-text fields containing a raw card number are rejected (Luhn-detected)
testCases.preconditions: Any CIS write path that accepts free text (e.g. issue-link note, review notes, decision notes, or a form field).
testCases.steps:
1. POST send-link with note containing a valid-format card number '4111 1111 1111 1111'.
2. POST submit with a form field carrying a raw 16-digit card number.
3. POST finance-decision with decisionNotes containing a card number.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 PCI-rejection error (assertNoRawPaymentCardData / assertNoRawPaymentCardDataInRecord) for each path; the Luhn + brand-prefix detector blocks the write. Raw card/CVV/ACH numbers are never persisted to any Pulse table, log, or audit record.

testCases.title: Unicode and special characters in text fields are preserved on save and submit
testCases.preconditions: A CisPackage in active editable state with a valid token.
testCases.steps:
1. Save-draft with legalCompanyName='Café Niño & Sons — HVAC™ 株式会社' and typeOfBusiness with emoji.
2. GET the package and submit; re-read.
testCases.testData: legalCompanyName="Café Niño & Sons — HVAC™ 株式会社"
testCases.expectedResult: Unicode/diacritic/CJK/special characters are stored and returned intact (no mojibake, no truncation, no injection side-effects); values survive the save-draft -> submit round-trip.

testCases.title: Sales/BD review and sign-off advances package to sales_signed_off and lead to cis_signed
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP; an in-scope package in submitted state.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/cis/{cisPackageId}/review-signoff with salesReviewNotes + financeCoverNotes.
2. GET the package and the lead.
testCases.testData: salesReviewNotes="Complete, ready for credit"; financeCoverNotes="Requesting 10k line"
testCases.expectedResult: 200; package status -> sales_signed_off, salesSignedOffAt + internalReview (notes, sign-off actor) persisted; lead stage advances to cis_signed; a sign-off event + audit entry recorded with actor and timestamp. Lead stage never advances to cis_signed on prospect submission alone (BR-CIS-05).

testCases.title: Sign-off rejected when package is in a non-reviewable state
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP; an in-scope package in link_sent (not yet submitted) state.
testCases.steps: 1. POST /api/v1/cis/{cisPackageId}/review-signoff.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'CIS package is not ready for Sales/BD sign-off'. Sign-off is only permitted from submitted, review_in_progress, or sales_signed_off states; no state can be skipped.

testCases.title: Submit-to-finance moves a signed-off package to finance_pending
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP; an in-scope package in sales_signed_off state with cardOnFileAuthorized=true on formData.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/cis/{cisPackageId}/submit-to-finance with submissionNotes.
2. GET the package.
testCases.expectedResult: 200; status -> finance_pending; financeSubmittedAt set; financeDecision upserted with status PENDING and submittedBy actor; a finance_submitted event + audit entry written. Package now appears in the finance queue.

testCases.title: Submit-to-finance rejected when package is not yet signed off
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP; an in-scope package in submitted (not signed-off) state.
testCases.steps: 1. POST /api/v1/cis/{cisPackageId}/submit-to-finance.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'CIS package must be Sales/BD signed off before finance submission'. Only sales_signed_off (or already finance_pending) packages may be submitted, enforcing BR-CIS-06.

testCases.title: Submit-to-finance rejected when card-on-file authorization is absent
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP; an in-scope package in sales_signed_off state whose formData.cardOnFileAuthorized is false/absent.
testCases.steps: 1. POST /api/v1/cis/{cisPackageId}/submit-to-finance.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'Card-on-file authorization is required before finance submission'. (Current built behaviour; subject to the 2026-04-20 card-on-file scope signal pending PM confirmation.)

testCases.title: Finance queue returns packages and defaults/filters by decision status
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated FINANCE; packages exist across sales_signed_off, finance_pending, finance_approved, finance_declined.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/cis/finance-queue (no filter).
2. GET /api/v1/cis/finance-queue?decisionStatus=pending.
3. GET /api/v1/cis/finance-queue?decisionStatus=approved.
testCases.testData: decisionStatus ∈ {pending, approved, awaiting_submission, info_requested, conditional, declined}
testCases.expectedResult: 200; unfiltered returns all queue-eligible statuses; pending returns only finance_pending with PENDING decision; approved returns finance_approved; each item shows company name, stage, finance decision status badge, and submission date; list returns within the 2s/500-package target.

testCases.title: SALES_BD_LEADERSHIP can view the finance queue (read) but queue masks finance detail per role
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_LEADERSHIP (has lead.finance_queue_view but NOT customer.financials_view).
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/cis/finance-queue.
2. Inspect each item for finance-only fields (credit line, payment terms).
testCases.expectedResult: 200 list returned (queue_view granted), but finance-sensitive fields are masked by maskFinanceQueueItem because the role lacks customer.financials_view. SALES_BD_REP (no queue_view) and TM/RD/DEALER get 403.

testCases.title: Approve with credit line and payment terms records an immutable approval
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated FINANCE; an in-scope package in finance_pending with cardOnFileAuthorized=true and paymentMethod=NET_30.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/cis/{cisPackageId}/finance-decision with decision=approved, creditLineAmount, paymentTerms.
2. GET the package.
testCases.expectedResult: 200; status -> finance_approved, financeDecidedAt set; financeDecision stores creditLineAmountCents=1000000 (dollars*100), paymentTerms NET_30, decidedBy actor, decidedAt; a finance_approved event + APPROVE audit entry written immutably with actor/outcome/terms/timestamp.

testCases.title: Approval rejected when credit line / payment terms missing for non-card terms (server-side)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated FINANCE; an in-scope package in finance_pending, cardOnFileAuthorized=true, paymentMethod=NET_30 (non-card).
testCases.steps:
1. POST finance-decision decision=approved with no creditLineAmount.
2. POST finance-decision decision=approved with creditLineAmount set but no paymentTerms.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'creditLineAmount is required when approving non-card payment terms' then 'paymentTerms is required when approving non-card payment terms'. NOTE: the PRD marks FR-CIS-019/UX-CIS-006 'Partial — required validation not enforced', but the API service DOES enforce it; the gap is UI-only. Document as built at API layer.

testCases.title: Credit line amount must be greater than zero
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated FINANCE; an in-scope package in finance_pending, non-card terms.
testCases.steps:
1. POST finance-decision approved with creditLineAmount=0.
2. POST with creditLineAmount=-100.
3. POST with creditLineAmount=0.009 (rounds below a cent) / NaN / Infinity.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'creditLineAmount must be greater than zero' for 0, negative, NaN, and non-finite values (normalizeCreditLineAmount). Valid positive amounts are stored as integer cents.

testCases.title: Conditional / info-requested require decision or requested-info notes
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated FINANCE; an in-scope package in finance_pending.
testCases.steps:
1. POST finance-decision decision=conditional with no decisionNotes and no requestedInfoNotes.
2. POST decision=info_requested with empty notes.
3. POST decision=conditional with requestedInfoNotes set.
testCases.testData: decision ∈ {conditional, info_requested}; notes empty then populated
testCases.expectedResult: Steps 1-2 -> 400 'decisionNotes or requestedInfoNotes is required for conditional or info-requested outcomes'; step 3 succeeds. Conditional/info_requested keep package status finance_pending (non-terminal) with decision status CONDITIONAL/INFO_REQUESTED. (API enforces this; PRD UX-CIS-005 'open' refers to the UI only.)

testCases.title: Decline requires decision notes and records an immutable rejection
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated FINANCE; an in-scope package in finance_pending.
testCases.steps:
1. POST finance-decision decision=declined with no decisionNotes.
2. POST decision=declined with decisionNotes set.
3. GET the package.
testCases.expectedResult: Step 1 -> 400 'decisionNotes is required when declining finance'; step 2 -> 200, status finance_declined, financeDecidedAt set, REJECT audit entry + finance_declined event written immutably with notes.

testCases.title: Approval blocked when card-on-file authorization is missing
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated FINANCE; an in-scope package in finance_pending whose formData.cardOnFileAuthorized is false/absent.
testCases.steps: 1. POST finance-decision decision=approved with creditLineAmount + paymentTerms.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'Card-on-file authorization is required before approving finance'. (Current built behaviour; tied to the card-on-file scope signal pending PM confirmation.)

testCases.title: Finance decision rejected when package is not in a finance-review state
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated FINANCE; an in-scope package in sales_signed_off (not yet submitted to finance) or submitted.
testCases.steps: 1. POST /api/v1/cis/{cisPackageId}/finance-decision decision=approved.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'CIS package is not in a finance-review state'. Decisions are only accepted from finance_pending/finance_approved/finance_declined; lifecycle states cannot be skipped.

testCases.title: Custom payment terms accepted and persisted as CUSTOM
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated FINANCE; an in-scope package in finance_pending, non-card terms.
testCases.steps:
1. POST finance-decision approved with paymentTerms=CUSTOM and creditLineAmount.
2. GET the package.
testCases.expectedResult: 200; paymentTerms persisted as CUSTOM. NOTE: BR-CIS-12 requires custom terms to carry a documented justification — verify whether a justification field is captured/required; if not enforced, log as a gap against BR-CIS-12 (PRD does not list a built justification field).

testCases.title: Register a scanned CIS creates a separate parsed-draft for review
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP/ADMIN_CSR_OPS; an in-scope lead (with or without an existing package).
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/leads/{leadId}/cis/upload-scan with fileName, mimeType, optional safeFieldPayload.
2. GET /api/v1/cis/{cisPackageId}/parsed-drafts.
testCases.expectedResult: 200; entryMethod -> SCANNED_PDF, package moved to review_in_progress; a CisDocument + a CisParsedDraft (parseStatus NEEDS_REVIEW) are created separate from the canonical formData; draft is listable for human review. Non-payment fields are never auto-applied at upload.

testCases.title: Upload-scan rejected when fileName is missing
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP; an in-scope lead.
testCases.steps: 1. POST upload-scan with an empty/whitespace fileName.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'fileName is required' (requireTrimmed). mimeType defaults to application/pdf when omitted; storageKey/parserVersion default if absent.

testCases.title: Payment fields in a scanned draft are detected, flagged, and stripped before storage
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP; an in-scope lead.
testCases.steps:
1. POST upload-scan with safeFieldPayload that includes paymentMethod / achAuthorized / cardOnFileAuthorized.
2. GET the parsed-draft and inspect the persisted safeFieldPayload + paymentFieldsDetected.
testCases.expectedResult: paymentFieldsDetected=true is set; the persisted safeFieldPayload has paymentMethod/achAuthorized/cardOnFileAuthorized stripped (normalizeSafeFieldPayload -> stripPaymentFieldsFromDraftInput) so payment-sensitive content never enters the review surface or canonical data.

testCases.title: Apply parsed draft writes only reviewed non-payment fields into canonical CIS
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP/ADMIN_CSR_OPS; an in-scope package with a NEEDS_REVIEW parsed draft carrying safe fields.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/cis/{cisPackageId}/parsed-drafts/{draftId}/apply.
2. GET the package and confirm canonical formData merged the safe fields only; no payment fields present.
testCases.expectedResult: 200; reviewed non-payment fields merged into canonical formData; draft parseStatus -> PARSED; a parsed_draft_applied event + UPDATE audit entry (with appliedFieldCount) written; payment fields are excluded from the apply even if a future code path attempts to include them (NFR-CIS-08).

testCases.title: Apply rejected when draft has no safe fields, or draft/package not found
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP; an in-scope package; a parsed draft whose safeFieldPayload is empty (only payment fields were present, now stripped).
testCases.steps:
1. POST apply on a draft with empty safeFieldPayload.
2. POST apply with a non-existent draftId.
3. POST apply with a non-existent cisPackageId.
testCases.expectedResult: Step 1 -> 400 'This parsed draft does not contain any safe fields to apply'; step 2 -> 404 'CIS parsed draft not found'; step 3 -> 404 'CIS package not found'. Out-of-scope packages also read as not-found.

testCases.title: Oversized parsed-draft payloads are bounded/rejected
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP; an in-scope lead.
testCases.steps: 1. POST upload-scan with rawStructuredPayload / fieldConfidenceMap / safeFieldPayload exceeding the configured JSON size limits.
testCases.expectedResult: The bounded-JSON guard (toBoundedJsonValue with JSON_SIZE_LIMITS for cisParsedStructuredPayloadBytes / cisParsedConfidenceMapBytes / cisParsedSafePayloadBytes) rejects payloads over the limit with a clear size error; no oversized blob is persisted.

testCases.title: Full lifecycle emits an immutable, append-only event/audit trail with no state skipping
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated actors across roles; a discovery-complete in-scope lead.
testCases.steps:
1. Drive: send-link -> public save-draft -> public submit -> review-signoff -> submit-to-finance -> finance approve.
2. GET the package events and the audit log after each step.
3. Attempt to update/delete an existing audit/event record via API.
testCases.expectedResult: Package transitions not_sent/link_sent -> draft_in_progress -> submitted -> review_in_progress/sales_signed_off -> finance_pending -> finance_approved in order; lead interlock cis_sent on first send, cis_signed only after sign-off; each transition writes a CisPackageEvent + AuditEntry capturing entity, action, actor, timestamp, and prev/next state; audit records are append-only (no update/delete path exposed).

testCases.title: Prospect submission alone does not advance the lead stage to cis_signed
testCases.preconditions: A lead in cis_sent with a link_sent package; prospect completes and submits the public CIS.
testCases.steps:
1. POST public submit for the token.
2. GET the lead stage and the package status.
testCases.expectedResult: Package -> submitted and lead.cisSubmittedAt set, but lead stage remains cis_sent (NOT cis_signed). cis_signed is reached only after Sales/BD sign-off (BR-CIS-05).

testCases.title: Hosted payment capture is blocked at the policy layer (provider parked / capture dormant)
testCases.preconditions: Default payment integration policy (captureMode=manual_recording, allowCisCaptureTracking=false); Moneris stub present. DEPENDENCY: eBizCharge/Moneris hosted capture runtime not certified; card-on-file capture flagged eliminated/deferred per 2026-04-20 scope signal (pending PM confirmation).
testCases.steps:
1. Resolve getResolvedPaymentIntegrationPolicy.
2. Attempt to start a Moneris hosted capture / requestCisPaymentCapture against a finance_pending package.
testCases.expectedResult: Policy returns allowCisCaptureTracking=false; capture attempts are rejected with 'CIS payment capture tracking is currently disabled by admin policy' (and Moneris-specific guards). No card data path is reachable. Test exists but the capture/runtime is Parked (dormant scope per FR-CIS-029 / §6.6).

testCases.title: Only tokenized vault references plus authorization state are stored (no raw instrument)
testCases.preconditions: A finance-pending/approved in-scope package; recording a vault reference with provider token + masked display (DEPENDENCY: provider tokenization runtime parked — exercise with a mock tokenized result).
testCases.steps:
1. Attempt recordCisPaymentVaultReference with no vaultToken and no vaultCustomerRef.
2. Record with a valid provider token + masked display.
3. Inspect the persisted vault reference and audit entry.
testCases.expectedResult: Step 1 -> 400 'vaultToken or vaultCustomerRef is required'. Step 2 stores provider, token, masked display, created-at and authorization state only; raw card/bank data is never written. Full provider runtime path is Parked.

testCases.feature: Prospect Digital CIS Form — UI Copy
testCases.title: Card-on-file explanatory copy and progress-saved banner (open UI gaps)
testCases.preconditions: Public CIS form (CisPublicForm) loaded; payment section and draft-save flow exercised.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the payment section and look for the one-paragraph 'card on file required / capture pending' explanation.
2. Save a draft and look for a 'progress saved' banner with a return link.
testCases.expectedResult: Per PRD these are Not-built: FR-CIS-010/028 card-on-file copy (UX-CIS-002 open) and FR-CIS-011 progress-saved banner (UX-CIS-003 open). Test documents expected behaviour; currently the copy/banner are absent. Also reconcile against the 2026-04-20 signal to eliminate/defer card-on-file messaging.

testCases.title: Lead CIS panel stepper present; link-expiry display and turnaround KPIs are partial
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated SALES_BD_REP viewing a lead's CIS panel; finance queue page available.
testCases.steps:
1. Open LeadCisPanel and verify the 9-state badge stepper, send count, last-sent, finance status, payment method, card-on-file state.
2. Look for the link-expiry date display.
3. Open the finance queue page and look for turnaround KPIs (avg days link_sent->finance_pending, finance_pending->decision).
testCases.expectedResult: 9-state stepper renders (UX-CIS-009 Done); send count / last-sent / finance status / payment method / card-on-file shown. Link-expiry-date display is missing (UX-CIS-004 open). Finance-queue summary KPIs (FR-CIS-034) are not yet computed. Document as Partial per PRD.

testCases.title: Invalid, malformed, or empty public token is rejected as not-found
testCases.preconditions: No valid package for the supplied token.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/public/cis/{garbageToken}.
2. GET with a token containing path-traversal-like characters.
3. GET with a token of an already-revoked/reissued link.
testCases.expectedResult: 404 'CIS link not found or expired' in all cases; no stack trace or internal detail leaked; token is matched by hash so raw token guessing/traversal does not resolve a package.

testCases.title: Concurrent submit on the same token does not double-lock or corrupt state (TOCTOU)
testCases.preconditions: A CisPackage in active editable state with a valid token; ability to fire two near-simultaneous submit requests.
testCases.steps:
1. Fire two POST /api/v1/public/cis/{token}/submit requests concurrently with complete valid forms.
2. Inspect final package state and events.
testCases.expectedResult: Exactly one submit succeeds (status -> submitted, one 'submitted' event); the second is serialized by the transaction and rejected with 'CIS package can no longer be submitted'. No duplicate submission, no lost update, single esign/signature record.

testCases.title: App opens on Today home as default landing surface after login
testCases.preconditions: Field user (TM) with valid Pulse credentials; API reachable; tab navigation present (Today/Route/Consign/More).
testCases.steps:
1. Launch the app and sign in with valid Pulse credentials.
2. Observe the first rendered screen.
3. Background the app, then reopen it.
4. Navigate to another tab, then relaunch the app.
testCases.expectedResult: The Today tab is the first screen after login. On subsequent opens the app still lands on Today with no rerouting to map/calendar.

testCases.title: Today shows exactly one ranked Start here next-action card that deep-links into its flow
testCases.preconditions: TM has a mix of route, lead, ROSE, and phone-saved work available.
testCases.steps:
1. Open Today.
2. Locate the Start here next-action card.
3. Count how many Start here cards are visible.
4. Tap the card.
testCases.testData: Account with overdue ROSE audit + a priority lead + 1 phone-saved draft
testCases.expectedResult: Exactly one Start here card is shown per session, reflecting the highest-ranked next action; tapping navigates directly into the relevant flow (e.g. the due ROSE audit).

testCases.title: Today renders four-tile metric strip and independent nearby-accounts section
testCases.preconditions: TM signed in; Today loaded.
testCases.steps:
1. Open Today.
2. Inspect the metric strip tiles.
3. Inspect the nearby accounts and priority leads sections.
testCases.expectedResult: Four metric tiles are present (Open actions / SLA risk / ROSE / Accounts); priority leads and nearby accounts sections render and load independently of each other.

testCases.title: Single failing endpoint degrades only its section; live-CRM-data panel reports ready/partial/failed
testCases.preconditions: Ability to force one Today data endpoint to fail (e.g. leads endpoint 500) while others succeed.
testCases.steps:
1. Force the leads endpoint to return 500; leave others healthy.
2. Open Today.
3. Observe the live-CRM-data status panel and each section.
testCases.expectedResult: Only the leads section shows a failed/error state; metric strip, ROSE, and nearby accounts remain usable. The status panel reports the failed section as failed and others as ready, using canonical vocabulary.

testCases.title: Overdue ROSE / SLA breach badge derives from fetched data without a push provider
testCases.preconditions: TM has at least one overdue ROSE audit site in scope; no push provider configured.
testCases.steps:
1. Ensure at least one ROSE site is past its nextAuditDueAt.
2. Open Today.
3. Inspect the ROSE metric tile / overdue badge.
testCases.testData: Site with nextAuditDueAt in the past (overdue count = 1)
testCases.expectedResult: An overdue ROSE count badge appears on the Today metric strip showing the correct count (>0); no push notification dependency is required to compute it.

testCases.title: Day-agenda strip shows up to 5 calendar events and never blocks Today on failure
testCases.preconditions: TM has more than 5 calendar events today; calendar endpoint can be toggled to fail.
testCases.steps:
1. Seed 7 calendar events for today.
2. Open Today and inspect the agenda strip.
3. Force the calendar endpoint to fail and reopen Today.
testCases.testData: 7 events today; calendar API forced to timeout
testCases.expectedResult: Agenda strip shows at most 5 events. When the calendar endpoint fails, the rest of Today still renders (agenda is best-effort and never blanks the workspace).

testCases.title: Core queues reachable within 2 taps; lead inbox is not buried (1-tap shortcut on Today)
testCases.preconditions: TM signed in; tab bar visible.
testCases.steps:
1. Inspect bottom tab labels.
2. From Today, tap the Lead inbox shortcut.
3. From Today, reach Training/Accounts/Voice Notes via More.
testCases.expectedResult: Tab bar shows Today / Route / Consign / More. Lead inbox opens in 1 tap from Today; Training, Accounts, and Voice Notes are reachable within 2 taps via More. (Bottom-tab placement of Leads, Q-M-02, remains a product decision.)

testCases.title: Persistent header bell badges the phone-saved draft count on every screen
testCases.preconditions: TM has N unsynced phone-saved drafts.
testCases.steps:
1. Create 2 phone-saved drafts (e.g. by completing a visit while offline).
2. Inspect the header bell badge on Today, Route, Consignment, and More.
3. Tap the bell.
4. Retry/sync one draft and re-check the badge.
testCases.expectedResult: Bell is visible on every screen header and badges the unsynced count (2). Tapping opens the notifications center. After one draft syncs, the badge decrements to 1.

testCases.title: iPad/tablet form factor caps and centres the content column
testCases.preconditions: App run on an iPad (supportsTablet:true) or tablet-width viewport.
testCases.steps:
1. Launch the app on an iPad / tablet-width layout.
2. Open Today and a ListScreen (e.g. Accounts).
3. Observe content column width and centring.
testCases.expectedResult: Shared Screen/ListScreen cap and centre the content column on tablet width (per width hook). Note: pixel-level verification of landscape tab bar, hero gradients, and safe-area insets still requires a device/simulator pass.

testCases.title: Consignment tab loads due ROSE sites sorted by due date on open
testCases.preconditions: TM has multiple in-scope consignment sites with differing nextAuditDueAt values.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the Consignment tab.
2. Observe the ROSE site list ordering without a manual refresh.
3. Note sites with null due dates.
testCases.testData: Sites: A due yesterday, B due next week, C with no due date
testCases.expectedResult: Sites load automatically on open ordered by ascending nextAuditDueAt (A, B), with null-due sites sorted last (C). No manual refresh is needed.

testCases.title: Expected-count source classified parked vs stale vs fresh before counting begins
testCases.preconditions: Acumatica read integration NOT connected (source effectively parked/seeded).
testCases.steps:
1. Open a ROSE site whose expected-count source is parked.
2. Observe the site-card source pill and ROSE step-1 guidance.
3. (If a synced site exists) verify fresh vs stale labelling against the 24h threshold.
testCases.testData: Parked source site; (optional) site with acumaticaLastSyncedAt 30h ago
testCases.expectedResult: A 'Source parked' pill and verify-manually guidance appear before counting. A source synced within 24h shows 'Source live'; older than 24h or never-synced shows 'Source stale'. Durable stale signal is dependency-gated on Acumatica.

testCases.title: 5-step ROSE workflow gates each step; skipping ahead is blocked
testCases.preconditions: TM has opened a scheduled/in-progress ROSE audit for a site.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the ROSE audit (counts step).
2. Attempt to advance to evidence/attest before entering counts and a note.
3. Complete each gate in order: counts -> notes -> evidence -> attest -> submit.
testCases.testData: Audit with 3 ROSE lines and expected quantities
testCases.expectedResult: Each step requires its gate satisfied before advancing; the UI blocks skipping. Progressing in order reaches the Submit step only after all gates pass.

testCases.title: Per-line and total variance preview renders before submission
testCases.preconditions: ROSE audit open with expected quantities present on each line.
testCases.steps:
1. Enter actual counts that differ from expected on some lines.
2. Observe per-line variance and total variance preview.
testCases.testData: Line1 expected 10 actual 8; Line2 expected 5 actual 5; Line3 expected 4 actual 7
testCases.expectedResult: Per-line variance shows -2, 0, +3 and total variance shows +1 across 2 variance lines, displayed before submit. When expected is absent, summary states expected quantities are parked.

testCases.title: Variance requires at least one discrepancy-purpose photo before attest/submit
testCases.preconditions: ROSE audit open; counts produce a non-zero variance; no discrepancy photo attached.
testCases.steps:
1. Enter counts producing a variance.
2. Add only a general-purpose photo (no discrepancy photo).
3. Attempt to attest and submit.
4. Add a discrepancy-purpose photo and retry.
testCases.testData: Variance present; 1 general photo only, then +1 discrepancy photo
testCases.expectedResult: Submit is blocked until at least one discrepancy-purpose evidence photo is attached. After adding the discrepancy photo, submission is allowed.

testCases.title: Submit blocked until typed attestation name and attestation confirmation are both set
testCases.preconditions: ROSE audit with valid counts, note, and (if variance) discrepancy photo present.
testCases.steps:
1. Leave attestedByName blank and toggle isAttested on; attempt submit.
2. Enter attestedByName but leave isAttested unchecked; attempt submit.
3. Set both attestedByName and isAttested; submit.
testCases.testData: attestedByName='', then 'Jordan TM' with isAttested true/false
testCases.expectedResult: Submit is blocked unless both attestedByName (non-empty after trim) and isAttested are set. Only with both set does submission proceed.

testCases.title: Balanced count submits true_up_confirmed; variance submits open reconciliation
testCases.preconditions: ROSE audit open; CRM reachable.
testCases.steps:
1. Enter counts that exactly match expected on all lines; submit.
2. Inspect reconciliationStatus sent to CRM.
3. Repeat with a shortage/overage; submit and inspect.
testCases.testData: Balanced: actual=expected for all lines; Unbalanced: one line short by 2
testCases.expectedResult: Balanced submission sends reconciliationStatus 'true_up_confirmed'; a shortage or overage sends 'open' so PO/discrepancy follow-up stays visible in the back office.

testCases.title: Offline ROSE submit saves a durable phone draft with counts/notes/attestation/photo metadata and retries
testCases.preconditions: ROSE audit completed on screen; CRM unreachable (offline / API down).
testCases.steps:
1. Complete a ROSE audit (counts, notes, attestation, evidence) while offline.
2. Tap submit.
3. Force-close and reopen the app.
4. Open Sync Status, restore connectivity, and tap retry.
testCases.testData: Variance audit with 1 discrepancy photo while airplane mode on
testCases.expectedResult: Audit is saved as a phone draft (Saved on phone) including counts, notes, attestation, and photo metadata; the draft survives app restart. On retry with signal it uploads evidence + submits the full audit payload and moves to CRM saved.

testCases.title: ROSE evidence rejects non-image files, files over 4 MB, and more than 3 photos
testCases.preconditions: ROSE audit evidence step open.
testCases.steps:
1. Attempt to attach a non-image asset (e.g. a PDF/video).
2. Attach an image whose fileSize or decoded base64 exceeds 4,000,000 bytes.
3. Attach a 4th photo after 3 are already attached.
testCases.testData: video.mov; image 4.2 MB; then 4 photos total
testCases.expectedResult: Non-image rejected ('accepts photos only'); over-4MB image rejected ('under 4 MB'); 4th photo rejected ('capped at 3 photos'). The max-files cap is enforced before the picker opens.

testCases.title: Invalid line-count input (negative, decimal, non-numeric) blocks advance
testCases.preconditions: ROSE audit counts step open.
testCases.steps:
1. Enter '-1' as a count.
2. Enter '3.5'.
3. Enter 'abc' / leave blank.
4. Enter a valid non-negative integer.
testCases.expectedResult: Only non-negative safe integers are accepted (0 and 12 valid); negative, decimal, non-numeric, and blank values are invalid and block advancing past counts (areRoseLineCountsValid fails).

testCases.title: Opening a site with no scheduled/in-progress audit shows a clear error, not a blank flow
testCases.preconditions: Consignment site exists but has no audit in status scheduled or in_progress.
testCases.steps:
1. Open a site whose only audits are completed/cancelled.
2. Observe the audit area.
testCases.testData: Site with one completed audit only
testCases.expectedResult: An error message instructs the user that no scheduled/in-progress ROSE audit is available and to schedule a fresh audit in CRM; the count flow is not presented.

testCases.title: ROSE submit does not block on customer signature (signature optional)
testCases.preconditions: ROSE audit ready to submit; no customer signature captured.
testCases.steps:
1. Complete a ROSE audit without capturing any customer/dealer signature.
2. Submit.
testCases.testData: Audit with attestation but no customer signature
testCases.expectedResult: Submission succeeds (review-and-submit, not review-and-sign). Mandatory signatures apply only to the initial BLUE form, which is web/back-office and out of mobile scope.

testCases.title: ROSE lines display SKU/barcode for reference with no camera scan button (scanning parked)
testCases.preconditions: Product-mapping signoff NOT received; ROSE audit has lines carrying SKU/barcode.
testCases.steps:
1. Open a ROSE audit with SKU/barcode on lines.
2. Inspect each line for SKU/barcode display.
3. Look for any barcode-scan affordance.
testCases.expectedResult: SKU/barcode show as read-only reference text; no scan button is present. Barcode scanning is parked and not presented as available.

testCases.title: 5-step training flow gates steps and requires attendee count and completion notes
testCases.preconditions: TM has a scheduled training session in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. Open Training; verify scheduled/checked-in/overdue counts and status pills.
2. Check in -> details -> proof -> follow-up -> submit.
3. Attempt submit with attendeeCount 0 and blank notes.
4. Enter attendeeCount>=1 and a completion note; submit.
testCases.testData: attendeeCount 0 then 6; notes '' then 'Covered P-Max install'
testCases.expectedResult: Each step gates the next. Submit is blocked while attendeeCount<1 or notes are blank ('Enter at least 1 attendee' / 'Add a short completion note'); with both valid the session completes to CRM.

testCases.title: Proof photo upload failure forces proof notes; follow-up task requires title and detail or none
testCases.preconditions: Training completion step open.
testCases.steps:
1. Trigger a proof-photo upload failure, leave proof notes blank, attempt submit.
2. Add proof notes; attempt submit.
3. Enable a follow-up task with only a title (no detail); attempt submit.
4. Provide both follow-up title and detail or clear the task; submit.
testCases.testData: Proof upload forced to fail; follow-up title only
testCases.expectedResult: When proof upload failed and proof notes are blank, submit is blocked. An enabled follow-up requires both title and detail (or be cleared). Otherwise the session submits with the follow-up task created.

testCases.title: Training completion saved as durable phone draft on CRM failure and retried
testCases.preconditions: Training session completed on screen; CRM unreachable.
testCases.steps:
1. Complete a training session while offline.
2. Submit; observe Saved on phone confirmation.
3. Restart app; open Sync Status; retry with connectivity.
testCases.expectedResult: Completion persists as a training phone draft surviving restart; retry submits the complete session payload and the draft becomes CRM saved.

testCases.title: Already-completed session cannot be re-completed from mobile
testCases.preconditions: Session already completed in CRM (completedAt set or status completed).
testCases.steps:
1. Open a session already completed in CRM.
2. Attempt to run the completion flow.
testCases.expectedResult: The completion blocker reports 'This session is already completed in CRM' and submission is prevented (no duplicate completion).

testCases.title: Route stop list seeds by oldest last-touch (ascending lastEngagementAt)
testCases.preconditions: TM has multiple in-scope accounts with differing lastEngagementAt values.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the Route tab with an empty selection.
2. Observe the seeded stop order.
testCases.testData: Acct A last touch 90d ago; B 5d ago; C never engaged
testCases.expectedResult: Stops seed by oldest last-touch first (never-engaged ranked oldest), capped at the seed limit; fully editable thereafter. This is the interim ordering pending geographic optimization.

testCases.title: Start visit checks in immediately and captures GPS when permission granted
testCases.preconditions: TM signed in (userId present); location permission grantable; CRM reachable.
testCases.steps:
1. From a route stop, tap Check in.
2. Grant location permission when prompted.
3. Observe the active-visit card and CRM status.
testCases.testData: Account with valid id; location permission granted
testCases.expectedResult: A visit begins immediately on the phone (local), a CRM site-visit/session is created and checked in, the card shows 'GPS captured' with rounded lat/lng and 'CRM checked in'.

testCases.title: Visit is timed-only and does not block when location permission is denied
testCases.preconditions: TM signed in; location permission denied.
testCases.steps:
1. Deny location permission at the OS level.
2. Start a visit at a route stop.
3. Observe the visit card.
testCases.expectedResult: The visit still starts and checks in; the card shows 'Timed only' and a non-blocking location notice; no lat/lng is stored. Checkout/completion proceed normally without GPS.

testCases.title: Checkout requires notes and blocks new check-in until current visit is completed
testCases.preconditions: TM is checked in to a visit (active visit present).
testCases.steps:
1. With an active visit, leave checkout notes blank and attempt Complete visit.
2. Attempt to Check in at another stop while a visit is active.
3. Enter checkout notes and Complete the visit.
4. Then check in elsewhere.
testCases.testData: Checkout notes '' then 'Restocked shelf, owner out'
testCases.expectedResult: Complete is disabled while notes are blank. All other stops' Check-in actions are disabled while a visit is active. Only after completing (with notes) the current visit can the user check in elsewhere.

testCases.title: Completed visit syncs to CRM or saves a retryable route draft; completed-today list shown
testCases.preconditions: Active visit with notes; one run with CRM reachable, one run offline.
testCases.steps:
1. Complete a visit with CRM reachable; verify 'CRM saved'.
2. Complete another visit offline; verify Saved on phone draft.
3. Inspect the Completed today review list.
4. Restart app and confirm the offline draft persists for retry.
testCases.expectedResult: Online completion shows 'CRM saved' and clears the draft; offline completion persists a retryable route phone draft. Both appear in the Completed today list, and the offline draft survives restart.

testCases.title: Navigate handoff opens chosen provider (Apple/Google/Waze) for a located stop; in-app TBT not built
testCases.preconditions: Route stop with valid latitude/longitude.
testCases.steps:
1. Tap Navigate on a located stop.
2. Choose Waze, then Google, then Apple from the chooser.
3. Verify the deep link / https fallback for each.
4. Confirm the last provider is remembered.
