testCases.expectedResult: Waze opens waze://?ll=...&navigate=yes (https fallback https://waze.com/ul...), Google opens comgooglemaps://?daddr=...&directionsmode=driving (https maps dir fallback), Apple opens maps://?daddr=...&dirflg=d. Last provider is floated to the top next time. No in-app turn-by-turn is rendered.

testCases.title: Navigate is unavailable/gated for an unlocated (state-centroid) stop
testCases.preconditions: Route stop without coordinates or with state-centroid precision only.
testCases.steps:
1. Add a stop that has no lat/lng (or state-centroid only).
2. Inspect the Navigate action for that stop.
testCases.expectedResult: The Navigate action is not offered (canNavigate false) for an unlocated stop; navigation is blocked for state-centroid pins and city-level pins are flagged approximate. No invalid nav URL is produced (isValidTarget rejects non-finite coords).

testCases.title: Multi-stop route builder: select, optimize (nearest-neighbour), per-stop dwell 1-60, end-of-day ETA
testCases.preconditions: TM has several located accounts to add as stops.
testCases.steps:
1. Add 4 located stops to the route.
2. Tap Optimize order.
3. Cycle a stop's dwell time through its range.
4. Set a start time and read the end-of-day finish ETA.
testCases.expectedResult: Stops can be added/removed/reordered; Optimize re-orders located stops by nearest-neighbour (straight-line) with unlocated stops appended; dwell cycles within 1-60 min (wraps after max); finish ETA is computed (labelled 'est.'). Road/traffic TSP is parked.

testCases.title: Optimize requires >=2 located stops; loading a saved route drops stops not in loaded accounts
testCases.preconditions: Saved route exists referencing some accounts not currently loaded.
testCases.steps:
1. With fewer than 2 located stops, tap Optimize.
2. Save a named route, then re-save with the same name.
3. Load a saved route whose stops are partially outside the loaded account set.
testCases.testData: Route with 5 stop ids, 2 not loaded; duplicate save name
testCases.expectedResult: Optimize warns 'Add at least 2 located stops'. Re-saving the same name updates rather than duplicating. Loading filters to usable stops and reports how many were dropped; if none usable, the current route is kept with a message.

testCases.title: Colour-coded account pins with multi-select account-type filter; MMC colours preserved
testCases.preconditions: Accounts of varied statuses (active, inactive, onboarding, members, consignment, consignment-overdue, prospect) in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the Map tab.
2. Observe pin colours by account type.
3. Open the filter and multi-select two account types.
4. Verify only selected types remain.
testCases.expectedResult: Pins are colour-coded by status with existing Map My Customer colours preserved and consignment/consignment-overdue added as distinct (placeholder) colours; the multi-select filter narrows the map/list to chosen types. Final authoritative colour list and street-level geocoding are dependency-gated.

testCases.title: Account detail contacts support tap-to-call and tap-to-email; mailto header-injection rejected
testCases.preconditions: Account with contacts having phone, mobilePhone, and email values; one contact with a crafted email.
testCases.steps:
1. Open account detail; open the contacts list.
2. Tap-to-call a contact (verify phone preferred over mobile).
3. Tap-to-email a contact with a clean address.
4. Tap-to-email a contact whose email contains ?subject= or a comma/extra recipient.
testCases.expectedResult: tel: built from digits preserving leading + (tel:+19015550100), preferring phone over mobile. Clean email opens mailto:a@b.com. Crafted email with ?,&,#,;,<,>, comma, or whitespace is rejected (returns null) so no mailto header/recipient injection occurs.

testCases.title: Four-tab account detail; Consignment tab greyed out for non-consignment accounts; Sales YTD parked
testCases.preconditions: One account on consignment (has sites) and one account without consignment sites.
testCases.steps:
1. Open a consignment account; verify Overview/Sales/Consignment/History tabs and an enabled Consignment tab.
2. Open a non-consignment account; verify the Consignment tab is greyed/disabled.
3. Open the Sales tab.
testCases.expectedResult: Four-tab SegmentedTabs render. Consignment tab is enabled only when the account has sites and greyed/disabled otherwise. Sales tab surfaces order drafts; YTD / last-year sales $ totals are shown as parked on the Acumatica feed.

testCases.title: Lightweight account-visit log submits a note as a voice note with route_visit context
testCases.preconditions: Account detail open; CRM reachable.
testCases.steps:
1. On account detail, use the visit-log action.
2. Enter a note and submit.
3. Observe the confirmation.
testCases.expectedResult: The note is submitted to CRM (as a voice note with route_visit context) and a confirmation message is shown. Empty note is blocked by the voice-note submit guard.

testCases.title: Lead detail call disposition, stage change, and tap-to-call with optional auto-log
testCases.preconditions: Lead in scope with a phone number and no prior initialContactedAt.
testCases.steps:
1. Open lead detail; log a call disposition (note + timestamp).
2. Change the lead stage with a note (within MOBILE_ADVANCEABLE_STAGES).
3. Tap Call; verify the dialer opens and the optional 'Log call placed' prompt is offered.
4. Open a lead that already has initialContactedAt and tap Call.
testCases.testData: Lead phone '+19015550101'; one lead with initialContactedAt set
testCases.expectedResult: Call disposition and stage change submit to CRM. Tap-to-call opens the dialer; the auto-log disposition is offered only when the lead has a phone and no recorded initial contact (shouldOfferCallLog). For an already-contacted lead the dialer opens without re-prompting to log initial contact.

testCases.title: Stage change restricted to mobile-advanceable stages
testCases.preconditions: Lead detail open.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the stage-change panel.
2. Inspect the available target stages.
3. Attempt to select a stage outside MOBILE_ADVANCEABLE_STAGES (if exposed).
testCases.expectedResult: Only mobile-advanceable stages are offered; stages reserved for web/back-office are not selectable from mobile.

testCases.title: Lead inbox shows full queue with working search and is scoped to the TM's own book
testCases.preconditions: TM has assigned leads; other TMs have leads in different territories.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the lead inbox.
2. Type a search term matching a subset of leads.
3. Verify result filtering.
4. Confirm no out-of-territory leads appear.
testCases.expectedResult: Inbox lists the TM's full lead queue, search filters correctly, and only the TM's territory-scoped leads are visible (no other TMs' leads).

testCases.title: OCR capture previews extracted fields with per-field confidence; pasted-text fallback works
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated; OCR preview endpoint reachable.
testCases.steps:
1. Capture a business card via camera.
2. Observe extracted fields and confidence percentages and review reasons.
3. Use the paste-text fallback with a sample card text and Preview.
testCases.testData: Card image; pasted text 'Acme HVAC, Joe Smith, joe@acme.com, 901-555-0100, TN'
testCases.expectedResult: Preview shows company/contact/email/phone/state/service-techs with per-field confidence and any review reasons; a 'Needs review' or 'Ready' pill reflects lowConfidence. The pasted-text path returns the same preview structure.

testCases.title: OCR capture enforces images-only, 4 MB cap, and capped pasted text length
testCases.preconditions: OCR capture screen open.
testCases.steps:
1. Pick a non-image file from the gallery.
2. Pick an image whose fileSize exceeds 4,000,000 bytes.
3. Paste text longer than 5,000 characters and Preview.
testCases.expectedResult: Non-image rejected ('Unsupported business-card image type'); over-4MB image rejected ('too large'); pasted text over 5,000 chars rejected ('keep it under 5,000 characters'). No oversized/invalid payload is sent.

testCases.title: No silent device-side lead creation; commit goes only through governed CRM review (governed endpoint parked)
testCases.preconditions: OCR preview produced on the device.
testCases.steps:
1. From the OCR preview, look for any 'Create lead' device-side commit.
2. Use 'Send to CRM review queue'.
3. Confirm where the lead is actually created.
testCases.expectedResult: No lead is created silently on the device. The available action shares the candidate to the governed CRM review queue (duplicate review, routing, source attribution run in web). The governed device-side commit endpoint (POST leads) is not yet built (Q-M-01).

testCases.title: Voice note captures editable transcript, scopes to general or a specific entity, and syncs for office review
testCases.preconditions: Voice Notes screen open; CRM reachable.
testCases.steps:
1. Record audio and edit the transcript text.
2. Choose general context, then a specific account, then a lead (e.g. deep-linked from lead detail).
3. Submit.
4. Verify the note appears as Needs Office Review (no auto-writeback).
testCases.testData: Transcript 'Owner wants P-Max demo next week'; lead preset context
testCases.expectedResult: Voice note syncs with title/transcript and the chosen context (general/account/lead) persisted; the note is marked for office review. Automatic writeback into records is parked (ASM-MOB-05). Voice-to-text is available in lead capture too (FR-MOB-059).

testCases.title: Voice note validation: empty content blocked, transcript length capped, entity context requires an id
testCases.preconditions: Voice Notes screen open.
testCases.steps:
1. Attempt to sync with no audio and no transcript.
2. Enter a transcript over 12,000 characters and attempt sync.
3. Choose a specific account/lead context but leave the id unselected and attempt sync.
testCases.testData: Empty note; 12,001-char transcript; entity context with blank id
testCases.expectedResult: Empty note blocked ('Record a note or type a quick transcript'); transcript over 12,000 chars blocked; an entity context with a blank id blocked ('Choose a <type> before syncing'). General context needs no id.

testCases.title: Sync Status is the single my-work inventory using canonical 6-state vocabulary with retry/discard
testCases.preconditions: Multiple draft kinds queued (ROSE, route visit, training, order).
testCases.steps:
1. Open Sync Status.
2. Verify each draft kind shows a content preview (ROSE variance summary, route summary, training summary, order summary).
3. Verify status labels use only canonical states.
4. Use retry on one and discard on another.
5. Confirm a stuck 'syncing' draft resets after reload.
testCases.testData: 1 of each draft kind; 1 forced into stuck syncing
testCases.expectedResult: Sync Status lists all draft kinds with previews and retry/discard controls. Field-facing copy uses only the canonical 6-state set (Saved on phone / Sending / CRM saved / Needs retry / Sign in again / Needs review); no legacy strings (local_only, CRM pending, Will retry) appear. A stuck syncing draft resets to Saved on phone after reload.

testCases.title: CRM saved shown only after API acceptance; Saved on phone only after durable storage confirms; in-memory fallback warns
testCases.preconditions: Ability to fail the API and to simulate SecureStore unavailable.
testCases.steps:
1. Submit work with the API failing; verify no premature 'CRM saved'.
2. Verify 'Saved on phone' appears only after storage confirms the draft.
3. Simulate durable storage unavailable and submit.
testCases.expectedResult: 'CRM saved' is shown only after the API accepts the work. 'Saved on phone' appears only after native storage accepts the draft. When storage is unavailable, the app falls back to in-memory drafts with a visible warning.

testCases.title: Offline drafts contain no media bytes, base64, file URIs, or storage keys
testCases.preconditions: ROSE/training/route/order draft created offline with attached photos.
testCases.steps:
1. Create an offline ROSE draft with photos and an offline order draft.
2. Inspect the persisted draft payload (e.g. via Sync Status detail / storage inspection).
3. Search the payload for base64, file URIs, or storage keys.
testCases.expectedResult: Draft payloads carry only metadata/text (file name, mime, purpose, capturedAt, byteSize); no media bytes, base64 content, file URIs, or storage keys are persisted. Photos upload only when CRM is reachable.

testCases.title: Draft titles redact account/customer names; draft size capped; stale drafts expire by window
testCases.preconditions: Drafts of differing kinds and ages exist.
testCases.steps:
1. Inspect a route draft title vs a ROSE/training draft title for redaction/truncation.
2. Create an oversized order draft payload (very long notes) and save offline.
3. Age a route draft beyond its expiry window and a ROSE draft beyond its (longer) window.
testCases.testData: Route draft aged past route TTL; ROSE draft aged past ROSE TTL; 7-day order TTL
testCases.expectedResult: Draft titles are truncated/redacted to the minimum identifier. Oversized order payloads are truncated. Route drafts age out faster than ROSE/training drafts; expired drafts are dropped per the defined windows (order draft 7-day TTL enforced).

testCases.title: API base URL restricted to approved HTTPS host allowlist; HTTP and unapproved hosts rejected
testCases.preconditions: API base URL settings entry available.
testCases.steps:
1. Enter https://pulse-crm.theclustox.com.
2. Enter http://pulse-crm.theclustox.com (non-local HTTP).
3. Enter https://evil.example.com (unapproved host).
4. Enter http://localhost:3000 and http://127.0.0.1:3000.
5. Enter a URL with trailing slashes.
testCases.testData: Approved host; HTTP host; unapproved host; localhost; 127.0.0.1
testCases.expectedResult: Approved HTTPS host accepted (trailing slashes stripped). Non-local HTTP throws 'must use HTTPS'. Unapproved host throws 'not approved for Pulse Field'. localhost and 127.0.0.1 are permitted over HTTP for QA only.

testCases.title: Login uses shared Pulse credentials; unauthenticated actions are blocked
testCases.preconditions: App at login; an action requiring auth (e.g. start visit, OCR preview, ROSE submit).
testCases.steps:
1. Sign in with valid Pulse web credentials.
2. Sign in with invalid credentials.
3. While signed out / token absent, attempt to start a route visit and OCR preview.
testCases.testData: Valid creds; wrong password; signed-out state
testCases.expectedResult: Valid Pulse credentials authenticate; invalid credentials are rejected. Auth-required actions short-circuit when no auth/token is present (e.g. 'Sign in before starting a route visit'); no CRM write occurs unauthenticated.

testCases.title: All field writes use shared @pulse/contracts and produce an audit trail with identity/timestamp/source
testCases.preconditions: Ability to inspect CRM audit log after a mobile write.
testCases.steps:
1. Submit a ROSE audit, complete a visit, complete a training session, and create/submit an order draft from mobile.
2. Inspect the CRM audit entries for each.
3. Confirm no mobile-only parallel data model is used.
testCases.testData: One write of each type from the mobile app
testCases.expectedResult: Every write flows through governed Pulse API contracts (no parallel data paths) and produces a CRM audit trail capturing user identity, timestamp, and source. Order-draft create/submit/cancel/fulfill each write audit rows with before/after status.

testCases.title: RD sees regional rollup dashboard; TM is denied the RD overview and cannot see other TMs' data
testCases.preconditions: RD account and TM account; RD-scoped reporting endpoints available.
testCases.steps:
1. As RD/exec/admin, open 'Director overview' from More.
2. Verify regional pipeline/training/exception rollups render.
3. As a TM, attempt to reach the Director overview.
4. As a TM, confirm only own-book data is visible across surfaces.
testCases.expectedResult: RD/exec/admin see the role-gated Director overview with regional rollups (revenue KPIs parked on Acumatica). A TM does not get the RD overview and only ever sees their own assigned accounts/sites/leads (default-deny scoping).

testCases.title: TM captures and submits an order draft from account context (DRAFT to SUBMITTED) through governed API
testCases.preconditions: TM has order.create/order.submit and the target account is in scope; product catalog reachable.
testCases.steps:
1. Open an in-scope account; tap New order.
2. Add a catalog line (search 'P-Max 1625') and a custom line; set quantities; pick ship-to; add customer PO and office notes.
3. Save draft.
4. Submit.
5. Confirm the office triage queue (/orders) shows it as submitted.
testCases.testData: Account in scope; catalog product P-Max 1625 qty 12; custom line qty 3
testCases.expectedResult: Order draft is created (DRAFT) and submitted (SUBMITTED) via the governed orders API; it appears in the web back-office triage queue. Pricing is NOT entered in the field (Acumatica truth). Submit hands a captured intent to the office; it does not post to Acumatica.

testCases.title: Order draft validation: requires account, >=1 line, positive-integer quantities within caps
testCases.preconditions: Order capture screen open.
testCases.steps:
1. Attempt to submit with no lines.
2. Add a line with blank product name; attempt submit.
3. Set a line quantity to 0, then to a non-integer/below 1.
4. Set a quantity above the max (1,000,000) and beyond the server line cap.
testCases.testData: 0 lines; blank name; qty 0; qty 1,000,001; lines > MAX_LINES
testCases.expectedResult: Submit blocked: 'Add at least one product line', 'Every line needs a product name', 'Every line needs a quantity of at least 1'. Quantities are clamped to 1..1,000,000 client-side; the server also rejects non-positive/over-max quantities and orders exceeding the line cap.

testCases.title: RBAC and record-scoping: order.create denied without permission; out-of-scope account/order rejected (IDOR)
testCases.preconditions: User A (TM) with order permissions; an account and an order draft owned by another territory (User B).
testCases.steps:
1. As a user lacking the orders module/order.create, attempt to create an order draft.
2. As TM A, create an order for an account outside A's scope.
3. As TM A, GET/PATCH/submit an order draft id belonging to TM B's territory.
4. As unauthenticated, call the order endpoints.
testCases.testData: User without order.create; out-of-scope accountId; another TM's orderDraftId
testCases.expectedResult: Missing permission returns 403 (default-deny). Creating against an out-of-scope account returns 'Account not found' (scope filter). Fetching/patching/submitting another TM's order returns not found via record-scope (no IDOR leak). Unauthenticated calls return 401.

testCases.title: Order lifecycle guards: only DRAFT edits/submits; terminal states reject; concurrent transition rejected (TOCTOU)
testCases.preconditions: Order drafts in DRAFT, SUBMITTED, FULFILLED, and CANCELLED states.
testCases.steps:
1. Edit (PATCH) and submit a SUBMITTED order.
2. Cancel a FULFILLED order.
3. Fulfill a DRAFT order.
4. Submit an order with zero lines.
5. Fire two concurrent submits on the same DRAFT.
testCases.testData: Orders in each status; empty-line order; race two submits
testCases.expectedResult: Edit/submit allowed only from DRAFT ('Only draft orders can be edited/submitted'); cancelling a FULFILLED/CANCELLED order and fulfilling a non-SUBMITTED order are rejected. Submitting with no lines is rejected. The atomic guarded transition lets only one concurrent submit win; the loser gets 'updated concurrently; reload and try again'.

testCases.title: Offline order draft replays with idempotency key so a lost create response does not duplicate
testCases.preconditions: Order capture offline; idempotency key threaded through create and offline replay.
testCases.steps:
1. Save/submit an order while offline; verify it queues with an idempotency key.
2. Simulate the first create response being lost, then replay from Sync Status.
3. Verify only one OrderDraft is created.
4. Confirm ship-to that doesn't belong to the account is rejected.
testCases.testData: Offline order with idempotencyKey; replayed twice; mismatched shipToLocationId
testCases.expectedResult: Replaying the create with the same client idempotency key dedupes (returns the existing draft via the unique [createdByUserId, idempotencyKey] constraint), so no duplicate order is created. A ship-to not belonging to the account is rejected ('Ship-to location does not belong to this account').

testCases.title: Acumatica order placement / first-order account-create / authoritative pricing remain parked
testCases.preconditions: Acumatica access NOT granted.
testCases.steps:
1. Submit an order on behalf; observe the destination.
2. Submit a first order for a brand-new customer.
3. Inspect whether prices/tax/shipping are shown as authoritative.
testCases.expectedResult: Submit hands the captured intent to back-office triage only; it does not post a SalesOrder to Acumatica, does not create an Acumatica Customer on first order, and does not surface authoritative price/tax/shipping. These remain parked behind Acumatica access and are not presented as complete.

testCases.title: Open account link from a field-activity review row (not yet built)
testCases.preconditions: A field-activity review list with rows tied to accounts.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the field activity review list.
2. Tap a review row's 'Open account' affordance.
testCases.expectedResult: Intended: tapping the row navigates to the account detail screen. Currently no 'Open account' link exists on review rows (UX-M-001 open) — this test is expected to fail until built.

testCases.title: Special characters / unicode / injection-like text in notes and transcripts are stored safely
testCases.preconditions: Voice note / checkout note / order note fields available; CRM reachable.
testCases.steps:
1. Enter a transcript/note containing emoji, RTL/unicode, and SQL/script-like strings.
2. Submit and view the stored value in CRM.
testCases.expectedResult: The value is persisted and rendered as inert text (no SQL execution, no script execution, length caps respected). Audit trail records the write with identity/timestamp/source.

testCases.title: Outdoor-readable theme (dark/high-contrast) and accessibility labels with Dynamic Type
testCases.preconditions: Device supports OS dark mode and font scaling.
testCases.steps:
1. Switch OS to dark mode; verify the app adopts a dark palette.
2. Enable the opt-in high-contrast toggle.
3. Increase OS font size (Dynamic Type) and verify text scales.
4. Run an accessibility audit on interactive controls (buttons, route actions).
testCases.testData: OS dark mode + largest Dynamic Type
testCases.expectedResult: App provides an OS-automatic dark theme and an opt-in high-contrast mode; interactive controls carry accessibility labels and text honours Dynamic Type targeting WCAG AA. On-device visual QA of palettes is hardware-gated.

testCases.title: Today first visible section renders within 3 seconds on LTE
testCases.preconditions: Device on an LTE connection; representative data volume.
testCases.steps:
1. Cold-start the app on LTE and sign in.
2. Time until the first Today section is visibly rendered.
3. Repeat with one slow endpoint.
testCases.expectedResult: The first visible Today section renders within 3 seconds on LTE; a single slow/failing endpoint does not delay or blank the whole screen (section-level independence).

testCases.title: Automatic AI writeback from voice notes/cards is parked; office approval required before activity
testCases.preconditions: Voice note synced; writeback governance not yet approved.
testCases.steps:
1. Sync a voice note scoped to an account/lead.
2. Observe its review state and whether it auto-creates record activity.
testCases.expectedResult: The note is marked Needs Office Review and does not silently write back into the lead/account/training/consignment record; office approval is required first. Automatic writeback remains parked (ASM-MOB-05).

testCases.title: Calendar events shown via Pulse calendar API only; Outlook/Graph bi-directional sync parked
testCases.preconditions: Microsoft Graph integration not certified.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the calendar / Today agenda.
2. Verify events come from the Pulse calendar API.
3. Create an event in Outlook and confirm it does not bi-directionally sync to mobile.
testCases.testData: Pulse calendar events; external Outlook event
testCases.expectedResult: Calendar shows Pulse calendar API events only; there is no Outlook/Graph bi-directional sync (parked). The absence of Graph sync is not presented as complete.

testCases.title: Field signals are in-app/derived only; push notifications, deep links, and background sync are parked
testCases.preconditions: No push provider configured; sync is foreground/manual.
testCases.steps:
1. Trigger an urgent lead / SLA risk / due ROSE condition.
2. Background the app and verify no push notification arrives.
3. Verify drafts only sync on foreground/manual retry (no background worker).
testCases.expectedResult: Signals are surfaced via the in-app header bell and Today badges derived from fetched data; no OS push notification or deep link fires, and drafts do not sync in the background. Push and background sync remain parked.

testCases.title: List users returns paginated rows with name, email, role, status, last login and live-session count
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS or SUPER_ADMIN (admin.user_view). At least 25 users exist spanning ACTIVE/PENDING/INACTIVE.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/admin/users
2. Inspect response body and the first user object
testCases.expectedResult: 200; response has users[], total, page=1, limit=20. testCases.preconditions: admin.integration_manage. Failed lead-alert deliveries exist.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/admin/integrations/lead-alerts/retry
2. POST /api/v1/admin/integrations/lead-alerts/dead-letter
3. PATCH /api/v1/admin/integrations/lead-alerts/quiet-hours
testCases.expectedResult: Retry re-enqueues failed deliveries via the queue; dead-letter moves irrecoverable ones; quiet-hours update returns refreshed settings. All three require admin.integration_manage (a view-only role gets 403).

testCases.title: Admin tabs render only for roles with the matching action; gating enforced server-side too
testCases.preconditions: Login as ADMIN_CSR_OPS (full admin) and as FINANCE (limited admin actions).
testCases.steps:
1. As ADMIN_CSR_OPS, open admin console and enumerate tabs
2. As FINANCE, open admin console
3. Deep-link to a tab the role lacks and call its API
testCases.expectedResult: Tabs (users, roles, overview, activity, integrations, configuration, reference) shown only where canPerformAction is true (tabAccess). FINANCE (no admin.* actions) sees no admin tabs / is denied. Deep-linked API call to an ungranted tab returns 403 (server-side gate, not UI-only). Dealer-group rules reachable from admin nav.

testCases.title: User list and reference lists meet load-time targets at scale
testCases.preconditions: 500 users and <500 reference entries seeded.
testCases.steps:
1. Time GET /api/v1/admin/users?limit=100 with active filters
2. Time affinity/ownership reference list load
testCases.expectedResult: User list (first page, filtered) returns within 2s for up to 500 users; reference lists load within 1s for lists under 500 entries. Pagination is server-side (max 100/page).

testCases.title: Unicode/special-character names accepted; SQL/script payloads stored safely (no injection/XSS)
testCases.preconditions: admin.user_manage.
testCases.steps:
1. POST a user with unicode name and an email containing a quote
2. POST a user whose lastName is a SQL/script payload
3. View the user in the list/UI
testCases.expectedResult: User created with unicode preserved (displayName 'José O'Brien <script>...'). Prisma parameterization prevents SQL injection; the payload is stored as data, not executed. UI renders the value escaped (no script execution / XSS). No 500.

testCases.title: Concurrent edits/deactivation on the same user are serialized via transactions
testCases.preconditions: admin.user_manage. One target user.
testCases.steps:
1. Fire two near-simultaneous PATCHes on the same user (e.g. role change vs isActive=false)
2. Inspect final state and audit entries
testCases.testData: Concurrent PATCH A {role:'FINANCE'} and PATCH B {isActive:false}
testCases.expectedResult: Both mutations run inside DB transactions (prisma.$transaction) so the user record does not corrupt; each successful mutation writes its own atomic audit entry. Final state is a consistent merge of the last-committed writes; no partial/lost-audit state.

testCases.title: Temp passwords are random and password hashes are scrypt salted; plaintext never logged
testCases.preconditions: admin.user_manage. Structured logs accessible.
testCases.steps:
1. Create two users without supplying a password
2. Compare their temporaryPassword values
3. Inspect stored identity passwordHash format and server logs
testCases.expectedResult: Each temporaryPassword is distinct, cryptographically random base64url (9 bytes entropy). Stored hash has format scrypt$<salt>$<derived> (scrypt, 16-byte salt, 64-byte key). Plaintext password and hash never appear in audit metadata or structured logs (NFR-AD-006/007).

testCases.title: Authenticated internal user reaches Reporting Home and lands on a role-scoped default dashboard
testCases.preconditions: User authenticated with a role that includes the `reports` module (e.g. SALES_BD_REP). Reporting Home route /reports and nav entry wired (FR-RPT-010 Built).
testCases.steps:
1. Log in as a SALES_BD_REP user.
2. Confirm the 'Reports' navigation entry is visible.
3. Click the Reports nav entry / navigate to /reports.
4. Observe the landing view without applying any filter.
testCases.expectedResult: The /reports shell renders with a default 'Dashboard' tab and a 'Saved reports' tab. The default Lead dashboard loads with role-scoped data and no filter selection required. Nav entry resolves (200).

testCases.title: Dashboard tab visibility is restricted by role - Executive tab hidden from non-executive roles
testCases.preconditions: Tabs framework built (Dashboard / Saved reports plus role-gated Executive/Training tabs). reports.executive held only by EXECUTIVE and SUPER_ADMIN.
testCases.steps:
1. Log in as TERRITORY_MANAGER (no reports.executive).
2. Navigate to /reports.
3. Inspect the available dashboard tabs.
4. Attempt to access the Executive tab/endpoint directly.
testCases.expectedResult: The Executive tab is not rendered for the TM. A direct call to GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/executive returns 403 Forbidden (assertActionAccess 'reports.executive' fails).

testCases.title: Dealer role is denied all internal Reporting Home endpoints (default-deny on reports module)
testCases.preconditions: DEALER_PORTAL_USER default module access is [home, calendar, dealer_portal, notifications] - 'reports' is NOT granted. Steve Mores: 'I don't want dealers seeing consignment.'
testCases.steps:
1. Authenticate as a DEALER_PORTAL_USER.
2. Call GET /api/v1/reports/definitions.
3. Call GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/leads.
4. Call POST /api/v1/reports/run.
5. Call GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/executive.
testCases.expectedResult: Every /api/v1/reports/* call returns 403 Forbidden (withReportsAuth requireAuthenticatedActor module:'reports' fails). Dealer never reaches any internal report, dashboard, builder, or schedule surface.

testCases.title: TM sees only own-book leads in the Lead dashboard; another TM's leads are excluded
testCases.preconditions: Two TMs (TM-A, TM-B) each own distinct leads. resolveLeadRecordScope restricts TM to assignedTmUserId / territory.managerUserId. lead.view held by TM.
testCases.steps:
1. Seed 10 active leads owned by TM-A and 7 by TM-B (distinct territories).
2. Log in as TM-A.
3. GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/leads.
4. Inspect metrics.totalActiveLeads, byStage, bySource, byState, slaAtRisk.
testCases.expectedResult: All counts and lists reflect only TM-A's 10 leads. None of TM-B's leads appear in any aggregate or in the slaAtRisk detail list. totalActiveLeads <= 10.

testCases.title: RD sees rollup across subordinate TMs; Executive/Admin see full dataset
testCases.preconditions: RD-1 directs region containing TM-A and TM-B. buildAccountRecordScope / lead scope resolve RD to assignedRdUserId / territory.region.directorUserId. EXECUTIVE has global visibility (undefined scope).
testCases.steps:
1. Log in as REGIONAL_DIRECTOR RD-1.
2. GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/leads and note the rollup count.
3. Log in as EXECUTIVE.
4. GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/executive and note org-wide openLeads.
testCases.testData: RD-1 over TM-A(10)+TM-B(7); plus other-region leads
testCases.expectedResult: RD-1's lead dashboard aggregates TM-A + TM-B (>=17, excludes other regions). Executive openLeads counts ALL active leads org-wide (no scope applied).

testCases.title: IDOR - TM cannot run a saved/ad-hoc report to read another territory's rows
testCases.preconditions: Every executor applies the actor's record scope (commits 4dfe445/619de4f). config.territoryId is an additive filter, not a scope override.
testCases.steps:
1. Log in as TM-A.
2. POST /api/v1/reports/run with reportKey 'lead_funnel' and config.territoryId set to TM-B's territory id.
3. Inspect returned rows.
testCases.expectedResult: The report returns zero rows (or only rows that are both in TM-B's territory AND in TM-A's scope = empty). The scope AND-clause prevents TM-A from reading TM-B's leads via a forged territoryId. No cross-territory leakage.

testCases.title: Report definition creation is gated on reports.builder action
testCases.preconditions: createReportDefinition calls assertActionAccess(role,'reports.builder'). All internal roles hold reports.builder; DEALER does not.
testCases.steps:
1. Identify a role WITHOUT reports.builder for a negative case (use DEALER_PORTAL_USER - blocked at module level) and confirm a builder-holding role for the positive case.
2. As SALES_BD_REP (has reports.builder), POST /api/v1/reports/definitions with a valid body.
3. As DEALER_PORTAL_USER, attempt the same POST.
testCases.testData: Positive: SALES_BD_REP; Negative: DEALER_PORTAL_USER; body { name:'My funnel', reportKey:'lead_funnel' }
testCases.expectedResult: SALES_BD_REP gets 201 Created with the definition. DEALER_PORTAL_USER gets 403 (module gate). A hypothetical reports-module role lacking reports.builder would also get 403 from the action gate.

testCases.title: Create a personal (PRIVATE) saved report definition - happy path
testCases.preconditions: Actor has reports module + reports.builder. REPORT_KEYS = lead_funnel, training_compliance, consignment_audit_status, territory_coverage, field_activity. Default visibility = private.
testCases.steps:
1. Log in as SALES_BD_REP.
2. POST /api/v1/reports/definitions { name:'Q3 Lead Funnel', description:'My funnel', reportKey:'lead_funnel', config:{startDate:'2026-04-01',endDate:'2026-06-30'} } (omit visibility).
3. GET /api/v1/reports/definitions.
testCases.testData: name='Q3 Lead Funnel', reportKey='lead_funnel', visibility omitted
testCases.expectedResult: 201 with definition: visibility='private', ownerUserId=actor, isActive=true, scheduleCount=0, name trimmed, ownerName populated. The definition appears in the owner's list.

testCases.title: Create report definition rejects blank/whitespace name
testCases.preconditions: createReportDefinition trims name and throws 'Report name is required' when empty. http maps thrown Error to 400 badRequest.
testCases.steps:
1. Log in as a reports.builder role.
2. POST /api/v1/reports/definitions { name:'   ', reportKey:'lead_funnel' }.
3. Observe status and message.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 Bad Request with message 'Report name is required'. No definition is created.

testCases.title: Create/run report rejects an unknown reportKey enum value
testCases.preconditions: assertReportKey throws 'Unknown report key: <x>' for any value not in REPORT_KEYS. Applies to create and ad-hoc run.
testCases.steps:
1. Log in as a reports.builder role.
2. POST /api/v1/reports/definitions { name:'X', reportKey:'revenue_by_state' }.
3. POST /api/v1/reports/run { reportKey:'revenue_by_state' }.
testCases.expectedResult: Both return 400 with message 'Unknown report key: revenue_by_state'. No definition created; no report executed.

testCases.title: Create report definition rejects an invalid visibility value
testCases.preconditions: REPORT_VISIBILITIES = private/team/org. createReportDefinition throws 'Unknown visibility: <x>' otherwise.
testCases.steps: 1. POST /api/v1/reports/definitions { name:'X', reportKey:'lead_funnel', visibility:'public' }.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 with message 'Unknown visibility: public'. No definition created.

testCases.title: PRIVATE definition is owner-only; not visible to other internal users
testCases.preconditions: visibleWhere returns OR[ ownerUserId=actor, visibility in (TEAM,ORG) ]. PRIVATE owned by user-A.
testCases.steps:
1. As user-A, create a PRIVATE definition.
2. Log in as user-B (different internal user, has reports module).
3. GET /api/v1/reports/definitions as user-B.
4. Attempt POST /api/v1/reports/definitions/{A-private-id}/run as user-B.
testCases.expectedResult: User-B's list does NOT include user-A's PRIVATE definition. Running it returns 'Report definition not found' (404/400) because findFirst with visibleWhere excludes it.

testCases.title: TEAM/ORG definitions are visible to all internal users
testCases.preconditions: visibleWhere admits visibility in (TEAM,ORG) for any internal user with reports module access.
testCases.steps:
1. As user-A, create an ORG definition 'Org Lead Funnel'.
2. Log in as user-B.
3. GET /api/v1/reports/definitions.
4. POST /api/v1/reports/definitions/{org-id}/run as user-B.
testCases.expectedResult: User-B sees the ORG definition in the list and can run it; the run executes with user-B's own record scope (not user-A's).

testCases.title: Non-owner, non-admin cannot edit or delete another user's definition
testCases.preconditions: getOwnedDefinition throws 'Only the report owner or an admin can modify this report' unless canManage (owner OR SUPER_ADMIN OR EXECUTIVE).
testCases.steps:
1. As user-A create an ORG definition.
2. Log in as user-B (regular role, not admin/exec, sees it via ORG).
3. PATCH /api/v1/reports/definitions/{id} { name:'Hijacked' } as user-B.
4. DELETE /api/v1/reports/definitions/{id} as user-B.
testCases.expectedResult: Both PATCH and DELETE return 400 'Only the report owner or an admin can modify this report'. Definition unchanged and not deleted.

testCases.title: SUPER_ADMIN and EXECUTIVE can modify/delete any definition (admin override)
testCases.preconditions: canManage returns true for role SUPER_ADMIN or EXECUTIVE regardless of ownership.
testCases.steps:
1. As user-A create an ORG definition.
2. Log in as SUPER_ADMIN.
3. PATCH the definition name.
4. Log in as EXECUTIVE.
5. DELETE the definition.
testCases.expectedResult: SUPER_ADMIN PATCH succeeds (200, name updated). EXECUTIVE DELETE succeeds (200 {ok:true}). Both are allowed by canManage admin override.

testCases.title: PATCH/DELETE/run on a non-existent definition id returns not-found
testCases.preconditions: getOwnedDefinition throws 'Report definition not found' on null lookup; runReportDefinition throws same when not visible.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/reports/definitions/does-not-exist { name:'X' }.
2. DELETE /api/v1/reports/definitions/does-not-exist.
3. POST /api/v1/reports/definitions/does-not-exist/run.
testCases.expectedResult: All return 400 with message 'Report definition not found'. No side effects.

testCases.title: Update definition rejects a name set to empty string but allows clearing description
testCases.preconditions: updateReportDefinition throws 'Report name cannot be empty' for blank name; description set to '' or null becomes null (cleared).
testCases.steps:
1. As owner, PATCH { name:'  ' } on an owned definition.
2. PATCH { description:'' } on the same definition.
3. GET the definition.
testCases.expectedResult: Step 1 returns 400 'Report name cannot be empty'. Step 2 succeeds; description is cleared (null / absent) in the returned summary.

testCases.title: Ad-hoc lead_funnel run returns stage aggregation with SLA breaches and top source
testCases.preconditions: runLeadFunnel aggregates leads by stage with slaBreaches (initialContactDueAt past & not contacted) and topSource. Scope applied via resolveLeadRecordScope.
testCases.steps:
1. Seed leads across stages, some past initial-contact due and uncontacted.
2. As EXECUTIVE, POST /api/v1/reports/run { reportKey:'lead_funnel', config:{ startDate:'2026-06-01', endDate:'2026-06-30' } }.
3. Inspect columns and rows.
testCases.expectedResult: 200 with columns [stage, leadCount, slaBreaches, topSource] and one row per stage present in window. slaBreaches counts overdue-uncontacted leads; topSource is the most frequent source per stage; rowCount = number of stages.

testCases.title: Run with no date config defaults to a trailing 30-day window; inclusive ISO bounds
testCases.preconditions: reportWindow: end defaults to now; start defaults to end-30d; explicit startDate -> 'T00:00:00.000Z', endDate -> 'T23:59:59.999Z' (inclusive end-of-day).
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/reports/run { reportKey:'lead_funnel' } (no config).
2. Seed a lead created at endDate 23:30 UTC and run with explicit endDate equal to that calendar day.
3. Verify the boundary lead is included.
testCases.testData: config omitted; then endDate='2026-06-29' with lead at 2026-06-29T23:30:00Z
testCases.expectedResult: No-config run uses now-30d..now. The 23:30 lead on the endDate calendar day IS included (end bound is 23:59:59.999Z). No off-by-one exclusion at the day boundary.

testCases.requirementRef: FR-RPT-061, NFR-RPT-008, Edge (very large dataset cap)
testCases.title: lead_funnel applies a 25,000-row safety cap for attacker-controlled date windows
testCases.preconditions: runLeadFunnel uses prisma.lead.findMany take:25000. A maximal window could otherwise pull unbounded rows.
testCases.steps:
1. As EXECUTIVE, POST /api/v1/reports/run { reportKey:'lead_funnel', config:{ startDate:'1970-01-01', endDate:'2100-12-31' } }.
2. Observe the query does not load more than 25,000 lead rows and the run completes.
testCases.expectedResult: The run completes without timeout/OOM; at most 25,000 leads are materialized for the aggregation. (Known limitation: aggregation beyond the cap is approximate - documented follow-up to move to groupBy.)

testCases.title: training_compliance run lists per-account last training, next due, and overdue flag with account scope
testCases.preconditions: runTrainingCompliance reads ACTIVE programs scoped by buildAccountRecordScope; lastCompletedAt via max(completedAt); overdue when nextDueAt < now.
testCases.steps:
1. Seed accounts with ACTIVE training programs, varying nextDueAt (some past).
2. As TRAINING_OPS, POST /api/v1/reports/run { reportKey:'training_compliance' }.
3. Inspect rows.
testCases.expectedResult: 200 with columns [account, lastCompletedAt(date), nextDueAt(date), overdue(text)]. Accounts with nextDueAt < now show overdue='Yes'; dates rendered as YYYY-MM-DD; null last-training shown as null.

testCases.title: Unknown/edge role with no defined scope is restricted to an empty result (default-deny scoping)
testCases.preconditions: buildAccountRecordScope returns { id:'__no-record-scope__' } for any role that is neither global-visibility nor TM/RD - producing an impossible match (empty set).
testCases.steps:
1. Simulate an actor with a non-global, non-TM/RD role that nonetheless has reports module access.
2. Run training_compliance / consignment_audit_status.
3. Inspect row count.
testCases.testData: role with reports module but no explicit scope branch
testCases.expectedResult: Reports return zero rows (the sentinel '__no-record-scope__' matches no records). The system fails closed rather than leaking the full dataset.

testCases.title: Executive dashboard returns org-wide CRM KPIs and a cross-module exception summary
testCases.preconditions: getExecutiveDashboard gated on reports.executive; returns openLeads, activeConsignmentSites, trainingsCompleted (90d window), openExceptions = overdueAudits+overdueTraining+staleLeads+openConsignmentWorkItems.
testCases.steps:
1. Seed cross-module data: active leads, active sites with overdue audits, overdue training programs, stale (overdue-uncontacted) leads, open consignment work items.
2. As EXECUTIVE, GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/executive.
3. Inspect metrics and exceptions objects.
testCases.expectedResult: 200 with metrics {openLeads, activeConsignmentSites, trainingsCompleted, openExceptions} and exceptions {overdueAudits, overdueTraining, staleLeads, openConsignmentWorkItems}; openExceptions equals the sum of the four exception counts; windowDays=90.

testCases.title: Acumatica-sourced exec KPIs (YTD revenue, active accounts) remain parked, not fabricated
testCases.preconditions: Dependency: Acumatica order/invoice API certification (§6). YTD revenue + active-account count are Parked; FR-RPT-011 only CRM KPIs built. NFR-RPT-015 requires lastSyncedAt + stale warning when surfaced.
testCases.steps:
1. As EXECUTIVE, GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/executive.
2. Confirm response contains NO computed YTD revenue / active-accounts figure.
3. (UI) Confirm revenue tiles render as a dashed 'awaiting Acumatica sync' placeholder rather than a number.
testCases.testData: Role: EXECUTIVE; Acumatica sync not available
testCases.expectedResult: The endpoint returns only CRM-native KPIs. No revenue/active-account number is present. UI shows a Parked placeholder. When sync lands, a lastSyncedAt timestamp and >24h stale warning must appear (NFR-RPT-015).

testCases.title: Executive dashboard endpoint denies a reports-module user lacking reports.executive
testCases.preconditions: getExecutiveDashboard calls assertActionAccess(role,'reports.executive'); only EXECUTIVE/SUPER_ADMIN hold it.
testCases.steps:
1. Log in as ADMIN_CSR_OPS (has reports module + builder, NOT reports.executive).
2. GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/executive.
3. Log in as FINANCE; repeat.
testCases.expectedResult: Both return 403 Forbidden. Only EXECUTIVE and SUPER_ADMIN can read the executive dashboard.

testCases.title: Lead dashboard reports intake by source/state and homeowner/contractor segmentation
testCases.preconditions: getLeadDashboard builds bySource (top 8), byState (top 8), segmentation {homeowner, contractor, unspecified}. Adrienne: 'of 187, 86 were homeowner.'
testCases.steps:
1. Seed active leads with mixed leadType (HOMEOWNER/CONTRACTOR/null), sources, states.
2. As SALES_BD_REP, GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/leads.
3. Inspect bySource, byState, segmentation.
testCases.testData: leads: 86 HOMEOWNER, 60 CONTRACTOR, 41 null of 187 in scope
testCases.expectedResult: bySource and byState each return up to the top 8 buckets sorted desc; null source->'Unknown', null state->'Unspecified'. segmentation.homeowner=86, contractor=60, unspecified = totalActiveLeads-86-60 (>=0, clamped at 0).

testCases.title: Lead stage bottleneck view returns per-stage counts plus aging (avg/max/stale)
testCases.preconditions: byStage merges stage counts with computeLeadStageAging (avgDaysInStage, maxDaysInStage, staleCount). Empty stages report 0 for all aging fields.
testCases.steps:
1. Seed active leads across all 7 stages with differing time-in-stage; include a stage with no leads.
2. GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/leads.
3. Inspect byStage entries.
testCases.testData: leads across NEW..CUSTOMER_ACTIVE; one empty stage
testCases.expectedResult: byStage lists all 7 stages in fixed order. Populated stages show count>0 with avgDaysInStage/maxDaysInStage/staleCount computed; the empty stage shows count=0 and avg=max=stale=0.

testCases.title: Lead-to-account conversion rate uses owned (non-pre-handoff-gated) book as a stable denominator
testCases.preconditions: conversionRatePct = round(convertedLeads/totalLeads*100) computed over the 'owned' scope (preHandoffTmVisibility:true) so the denominator is not inflated by the visibility gate. totalLeads=0 -> 0%.
testCases.steps:
1. Seed a TM book with N total leads and K at CUSTOMER_ACTIVE.
2. As that TM, GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/leads.
3. Verify conversionRatePct = round(K/N*100).
4. As a TM with zero leads, verify conversionRatePct=0 (no divide-by-zero).
testCases.testData: K=12 converted of N=80 owned -> 15%; then N=0 -> 0%
testCases.expectedResult: conversionRatePct = 15 for the first TM and 0 (not NaN/Infinity) for the empty-book TM. Denominator uses owned book, not visible-scope, so the rate is comparable across roles.

testCases.title: SLA-at-risk list returns overdue uncontacted leads with owner and days-overdue, most-overdue first
testCases.preconditions: slaAtRisk = active leads with initialContactedAt null AND initialContactDueAt < now; ordered initialContactDueAt asc; capped at top 8; daysOverdue >= 0.
testCases.steps:
1. Seed several active leads past their initial-contact due date and uncontacted, plus one already contacted.
2. GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/leads.
3. Inspect slaAtRiskCount and slaAtRisk[].
testCases.expectedResult: slaAtRiskCount=5; slaAtRisk lists up to 8 items each with leadId, companyName, stage(lowercase), ownerName (or null), initialContactDueAt, daysOverdue>=0; ordered most-overdue first. The contacted lead is excluded.

testCases.title: Lead dashboard denies a reports-module role that lacks lead.view (TRAINING_OPS)
testCases.preconditions: getLeadDashboard asserts module 'reports' AND action 'lead.view'. TRAINING_OPS has reports + reports.builder but NOT lead.view.
testCases.steps:
1. Log in as TRAINING_OPS.
2. GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/leads.
testCases.expectedResult: 403 Forbidden (assertActionAccess 'lead.view' fails). A reports-but-not-leads role cannot read lead-record KPIs via the dashboard.

testCases.title: Training dashboard returns hours, accounts trained, site-visit split, and by-type/by-trainer breakdowns
testCases.preconditions: getTrainingDashboard gated on reports + training modules; 90-day window; separates activityKind TRAINING vs SITE_VISIT; byType and byTrainer top 8.
testCases.steps:
1. Seed completed TRAINING and SITE_VISIT sessions in the last 90 days across types/trainers/accounts.
2. As TRAINING_OPS, GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/training.
3. Inspect metrics, byType, byTrainer.
testCases.testData: Role: TRAINING_OPS; mixed completed sessions in 90d
testCases.expectedResult: metrics {completedSessions, trainingHours (minutes/60 rounded to 0.1), accountsTrained (distinct), siteVisits (separate count), overduePrograms}; byType and byTrainer each up to 8 sorted buckets; siteVisits excluded from trainingHours.

testCases.title: Training overdue exception lists accounts with overdue training programs, scoped and most-overdue first
testCases.preconditions: overdueProgram = status in (ACTIVE,OVERDUE) AND nextDueAt < now; overdueAccounts top 8 ordered nextDueAt asc; account scope applied for TM/RD.
testCases.steps:
1. Seed accounts with overdue training programs in and out of the TM's book.
2. As TERRITORY_MANAGER, GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/training.
3. Inspect overduePrograms count and overdueAccounts list.
testCases.testData: Role: TERRITORY_MANAGER; overdue programs in/out of book
testCases.expectedResult: overduePrograms counts only in-scope overdue programs; overdueAccounts lists up to 8 in-scope accounts with daysOverdue>=0, most overdue first. Out-of-book overdue accounts excluded.

testCases.title: Training dashboard denies reports roles without the training module (SALES_BD/FINANCE/ADMIN_CSR_OPS)
testCases.preconditions: getTrainingDashboard asserts module 'reports' AND module 'training'. SALES_BD_REP/FINANCE/ADMIN_CSR_OPS have reports but not training module.
testCases.steps:
1. Log in as SALES_BD_REP.
2. GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/training.
3. Repeat as FINANCE and ADMIN_CSR_OPS.
testCases.expectedResult: All three return 403 Forbidden (training module gate). Only training-enabled roles (TRAINING_OPS, TM, RD, EXECUTIVE, SUPER_ADMIN) can read the training dashboard.

testCases.title: consignment_audit_status report lists sites with ROSE due dates, overdue flag, and open work-item counts
testCases.preconditions: runConsignmentAuditStatus scoped by buildConsignmentSiteRecordScope; overdue when nextAuditDueAt < now; openWorkItems counts status in (OPEN,IN_PROGRESS,BLOCKED).
testCases.steps:
1. Seed consignment sites with mixed nextAuditDueAt (some overdue) and open work items.
2. As ADMIN_CSR_OPS, POST /api/v1/reports/run { reportKey:'consignment_audit_status' }.
3. Inspect rows.
testCases.expectedResult: 200 with columns [site, account, status, nextAuditDueAt, overdue, openWorkItems]. Sites past nextAuditDueAt show overdue='Yes'; openWorkItems reflects only OPEN/IN_PROGRESS/BLOCKED items.

testCases.title: Consignment inventory value by site is surfaced as a Parked placeholder (Acumatica inventory truth)
testCases.preconditions: FR-RPT-059 Parked behind Acumatica inventory truth; per 05_CONSIGNMENT_PRD §4A.7 rendered as a dashed 'Parked' card.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the consignment reports/dashboard view.
2. Locate the inventory-value-by-site widget.
testCases.expectedResult: The inventory-value-by-site widget renders as a dashed Parked card (no fabricated $ figure). It is clearly labelled as awaiting Acumatica inventory sync.

testCases.title: Create a recurring schedule with cadence, hour, and recipient list - happy path
testCases.preconditions: createReportSchedule requires owned definition; assertScheduleInput validates cadence/hourUtc/recipients; computeNextRunAt sets nextRunAt (weekly->Monday, monthly->1st).
testCases.steps:
1. As owner of a definition, POST /api/v1/reports/definitions/{id}/schedules { cadence:'weekly', hourUtc:9, recipients:['ops@dynamic.com','vp@dynamic.com'] }.
2. GET /api/v1/reports/definitions/{id}/schedules.
testCases.expectedResult: 201 with schedule: cadence='weekly', hourUtc=9, recipients of length 2, isActive=true, nextRunAt set to the next Monday at 09:00 UTC. Listed under the definition.

testCases.title: Schedule creation rejects invalid cadence and out-of-range hourUtc
testCases.preconditions: assertScheduleInput throws 'Unknown cadence' for non daily/weekly/monthly; 'hourUtc must be an integer between 0 and 23' for <0, >23, or non-integer.
testCases.steps:
1. POST schedule { cadence:'hourly', hourUtc:9, recipients:['a@b.com'] }.
2. POST { cadence:'daily', hourUtc:24, recipients:['a@b.com'] }.
3. POST { cadence:'daily', hourUtc:-1, ... }.
4. POST { cadence:'daily', hourUtc:9.5, ... }.
testCases.expectedResult: Step 1 -> 400 'Unknown cadence: hourly'. Steps 2-4 -> 400 'hourUtc must be an integer between 0 and 23'. hourUtc=0 and hourUtc=23 are accepted (valid boundaries).

testCases.title: Schedule creation rejects empty recipient list and malformed email addresses
testCases.preconditions: assertScheduleInput throws 'At least one recipient is required' for empty; per-recipient regex ^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$ else 'Invalid recipient email: <x>'.
testCases.steps:
1. POST schedule { cadence:'daily', hourUtc:9, recipients:[] }.
2. POST { ..., recipients:['not-an-email'] }.
3. POST { ..., recipients:['ok@dynamic.com','bad@@x'] }.
testCases.expectedResult: Step 1 -> 400 'At least one recipient is required'. Steps 2-3 -> 400 'Invalid recipient email: ...' (the whole request is rejected if any recipient is malformed). No schedule created.

testCases.title: Non-owner/non-admin cannot create, update, or delete a schedule on another user's definition
testCases.preconditions: createReportSchedule uses getOwnedDefinition (owner/admin only); update/delete check canManage on the parent definition owner else throw.
testCases.steps:
1. user-A owns an ORG definition with a schedule.
2. As user-B (non-admin), POST a schedule on it.
3. As user-B, PATCH the existing schedule.
4. As user-B, DELETE the schedule.
testCases.expectedResult: Create -> 400 'Only the report owner or an admin can modify this report'. Update/Delete -> 400 'Only the report owner or an admin can modify this schedule'. No changes persisted.

testCases.title: Due-schedule dispatcher records a preview delivery and advances nextRunAt (Graph send parked)
testCases.preconditions: Dependency: Microsoft Graph credentials (Parked). processDueReportSchedules runs due active schedules with the OWNER's record scope, writes a SENT preview delivery, advances nextRunAt, is idempotent per scan.
testCases.steps:
1. Create an active schedule with nextRunAt in the past on an active definition.
2. Invoke processDueReportSchedules(now).
3. GET /api/v1/reports/schedules/{id}/deliveries.
4. Re-run processDueReportSchedules immediately.
testCases.expectedResult: First scan: scan result {due:1,sent:1,failed:0}; a delivery record status='sent' with detail 'Preview delivery to <recipients> (<n> rows)' and rowCount; nextRunAt advanced. No real email sent (Graph parked). Second immediate scan finds it not due (idempotent). Per-schedule format selection (FR-RPT-071) remains tied to the parked channel.

testCases.title: Dispatcher records a FAILED delivery (with reason) and still advances nextRunAt when a run errors
testCases.preconditions: processDueReportSchedules catch-block writes status='failed' with the error message and advances nextRunAt so a poison schedule cannot wedge the scanner. Owner missing -> 'Report owner not found'.
testCases.steps:
1. Create an active schedule whose definition owner has been removed/disabled so executeReport throws.
2. Invoke processDueReportSchedules(now).
3. GET deliveries for the schedule.
testCases.expectedResult: Scan result counts failed=1; a delivery record status='failed' with detail set to the thrown message (e.g. 'Report owner not found'); nextRunAt is still advanced. The failed run is logged (job id/recipient context) per NFR-RPT-011.

testCases.requirementRef: FR-RPT-074, BR (owner scope on scheduled runs), NFR-RPT-004
testCases.title: Scheduled report executes with the report owner's row-level scope, not the recipients'
testCases.preconditions: processDueReportSchedules constructs ownerActor from reportDefinition.ownerUser.roleCode and runs executeReport with it; recipients may have broader/narrower access than the owner.
testCases.steps:
1. TM owner-A creates a TEAM definition (lead_funnel) and schedules it to recipients including a non-internal email.
2. Trigger the dispatcher.
3. Inspect the produced row count vs owner-A's in-app run.
testCases.testData: owner=TM owner-A; recipients include external address
testCases.expectedResult: The delivered/preview report contains exactly the rows TM owner-A would see in-app (owner scope), regardless of recipient identity. Recipients cannot widen the data via the schedule. rowCount matches owner-A's interactive run.

testCases.title: Deliveries and schedules of a definition not visible to the actor return not-found (no enumeration)
testCases.preconditions: listReportSchedules / listReportDeliveries use findFirst with visibleWhere on the parent definition; a PRIVATE definition owned by someone else is invisible.
testCases.steps:
1. user-A owns a PRIVATE definition with a schedule and deliveries.
2. As user-B, GET /api/v1/reports/definitions/{A-private-id}/schedules.
3. As user-B, GET /api/v1/reports/schedules/{A-schedule-id}/deliveries.
testCases.expectedResult: Both return 400 'Report definition not found' / 'Report schedule not found'. user-B cannot enumerate schedules, recipients, or delivery history of a report they cannot see.

testCases.title: Admin updates the active-account window; change is persisted and audit-logged
testCases.preconditions: PUT /threshold-settings gated on admin.integration_manage; updateReportingThresholdSettings upserts FeatureFlag 'reporting.thresholds' and writes an AuditEntry (before/after).
testCases.steps:
1. As ADMIN_CSR_OPS (has admin.integration_manage), PUT /api/v1/reports/threshold-settings { activeAccountWindowDays: 180 }.
2. GET /api/v1/reports/threshold-settings.
3. Query the audit log for entityType 'reporting_threshold_settings'.
testCases.expectedResult: PUT returns 200 { settings:{ activeAccountWindowDays:180 } }. GET returns 180. An AuditEntry exists with action UPDATE, beforeData {365 default} and afterData {180}, actorUserId set.

testCases.title: Threshold update is denied to roles without admin.integration_manage (incl. EXECUTIVE/FINANCE/TM)
testCases.preconditions: PUT gated via withReportingAdminAuth (module admin + action admin.integration_manage). Only ADMIN_CSR_OPS and SUPER_ADMIN hold it; EXECUTIVE/FINANCE/TM do not.
testCases.steps:
1. As EXECUTIVE, PUT /api/v1/reports/threshold-settings { activeAccountWindowDays:200 }.
2. As FINANCE, repeat.
3. As TERRITORY_MANAGER, repeat.
4. As ADMIN_CSR_OPS, GET /threshold-settings to confirm value unchanged.
testCases.expectedResult: All three PUT attempts return 403 Forbidden. The stored window remains unchanged. (Note: read GET /threshold-settings is allowed to any reports-module role.)

testCases.title: Threshold update validates positivity and caps at the 3650-day maximum
testCases.preconditions: normalizeActiveAccountWindowDays throws for non-finite or <1; floors fractional; clamps to MAX 3650. Default 365.
testCases.steps:
1. As ADMIN_CSR_OPS, PUT { activeAccountWindowDays:0 }.
2. PUT { activeAccountWindowDays:-30 }.
3. PUT { activeAccountWindowDays:99999 }.
4. PUT { activeAccountWindowDays:30.9 }.
testCases.expectedResult: 0 and -30 -> 400 'activeAccountWindowDays must be a positive number of days'. 99999 -> 200 clamped to 3650. 30.9 -> 200 floored to 30. The persisted value never exceeds 3650.

testCases.title: Stale-accounts report lists in-scope active accounts with no engagement within the active window
testCases.preconditions: getStaleAccountsReport requires reports + customer.view; uses active-account window; selects isActive accounts with lastEngagementAt null OR < threshold; account scope applied; top 100, nulls first.
testCases.steps:
1. Set window to 90 days. Seed active accounts: some engaged recently, some > 90 days ago, some never engaged.
2. As TERRITORY_MANAGER, GET /api/v1/reports/stale-accounts.
3. Inspect windowDays, total, items.
testCases.testData: window=90; mix of engaged/stale/never-engaged accounts in TM book
testCases.expectedResult: 200 with windowDays=90; items include only in-scope active accounts that are never-engaged (lastEngagementAt null, listed first) or engaged > 90 days ago; recently engaged accounts excluded; daysSinceEngagement computed (null for never-engaged); capped at 100; total reflects full matching count.

testCases.title: Order-based 'lost account' definition remains parked; only engagement-based staleness is built
testCases.preconditions: FR-RPT-015 Partial: engagement-based staleness shipped; the order-based 'lost' (no order in window) half is Acumatica-gated.
testCases.steps:
1. Review the stale-accounts report semantics.
2. Confirm it keys off lastEngagementAt (training/visit/voice note/ROSE audit), not last order date.
testCases.testData: Account engaged recently but with no orders for >1yr
testCases.expectedResult: An account recently engaged but not ordering is NOT flagged (engagement-based definition). The order-based lost-account list is documented as Parked on Acumatica order history and not fabricated.

testCases.title: Stale-accounts report denied to reports roles lacking customer.view
testCases.preconditions: getStaleAccountsReport asserts module 'reports' AND action 'customer.view'. TRAINING_OPS lacks customer.view.
testCases.steps:
1. Log in as TRAINING_OPS.
2. GET /api/v1/reports/stale-accounts.
testCases.expectedResult: 403 Forbidden (customer.view gate). The account-data report is not exposed to a role without customer visibility.

testCases.title: Report run can be exported to CSV, Excel (.xls), and PDF; dashboard tiles export too
testCases.preconditions: CSV+Excel(.xls SpreadsheetML)+PDF(jsPDF) download on report runs (9ba66fa); dashboard-tile export on Lead SLA-at-risk, Training overdue, Executive exceptions via downloadTable* (2e68274/6f79a4d/5272f73).
testCases.steps:
1. Run a saved report; export as CSV, then Excel, then PDF.
2. Open each file and verify columns/rows match the on-screen table.
3. On the Lead dashboard, export the SLA-at-risk tile.
testCases.testData: Any report run with multiple rows; Lead SLA-at-risk tile
testCases.expectedResult: All three formats download with header row + data rows matching the rendered table. The SLA-at-risk dashboard tile exports correctly. (Per-schedule export format selection stays tied to the parked delivery channel - FR-RPT-071.)

testCases.title: Exported CSV neutralizes formula-injection payloads and preserves unicode/special characters
testCases.preconditions: Account/company names are free text and can contain leading =,+,-,@ (CSV/Excel formula triggers) and unicode. Export must not execute formulas when opened in a spreadsheet.
testCases.steps:
1. Create a lead/account with companyName '=cmd|calc'!A1' and another with unicode 'Müller & Söhne ☃'.
2. Run a report that surfaces the name and export to CSV/Excel.
3. Open the file in a spreadsheet app.
testCases.expectedResult: The '=' / '+' / '-' / '@'-leading cell is treated as text (escaped/quoted) and no formula executes on open. Unicode characters render intact. No cell is interpreted as a live formula.

testCases.title: Default dashboard KPI cards load within 2 seconds on warm cache under concurrent load
testCases.preconditions: NFR-RPT-001 (<2s warm); NFR-RPT-007 (>=500 concurrent sessions). Dashboards compute server-side via batched Promise.all aggregates.
testCases.steps:
1. Warm the cache for the Lead dashboard.
2. Measure GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/leads p95 latency.
3. Run a 500-concurrent-session load test against the dashboard endpoints at month-end data volume.
testCases.expectedResult: p95 default-dashboard load <= 2s on warm cache; no error-rate degradation at 500 concurrent sessions; aggregate endpoints remain responsive.

testCases.title: Report run returns within 5 seconds for datasets up to 10,000 rows
testCases.preconditions: NFR-RPT-002 (<5s for 10k rows). lead_funnel materializes up to 25k rows for in-memory aggregation.
testCases.steps:
1. Seed ~10,000 leads in the report window.
2. POST /api/v1/reports/run { reportKey:'lead_funnel', config:{wide window} }.
3. Measure latency.
testCases.expectedResult: The run completes within 5 seconds and returns correct per-stage aggregates. No timeout.

testCases.title: All reporting endpoints require authentication (401 when unauthenticated)
testCases.preconditions: withReportsAuth / withReportingAdminAuth call requireAuthenticatedActor; isAuthenticationError -> 401 unauthorized.
testCases.steps:
1. Without a session token, GET /api/v1/reports/definitions.
2. POST /api/v1/reports/run with no auth.
3. GET /api/v1/reports/dashboard/executive with no auth.
4. PUT /api/v1/reports/threshold-settings with no auth.
testCases.expectedResult: Every endpoint returns 401 Unauthorized. No data, dashboard, or config is returned to an unauthenticated caller.

testCases.title: Unsupported HTTP methods on reporting routes return 405 with Allow set
testCases.preconditions: Route handlers return methodNotAllowedResponse for unsupported verbs (e.g. dashboards GET-only; /run POST-only; definitions GET/POST).
testCases.steps:
1. DELETE /api/v1/reports/dashboard/leads.
2. GET /api/v1/reports/run.
3. PUT /api/v1/reports/definitions.
testCases.expectedResult: Each returns 405 Method Not Allowed listing the permitted methods (dashboards: GET; /run: POST; definitions: GET,POST). Threshold-settings advertises GET,PUT.

testCases.title: Clicking a KPI card drills into the filtered list behind the number
testCases.preconditions: FR-RPT-005 Partial: KPI cards drill down by navigating to the module list (in-place filtered drawer is the later richer version).
testCases.steps:
1. As EXECUTIVE, open the dashboard.
2. Click the 'Training Overdue' (or 'SLA at risk') KPI card.
3. Observe navigation/target.
testCases.expectedResult: The click navigates to the underlying filtered list (e.g. the overdue-training list) whose row count matches the KPI value N. (In-place filtered drawer is a pending enhancement.)

testCases.title: Dashboard chart widget toggles between bar, line, and area; builder chart-type wiring still pending
testCases.preconditions: Shared ReportChart bar/line/area toggle via @mantine/charts on Lead/Training/Executive (f48fa32). FR-RPT-067 builder output wiring is Partial/pending.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the Lead dashboard chart widget.
2. Toggle bar -> line -> area.
3. Open the report builder and attempt to set a chart type on the saved report output.
testCases.testData: Lead dashboard chart; builder chart-type control
testCases.expectedResult: Dashboard chart re-renders correctly in all three modes (bar/line/area). The builder chart-type selection is not yet wired into saved-report output (documented Partial - FR-RPT-067).

testCases.title: Drag-drop any-field selector, arbitrary sort, pre-save preview, and Priority Subjects tile section are not yet built
testCases.preconditions: Implemented builder picks one of 5 fixed report types (REPORT_KEYS), not arbitrary fields. FR-RPT-060/062/063/068 Not-built; FR-RPT-068 saved-reports list exists but no pre-built tile section.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the report builder.
2. Attempt to drag an arbitrary Pulse field into the report.
3. Attempt to set an arbitrary sort field/direction.
4. Look for a pre-save 'Preview' tab and a 'Priority Reporting Subjects' tile section.
testCases.expectedResult: Only the 5 fixed report types are selectable; there is no arbitrary-field drag-drop, no arbitrary sort control, no dedicated pre-save preview tab, and no Priority Reporting Subjects pre-built tile section. These remain Not-built per §12.

testCases.title: All revenue/YoY/Top-N revenue widgets are parked behind Acumatica/legacy migration
testCases.preconditions: Dependency: Acumatica order/invoice sync + QuickBooks 2024 legacy migration (§6, ASM-RPT-001/003). FR-RPT-007/012/013/014/016/017/019/028/029/032/036/037/038/075/078 + revenue half of 015/077 Parked.
testCases.steps:
1. Open Executive/TM/RD dashboards.
2. Locate revenue-by-month, YoY-by-group/location, revenue-by-TM/state, Top-N revenue, aging receivables, seasonal-pattern widgets.
testCases.expectedResult: Every $/revenue/YoY widget renders as a dashed 'awaiting Acumatica sync' placeholder (NFR-RPT-015) with no fabricated number. CRM-native widgets on the same dashboard still render real data. No revenue figure is computed by Pulse.

testCases.title: Auto-email of prior-month sales / monthly training-overdue is built as a schedule but email send is parked on Graph
testCases.preconditions: Dependency: Microsoft Graph sendMail credentials (Parked). Scheduling + preview dispatcher built (training_compliance schedulable monthly); actual mailbox delivery parked.
testCases.steps:
1. Create a monthly schedule (hourUtc, 1st-of-month) on a training_compliance / lead report definition with recipients.
2. Trigger the dispatcher when due.
3. Inspect deliveries and confirm no real email is sent.
testCases.expectedResult: The monthly schedule is created and the dispatcher records a preview SENT delivery with row count, advancing nextRunAt to the next 1st-of-month. No actual email leaves the system until Graph credentials are certified (FR-RPT-074 Parked).

testCases.title: Member-list penetration % and new-account-count widgets are not yet built (CRM-native, pending import/definition)
testCases.preconditions: FR-RPT-076 Not-built (member-list import dependency; metric definition OQ-RPT-010 open). FR-RPT-079 Not-built (CRM onboarding/first-order date).
testCases.steps:
1. Open Executive/Sales dashboards.
2. Look for the affinity member-list penetration % tile and the new-accounts-by-month / by-owner widgets.
testCases.expectedResult: Neither the member-list penetration tile nor the new-account-count widgets are present. Both are documented Not-built: FR-RPT-076 blocked on member-list import and an open metric definition (OQ-RPT-010); FR-RPT-079 pending CRM onboarding/first-order-date work.

testCases.title: Concurrent delete then run/update of the same definition resolves safely without a stale read
testCases.preconditions: runReportDefinition/getOwnedDefinition re-fetch the definition each call; a deleted definition yields not-found. No cached authorization across the delete boundary.
testCases.steps:
1. As owner, start a run of definition D.
2. Concurrently DELETE definition D.
3. Immediately POST /api/v1/reports/definitions/{D}/run again.
testCases.expectedResult: The post-delete run returns 'Report definition not found' (no stale execution against deleted config). No orphaned schedule continues to resolve D for new runs; the first in-flight run either completes against the pre-delete snapshot or fails cleanly - no partial/corrupt result.

testCases.title: Assign a price class code during lead conversion preparation (happy path)
testCases.preconditions: Lead exists with a CIS package finance-approved; readiness checklist generated; actor has a role holding lead.intake_manage and the lead is within the actor's record scope (e.g. ADMIN_CSR_OPS, SALES_BD_REP, or SUPER_ADMIN).
testCases.steps:
1. Open the lead's Conversion Preparation / Onboarding Ready panel.
2. Enter 'A3' in the Price Class Code field.
3. Save the preparation (PATCH /leads/{leadId}/conversion-preparation with priceClassCode='A3').
4. Reload the readiness detail.
testCases.testData: leadId of a finance-approved lead; priceClassCode='A3'
testCases.expectedResult: Preparation persists priceClassCode='A3'; the 'price_class_assigned' checklist item flips to COMPLETED; the 'Price class is not assigned.' readiness blocker is removed; readinessState.priceClassResolvedAt is set; an UPDATE audit entry for LEAD_CONVERSION_PREPARATION recording priceClassCode='A3' is written.

testCases.title: Update an existing price class code and verify audit before/after
testCases.preconditions: Lead conversion preparation already has priceClassCode='A1'; actor holds lead.intake_manage and lead is in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the conversion preparation with existing priceClassCode='A1'.
2. Change the Price Class Code field to 'EDL'.
3. Save.
4. Inspect the audit log for the LEAD_CONVERSION_PREPARATION entity.
testCases.expectedResult: priceClassCode is updated to 'EDL'; reviewedAt and reviewedByUserId are updated to the actor; an UPDATE audit entry is created capturing the new priceClassCode='EDL' in afterData. (Note: current audit afterData records only the new value, not old/new pair — full FR-PRC-013 immutable old→new price-change ledger is Not-built.)

testCases.title: Clear an assigned price class code (set to empty) re-opens the blocker
testCases.preconditions: Lead conversion preparation has priceClassCode='A3'; actor holds lead.intake_manage; lead in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the conversion preparation.
2. Clear the Price Class Code field (submit priceClassCode='' / whitespace).
3. Save.
4. Reload readiness detail.
testCases.expectedResult: optionalTrimmed reduces empty/whitespace to null; priceClassCode is stored as null; 'price_class_assigned' checklist item returns to PENDING; 'Price class is not assigned.' blocker reappears; priceClassResolvedAt is cleared to null.

testCases.title: Omitting priceClassCode in a partial update preserves the existing value
testCases.preconditions: Lead conversion preparation has priceClassCode='A3'; actor holds lead.intake_manage; lead in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH the conversion preparation with only targetAccountName changed and no priceClassCode key in the payload.
2. Save.
3. Reload the preparation.
testCases.expectedResult: Because input.priceClassCode is undefined, the existing value is retained; priceClassCode remains 'A3' (not nulled); the price_class_assigned checklist item stays COMPLETED.

testCases.title: Update price class on a non-existent lead returns not-found
testCases.preconditions: Actor holds lead.intake_manage. The supplied leadId does not exist.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /leads/{bogusLeadId}/conversion-preparation with priceClassCode='A1'.
2. Observe the response.
testCases.expectedResult: Service throws 'Lead not found: {leadId}' (mapped to a 404 / not-found response). No preparation row is created; no audit entry is written.

testCases.title: Unauthenticated request to set price class is rejected
testCases.preconditions: No valid session token / cookie supplied.
testCases.steps:
1. Send PATCH /leads/{leadId}/conversion-preparation with priceClassCode='A1' and no/invalid auth token.
2. Observe the response.
testCases.testData: Authorization header absent or invalid token
testCases.expectedResult: Request is rejected at the auth boundary with 401 Unauthorized; no DB read/write of pricing data occurs; price data is not exposed to an unauthenticated caller (NFR-PRC-10).

testCases.title: TERRITORY_MANAGER cannot write a price class (lacks lead.intake_manage)
testCases.preconditions: Actor role is TERRITORY_MANAGER (has lead.view but NOT lead.intake_manage). A lead within the TM's book exists.
testCases.steps:
1. As the TM, attempt PATCH /leads/{leadId}/conversion-preparation with priceClassCode='A3'.
2. Observe the response.
testCases.expectedResult: assertActionAccess(role,'lead.intake_manage') throws AuthorizationError -> 403 Forbidden. priceClassCode is unchanged. Confirms default-deny: a scoped sales role cannot edit pricing-relevant onboarding data.

testCases.title: REGIONAL_DIRECTOR cannot write a price class (lacks lead.intake_manage)
testCases.preconditions: Actor role is REGIONAL_DIRECTOR (lead.view only).
testCases.steps:
1. As the RD, attempt PATCH /leads/{leadId}/conversion-preparation with priceClassCode='A1'.
2. Observe the response.
testCases.expectedResult: AuthorizationError -> 403 Forbidden; no write occurs.

testCases.title: FINANCE role (checklist owner) cannot itself set the price class code
testCases.preconditions: Actor role is FINANCE. Note FINANCE is the ownerRoleCode for the 'price_class_assigned' checklist item but FINANCE's action set does NOT include lead.intake_manage.
testCases.steps:
1. As FINANCE, attempt PATCH /leads/{leadId}/conversion-preparation with priceClassCode='A3'.
2. Observe the response.
testCases.expectedResult: AuthorizationError -> 403 Forbidden. Documents a workflow gap: the role that OWNS the price-class checklist item cannot set the code through the preparation endpoint; an ADMIN_CSR_OPS/SALES rep must enter it.

testCases.title: DEALER_PORTAL_USER cannot access the leads module to set price class
testCases.preconditions: Actor role is DEALER_PORTAL_USER (module access limited to home/calendar/dealer_portal/notifications; no 'leads' module).
testCases.steps:
1. As DEALER_PORTAL_USER, attempt PATCH /leads/{leadId}/conversion-preparation with priceClassCode='A1'.
2. Observe the response.
testCases.expectedResult: assertModuleAccess(role,'leads') throws AuthorizationError -> 403 Forbidden. A dealer cannot reach or modify CRM-side price-class assignment.

testCases.title: TERRITORY_MANAGER can read price class only for leads within their book
