testCases.preconditions: Two leads exist: leadA assigned to the TM's book, leadB in another TM's book. Both have priceClassCode set. Actor is TERRITORY_MANAGER with lead.view.
testCases.steps:
1. As the TM, GET /leads/{leadA}/conversion-preparation.
2. As the same TM, GET /leads/{leadB}/conversion-preparation.
testCases.expectedResult: leadA returns the preparation incl. its priceClassCode (200). leadB returns null/404 because isLeadVisibleToActor resolves the TM record scope and excludes leadB — confirming record-level visibility scoping for pricing data (no cross-territory price leak).

testCases.title: IDOR: scoped role guessing another territory's leadId cannot read its price class
testCases.preconditions: Actor is TERRITORY_MANAGER. A valid leadId belonging to a different territory is known/guessed by the attacker.
testCases.steps:
1. As the TM, directly call GET /leads/{otherTerritoryLeadId}/conversion-preparation by enumerating the id.
2. Observe the response.
testCases.expectedResult: Response is null/404 (isLeadVisibleToActor returns false before any data is loaded); the foreign lead's priceClassCode, addresses and finance state are never returned. No information disclosure that distinguishes 'exists but forbidden' from 'not found'.

testCases.title: Price class code accepts an arbitrary/unknown value (no master-list validation)
testCases.preconditions: Actor holds lead.intake_manage; lead in scope. No price-class master/catalog exists in Pulse.
testCases.steps:
1. Enter 'ZZ-NOT-A-REAL-CLASS' in the Price Class Code field.
2. Save.
3. Reload the preparation.
testCases.expectedResult: DEFECT/GAP: the value is accepted and stored verbatim; price_class_assigned flips to COMPLETED. There is no validation against a list of ~34 valid classes (FR-PRC-001 master is Not-built). Documents that any free-text passes — a data-quality risk to be raised.

testCases.title: Very long price class string is stored without a length cap
testCases.preconditions: Actor holds lead.intake_manage; lead in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. Enter a 5,000-character string in the Price Class Code field.
2. Save.
3. Reload and inspect the stored value.
testCases.expectedResult: Either the DB column rejects the oversized value (constraint error surfaced as a clean 4xx) or it is truncated/stored. There is no application-level max-length guard on the input, so verify the behaviour and flag absence of a sensible cap as a data-quality concern.

testCases.title: Price class code with SQL/script payload and unicode is stored safely (no injection)
testCases.preconditions: Actor holds lead.intake_manage; lead in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. Enter the payload in the Price Class Code field.
2. Save.
3. Reload the preparation and view it on the readiness panel.
testCases.expectedResult: Prisma parameterises the value; it is stored verbatim with no SQL executed and the DB intact. The value is escaped/rendered as inert text in the UI (no script execution). Trimming applies but content is preserved; unicode round-trips correctly.

testCases.title: Leading/trailing whitespace around the code is trimmed before storage
testCases.preconditions: Actor holds lead.intake_manage; lead in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. Enter '  A3  ' (padded) in the Price Class Code field.
2. Save.
3. Reload and inspect the stored value.
testCases.expectedResult: optionalTrimmed strips surrounding whitespace; stored value is exactly 'A3'. (Note: internal casing/spacing is NOT normalised, so 'a3' and 'A3' would be distinct values — a normalisation gap to flag.)

testCases.title: Concurrent edits to the same lead's price class — last write wins without corruption
testCases.preconditions: Two authorised editors open the same lead's conversion preparation simultaneously; lead has priceClassCode='A1'.
testCases.steps:
1. Editor 1 submits priceClassCode='A3'.
2. Editor 2 (with stale view) submits priceClassCode='EDL' immediately after.
3. Reload the preparation.
testCases.expectedResult: Each update runs in its own transaction; the final stored value is the last committed write ('EDL'); both writes produce audit entries; no partial/garbled value results. Documents there is no optimistic-lock/version check (no conflict 409) — last-write-wins is the current behaviour.

testCases.title: price_class_assigned checklist item auto-completes/reverts with the code
testCases.preconditions: Lead has a generated onboarding checklist (post finance approval). Actor holds lead.intake_manage.
testCases.steps:
1. Confirm 'Price class assigned' checklist item is PENDING with no code.
2. Set priceClassCode='A1' and save; re-check the item.
3. Clear priceClassCode and save; re-check the item.
testCases.expectedResult: syncAutomaticChecklistItems drives the item: COMPLETED when a non-empty code is present, PENDING when absent. The item's ownerRoleCode is FINANCE and sortOrder 50. State tracks the code automatically (no manual toggle needed).

testCases.title: Lead cannot be converted while price class is unassigned
testCases.preconditions: Lead is finance-approved with checklist generated but priceClassCode is null; actor holds customer.create and lead is in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. Attempt convertLeadOnFirstOrder for the lead.
2. Observe the response and blockers.
testCases.expectedResult: Conversion is rejected: 'Lead is not ready for conversion' with blockers including 'Price class is not assigned.' No Account is created. Confirms price-class is a hard onboarding gate.

testCases.title: No automatic default to generic A1 when price class is left blank
testCases.preconditions: Lead finance-approved, checklist generated, priceClassCode left blank through to activation; actor holds lead.intake_manage.
testCases.steps:
1. Complete onboarding leaving Price Class Code empty.
2. Observe whether the system assigns the generic A1 default and whether an admin alert is raised for a customer left on generic.
testCases.expectedResult: GAP: the system does NOT default to A1; instead it blocks conversion (see PRC-TC-019) and raises no 'customer remained on generic class' alert. FR-PRC-003 (generic default + admin alert) is unbuilt — record as Not-built.

testCases.title: Admin CRUD of residential price classes (create/edit/deactivate)
testCases.preconditions: Per §0 this is DE-SCOPED from Pulse — the class catalog is owned by the existing pricing system. No create/edit/deactivate endpoints exist in Pulse.
testCases.steps:
1. Attempt to create a price class with code/display name/currency/affinity group/effective date.
2. Attempt to edit and to deactivate it.
testCases.testData: code='A3', displayName='Service Experts', currency='USD', affinityGroup='SE', effectiveDate='2026-01-01'
testCases.expectedResult: No such endpoint or UI exists in Pulse. Test cannot execute; FR-PRC-001 is Not-built and de-scoped (price-class master authoring stays in the separate pricing system, see PRD §0). Verify Pulse only references, never authors, the class list.

testCases.title: USD and CAD price classes are maintained as separate, non-contaminating sets
testCases.preconditions: Per §0 price-class master authoring (incl. currency isolation) is de-scoped from Pulse. priceClassCode in Pulse is a free-text string with no currency attribute.
testCases.steps:
1. Inspect the Pulse data model for a currency field on the price class.
2. Attempt to assign a CAD class to a US account and check for cross-currency guard.
testCases.expectedResult: Pulse stores only a code string with no currency dimension and no isolation logic; there is no validation preventing a CAD code on a US account. FR-PRC-004 is Not-built / de-scoped — currency isolation lives in the source pricing system.

testCases.title: Wildcard rule definition, expansion to stock items, pinned overrides and % increase preview
testCases.preconditions: Per §0 the entire wildcard engine is DE-SCOPED from Pulse and stays in the LAMP/MSSQL system. No engine, rules table, or expansion job exists in Pulse.
testCases.steps:
1. Attempt to define a wildcard rule (pattern, size class, product group, formula, precedence).
2. Apply rules and expect expansion to per-SKU prices.
3. Pin a SKU price and apply a product-group % increase with preview.
testCases.testData: pattern e.g. 'PANEL-*', group='panels', increase=+4%; pinned SKU price $30
testCases.expectedResult: No rule engine exists in Pulse. Tests are non-executable here. FR-PRC-005–009 Not-built and de-scoped; NFR-PRC-01 (130 rules -> 6,600 prices within 60s) is not applicable to Pulse. Verify Pulse consumes expanded prices rather than computing them.

testCases.title: Admin must approve a SKU/current/new/%-change preview before publish
testCases.preconditions: De-scoped from Pulse (engine resides in the source system). No preview/commit workflow in Pulse.
testCases.steps: 1. Initiate a price change and expect a preview table (SKU, current price, new price, % change, effective date) requiring explicit approval.
testCases.expectedResult: No preview-before-commit workflow exists in Pulse. FR-PRC-009 Not-built / de-scoped. Confirm Pulse does not author price changes.

testCases.title: Create named price-increase event with staggered per-class effective dates
testCases.preconditions: De-scoped from Pulse per §0; annual price-increase authoring stays in the existing system.
testCases.steps:
1. Attempt to create a named event '2026 Residential Price Increase' with participants and target effective dates.
2. Set per-affinity-group staggered effective dates (e.g. +15 days, +1 month, +1 year).
testCases.expectedResult: No price-increase event entity/workflow exists in Pulse. FR-PRC-010/011 Not-built and de-scoped. Pulse only records (externally negotiated) dates if/when surfaced, but does not author the event.

testCases.title: Draft routed to a named checker who can approve or send back before outputs
testCases.preconditions: De-scoped from Pulse per §0.
testCases.steps:
1. After applying a price increase, assign a checker (e.g. Stephanie) and route the draft to their queue.
2. Checker approves or returns with comments; verify approval gates output generation.
testCases.expectedResult: No checker queue/approval workflow exists in Pulse. FR-PRC-012 Not-built / de-scoped.

testCases.title: Immutable, exportable price-change ledger (user/old/new/SKU/class/date) retained 7 years
testCases.preconditions: De-scoped from Pulse per §0 (price authoring lives elsewhere). Pulse only writes generic AuditEntry rows for priceClassCode changes on the lead prep record.
testCases.steps:
1. Change a price (in the source system) and expect an immutable old->new ledger entry.
2. Attempt to edit/delete the audit entry as ADMIN/SUPER_ADMIN.
3. Verify 7-year retention.
testCases.expectedResult: No dedicated price-change ledger exists in Pulse (FR-PRC-013 de-scoped). Pulse's AuditEntry for priceClassCode is not an immutable-by-design price ledger and records only the new code. NFR-PRC-05 immutability and NFR-PRC-06 7-year retention are Not-built/unverified in Pulse — flag for the source system.

testCases.title: Query 'price of SKU X on date Y for class Z' from retained history
testCases.preconditions: De-scoped from Pulse per §0.
testCases.steps: 1. Query historical price for a SKU at a past effective date and price class.
testCases.expectedResult: No price-version history store exists in Pulse. FR-PRC-014 Not-built / de-scoped.

testCases.feature: Acumatica Sales Price Worksheet CSV export
testCases.title: Generate Acumatica price-worksheet CSV (CustomerPriceClassID, InventoryID, SalesPrice...)
testCases.preconditions: De-scoped from Pulse per §0 — output generation stays in the source pricing system. Acumatica API push is additionally Parked pending REST sandbox certification (Parked Dependencies table + OQ-PRC-01).
testCases.steps:
1. Trigger Acumatica CSV export for a price class.
2. Validate columns and 2dp prices against the sample (SRC-PRC-008).
3. Attempt the API push variant.
testCases.testData: Price class A1; expected columns CustomerPriceClassID, InventoryID, SalesPrice, EffectiveDate, ExpirationDate
testCases.expectedResult: No CSV export exists in Pulse. Output generation de-scoped; the Acumatica API push path is Parked behind REST certification. Mark Parked — verify when integration is certified.

testCases.title: Generate Bold Commerce Shopify import CSV per applicable price class
testCases.preconditions: De-scoped from Pulse per §0; Bold Commerce CSV push is Parked behind dealer-portal go-live (Parked Dependencies table).
testCases.steps:
1. Trigger Bold Commerce CSV export for a price class.
2. Validate format against the sample (SRC-PRC-009).
testCases.testData: Price class A1; Bold Commerce import format
testCases.expectedResult: No Bold Commerce CSV export exists in Pulse and the dependency is Parked behind dealer portal go-live. Mark Parked.

testCases.title: Generate per-class Excel files and trigger a single bulk run of all outputs
testCases.preconditions: De-scoped from Pulse per §0 — output generation stays in the source system.
testCases.steps:
1. Generate an Excel price list for one price class (SKU, description, price, size class, effective date).
2. Trigger bulk generation of all outputs for all 35 classes and expect async queueing + completion notification.
testCases.expectedResult: No Excel export or bulk-generation orchestration exists in Pulse. FR-PRC-017/019 Not-built / de-scoped; NFR-PRC-02 (all outputs for 35 classes within 10 min) not applicable to Pulse.

testCases.title: Generate branded per-class PDF price sheet with product images
testCases.preconditions: De-scoped from Pulse per §0; additionally blocked/Parked on product images existing in the Pulse product catalog (Parked Dependencies + ASM-PRC-006).
testCases.steps: 1. Trigger PDF price-sheet generation for a price class with product images, names, descriptions, prices and branding/private-label logo.
testCases.testData: Price class A1 with catalog images present
testCases.expectedResult: No PDF generation exists in Pulse and it is Parked pending product images in the catalog. Mark Parked.

testCases.title: Dealer views/downloads only their assigned price sheet; cannot see other classes
testCases.preconditions: Per §0 FR-PRC-020 STAYS in Pulse scope (Pulse surfaces the externally-generated sheet) but is Not-built; the sheet itself is sourced from Acumatica / Dan's pricing DB. Dealer portal price resolution is Not-built (PRD §10).
testCases.steps:
1. As a DEALER_PORTAL_USER assigned to class A1, open the dealer portal and request the price sheet.
2. Attempt to access/download a sheet for a class the dealer is not assigned to (e.g. A3).
testCases.testData: dealer assigned class A1; attempts to fetch A3 sheet
testCases.expectedResult: When built: dealer sees/downloads only their A1 sheet; any attempt to fetch A3 returns 403/404 (no cross-class exposure, NFR-PRC-10). Currently no dealer-portal price-sheet surface exists — Not-built; test is a forward spec.

testCases.title: Dealer portal applies the dealer's assigned price class to their catalog view
testCases.preconditions: FR-PRC-021 Not-built (PRD §10: 'Dealer portal price class resolution — Not-built'). Pricing pulled from Acumatica / pricing DB per §0.
testCases.steps:
1. Dealer logs into the portal.
2. System resolves their assigned price class and applies the correct prices to the catalog.
3. Confirm no dealer sees another dealer's pricing.
testCases.testData: Dealer A (class A1) vs Dealer B (class A3)
testCases.expectedResult: When built: each dealer's catalog shows prices for their own class only; no cross-dealer price exposure. Currently no resolution logic exists — FR-PRC-021 Not-built. Record as forward spec.

testCases.title: System warns when a price-class entry exceeds the product base (highest) price
testCases.preconditions: De-scoped from Pulse per §0 (Shopify-compatibility base-price constraint stays in the source system).
testCases.steps:
1. Enter a class price higher than the product's base (highest) price.
2. Expect a validation warning that the base must be raised first.
testCases.expectedResult: No base-price validation exists in Pulse. FR-PRC-022 Not-built / de-scoped (the known 'I don't raise the base price' bug is handled in the source system).

testCases.feature: Price class visible on account profile
testCases.title: Assigned price class displayed on the converted account/customer profile
testCases.preconditions: A lead with priceClassCode='A3' is converted to an Account. PRD §10/§5.6 note: priceClassCode exists on the lead but is NOT surfaced on the account profile and account-level storage is not confirmed.
testCases.steps:
1. Convert the lead to an account.
2. Open the account/customer profile page.
3. Look for the assigned price class (e.g. 'A3') without navigating into a sub-section.
testCases.expectedResult: GAP: convertLeadOnFirstOrder does NOT copy priceClassCode onto the Account record, and the profile page does not display it. FR-PRC-023 Not-built — the code is stranded on the lead conversion-preparation record. Flag the data-carryover gap.

testCases.title: Instant-rebate flag shown on account profile for reference (no calculation)
testCases.preconditions: FR-PRC-024 Not-built. No instantRebateFlag field exists in the lead/account data model (grep confirms zero references). Rebate calculation explicitly out of scope (ASM-PRC-004).
testCases.steps:
1. During onboarding, attempt to set an instant-rebate flag.
2. Open the account profile and look for a reference-only instant-rebate indicator.
testCases.expectedResult: No instant-rebate flag field or UI exists in Pulse. FR-PRC-024 Not-built; the CRM correctly performs no rebate calculation, but the reference indicator is also absent. Source/ownership (Acumatica vs CRM) is open (OQ-PRC-07).

testCases.title: Dedicated pricing_admin / pricing_editor roles gate price-class/rule/event changes
testCases.preconditions: NFR-PRC-04 requires explicit pricing_admin/pricing_editor roles. The Pulse role set (AUTH_ROLES) contains no such roles; no 'pricing' module exists in WORKSPACE_MODULES.
testCases.steps:
1. Enumerate AUTH_ROLES and the workspace module/action maps.
2. Look for pricing_admin / pricing_editor and a 'pricing' module with read-only dealer/TM access to own price sheet.
testCases.expectedResult: No pricing_admin/pricing_editor roles and no 'pricing' module exist. NFR-PRC-04 is Not-built. Today price-class write is governed by the generic lead.intake_manage action — flag that the intended dedicated pricing RBAC does not exist (Curry: 'I don't want anybody...changing price books').

testCases.title: Acumatica-exported price matches dealer-portal price to 2dp; discrepancy logged/warned
testCases.preconditions: De-scoped from Pulse per §0 (export + portal price both sourced externally / Parked). No reconciliation logic in Pulse.
testCases.steps:
1. Compare the Acumatica CSV price and the dealer-portal price for the same SKU/class.
2. Introduce a 1-cent mismatch and expect a logged warning before export.
testCases.expectedResult: No cross-source price reconciliation exists in Pulse. NFR-PRC-03 Not-built / dependent on de-scoped export + Parked portal pricing. Mark Parked.

testCases.title: Every CSV/PDF export logs user, timestamp, class, row count, file size, warnings
testCases.preconditions: De-scoped from Pulse per §0 (no export functionality in Pulse).
testCases.steps: 1. Run an export and inspect logs for user, timestamp, price class, row count, file size and validation warnings.
testCases.expectedResult: No export and therefore no export-observability logging exists in Pulse. NFR-PRC-08 Not-built / de-scoped.

testCases.title: Setting/changing priceClassCode writes an AuditEntry with actor and value
testCases.preconditions: Actor holds lead.intake_manage; lead in scope.
testCases.steps:
1. Set priceClassCode='A3' on the conversion preparation.
2. Query the AuditEntry table for entityType=LEAD_CONVERSION_PREPARATION, entityId=leadId.
testCases.expectedResult: An UPDATE AuditEntry is created with actorUserId, actorRole, actorType, sessionId and afterData.priceClassCode='A3'. Confirms basic accountability exists, though it is the generic CRM audit (not a dedicated immutable price ledger per FR-PRC-013/NFR-PRC-05).

testCases.title: No residential/commercial channel flag on price-class assignment
testCases.preconditions: Phase 1 is residential-only (Out of Scope §4.2). OQ-PRC-08 asks whether a channel flag is needed now.
testCases.steps: 1. Inspect the price-class assignment fields for a residential/commercial channel attribute.
testCases.expectedResult: priceClassCode is a single free-text string with no channel dimension; no residential/commercial flag exists. Consistent with residential-only Phase 1; record OQ-PRC-08 as an open extensibility decision.

testCases.title: Dealer user authenticates at /dealer/login and reaches dealer workspace
testCases.preconditions: An active DEALER_PORTAL_USER exists with a known password and is linked to an active dealer Account.
testCases.steps:
1. Navigate to /dealer/login.
2. Enter the dealer user's email and password.
3. Submit.
4. Observe redirect target and session.
testCases.expectedResult: Authentication succeeds; session is created with role DEALER_PORTAL_USER; user lands on the dealer dashboard; server validates the dealer-portal session on each subsequent request.

testCases.title: Internal Pulse user is denied/redirected when accessing dealer routes
testCases.preconditions: An internal Pulse user (e.g. ADMIN_CSR_OPS) is authenticated in the internal workspace, no DEALER_PORTAL_USER session.
testCases.steps:
1. Authenticate as an internal Pulse user.
2. Attempt to GET /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/dashboard.
3. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: Request is rejected (403/redirect message); internal users cannot access dealer 'me' routes; loadActiveDealerPortalUser finds no active DealerPortalUser linked to that user id and throws.

testCases.title: Unauthenticated request to dealer 'me' endpoint returns 401
testCases.preconditions: No session cookie / bearer token presented.
testCases.steps:
1. Send GET /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/cart with no auth.
2. Observe HTTP status.
testCases.expectedResult: Server responds 401 Unauthorized (requireAuthenticatedActor throws an authentication error handled as unauthorizedResponse); no cart data returned.

testCases.title: Admin staff provisions a dealer portal user linked to an Account
testCases.preconditions: Internal actor holds lead.portal_setup (ADMIN_CSR_OPS). Target Account is active.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/dealer-portal/accounts/{accountId}/users with contact/email + accessRole.
2. Observe response.
3. Verify portal user record and temporary password/invite token.
testCases.expectedResult: 201 Created; DealerPortalUser created linked to the Account with the given access role; temporaryPassword (and inviteToken/invitePath) returned; event is audit-logged with actor and timestamp.

testCases.title: Provisioning is rejected for an inactive Account
testCases.preconditions: Internal actor holds lead.portal_setup. Target Account exists but is inactive.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/dealer-portal/accounts/{inactiveAccountId}/users with valid body.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: Request fails with 400 and message 'Inactive accounts cannot receive dealer portal access'; no portal user created.

testCases.title: Duplicate provisioning for the same contact/email is rejected
testCases.preconditions: A DealerPortalUser already exists for the target contact/email on the account.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/dealer-portal/accounts/{accountId}/users reusing the existing contact/email.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: Request fails with message 'A dealer portal user already exists for this contact or email'; no duplicate record created.

testCases.title: Provisioning without contactId requires firstName and lastName
testCases.preconditions: Internal actor holds lead.portal_setup. No contactId supplied.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/dealer-portal/accounts/{accountId}/users with email only, no contactId/firstName/lastName.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: Request fails with 'firstName and lastName are required when contactId is not provided'.

testCases.title: Field rep / TM without lead.portal_setup cannot provision dealer users (default-deny)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated internal actor whose role does NOT include lead.portal_setup (e.g. a field/territory rep role).
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/dealer-portal/accounts/{accountId}/users with a valid body.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: 403 Forbidden; provisioning is denied; only roles granting lead.portal_setup (e.g. ADMIN_CSR_OPS) may provision.

testCases.title: Company admin invites a non-admin portal user via Account Center
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated DEALER_PORTAL_USER with accessRole=admin; Account is active.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/users with firstName, lastName, email, accessRole.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: 201 Created; new portal user created on the admin's own account with the chosen non-admin role; inviteToken, invitePath, and expiresAt returned.

testCases.title: Company admin cannot self-create an additional admin user
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated DEALER_PORTAL_USER with accessRole=admin.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/users with accessRole=admin.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: 403/AuthorizationError 'Dealer admins cannot create additional admin users from the portal'; admin/primary-owner roles are Dynamic AQS-managed only.

testCases.title: Purchasing/Accounting/Viewer dealer role cannot manage company users (default-deny)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated DEALER_PORTAL_USER with accessRole=purchasing (repeat for accounting, viewer).
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/users with a valid new-user body.
2. Observe response.
3. Repeat PATCH /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/users/{id}.
testCases.expectedResult: All blocked with AuthorizationError 'Only dealer portal admins can manage company portal users' (assertDealerPortalSelfAdmin); non-admin roles get read-only.

testCases.title: Company admin pauses (deactivates) and restores a non-admin portal user
testCases.preconditions: Admin dealer user; a target active non-admin, non-primary-owner user exists on the same account.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/users/{targetId} status=deactivated.
2. Verify status.
3. PATCH same user status=active.
4. Verify status.
testCases.expectedResult: Status transitions deactivated then active; deactivatedAt set/cleared accordingly; suspended status is rejected for self-service admins; events audit-logged.

testCases.title: Admin cannot deactivate their own portal access or the primary-owner/admin users
testCases.preconditions: Admin dealer user; target set includes self, the primary owner, and another admin.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/users/{ownId} status=deactivated.
2. PATCH primary-owner user.
3. PATCH another admin user.
testCases.expectedResult: Self -> 'Dealer admins cannot deactivate their own portal access'; primary owner -> 'Primary owner access must be managed by Dynamic AQS'; admin -> 'Admin access must be managed by Dynamic AQS'. All blocked.

testCases.title: Admin cannot modify a user belonging to a different dealer account (IDOR)
testCases.preconditions: Admin dealer user on Account A; a portal user id belonging to Account B is known.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/users/{accountB_userId} status=deactivated.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: Rejected with 'Dealer portal user not found for this account' — the lookup is scoped by currentPortalUser.accountId, so cross-account targeting is treated as not-found.

testCases.title: Invite link expires after 14 days and cannot set a password
testCases.preconditions: A portal user with inviteExpiresAt = createdAt + 14 days; current time is past expiry.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/dealer-portal/invites/accept with the expired token and a valid password.
2. Observe response.
testCases.expectedResult: Rejected with 'Dealer invite link is invalid or has expired'; password is not set.

testCases.title: Invite acceptance enforces minimum 10-character password
testCases.preconditions: A valid, unexpired, unaccepted invite token exists.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/dealer-portal/invites/accept with a 9-character password.
2. Observe response.
3. Retry with a 10-character password.
testCases.expectedResult: 9-char rejected with 'Password must be at least 10 characters long'; 10-char accepted, identity password set, inviteTokenHash cleared, inviteAcceptedAt set.

testCases.title: Already-accepted or unknown invite token is rejected
testCases.preconditions: One token already accepted; one random token never issued.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /invites/accept with the already-accepted token.
2. POST /invites/accept with a random non-existent token.
3. POST /invites/accept with empty token.
testCases.expectedResult: Accepted token and unknown token both return 'Dealer invite link is invalid or has expired'; empty token returns 'Invite token is required'.

testCases.title: Dealer sees only their assigned catalog with no cross-group leakage
testCases.preconditions: Dealer A resolves to ARS affinity view; Dealer B resolves to Next Star view; both catalogs published.
testCases.steps:
1. As Dealer A GET /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/catalog.
2. Inspect products and branding.
3. As Dealer B repeat.
testCases.expectedResult: Dealer A sees only ARS-branded products; Dealer B sees only Next Star; no product from the other group appears; catalog resolved via affinity/ownership/region rules.

testCases.title: Catalog search and filters match across documented fields and are combinable
testCases.preconditions: Dealer has an assigned catalog with products spanning multiple categories/brands/families and assets.
testCases.steps:
1. Search by a SKU fragment.
2. Search by a word in longDescription.
3. Apply category + brand + files-available filters together.
4. Clear filters.
testCases.testData: query='HUM', then 'merv13'; filters category=Humidifier, brand=ARS, files-available
testCases.expectedResult: Search matches across SKU/displayName/short+long description/category/family/asset titles/file names; combined filters narrow correctly; clearing restores full list.

testCases.title: Dealer downloads a visible product asset; foreign asset id is rejected (IDOR)
testCases.preconditions: Dealer has a published catalog; a valid asset id visible to them and a foreign asset id not in their catalog are known.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/assets/{visibleAssetId}/open.
2. POST /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/assets/{foreignAssetId}/open.
testCases.expectedResult: Visible asset returns a CloudFront/legacy download URL (open recorded for audit/diagnostics); foreign asset returns 'Asset is not visible in the current dealer catalog' (not-found semantics) — no cross-catalog asset leakage.

testCases.title: Admin/Purchasing can favorite/unfavorite; Accounting/Viewer cannot
testCases.preconditions: A visible presentation id; dealer users of each access role.
testCases.steps:
1. As purchasing POST /me/favorites/{presentationId} then DELETE.
2. As viewer POST /me/favorites/{presentationId}.
testCases.expectedResult: Purchasing (and admin) toggle favorite, isFavorite/favoriteCount update; viewer/accounting blocked with 'This dealer portal role cannot save catalog favorites'.

testCases.title: Purchasing dealer adds a catalog product to the persistent cart
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated DEALER_PORTAL_USER accessRole=purchasing (or admin); valid visible presentationId.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/cart/items { presentationId, quantity:2 }.
2. GET /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/cart.
testCases.expectedResult: 201 Created; cart contains one line (sku/productName/uom resolved server-side from catalog), quantity 2; cart is the single DRAFT OrderDraft for the user; lineCount/totalUnits reflected. No price shown (pricing parked).

testCases.title: Adding the same product twice merges onto one line (idempotent per product)
testCases.preconditions: Cart contains product P with quantity 2.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /me/cart/items { presentationId: P, quantity:3 } again.
2. GET /me/cart.
testCases.expectedResult: Cart still has a single line for P with quantity 5 (2+3), not a duplicate line.

testCases.title: Cart quantity is clamped to [1, 1,000,000] for zero/negative/oversized/fractional input
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated purchasing dealer; valid presentationId.
testCases.steps:
1. Add with quantity 0.
2. Add with quantity -5.
3. PATCH a line quantity to 2,000,000.
4. Add with quantity 3.7.
5. Add with quantity NaN/Infinity.
testCases.expectedResult: 0 and -5 clamp to 1; 2,000,000 clamps to 1,000,000; 3.7 truncates to 3; non-finite defaults to 1 (clampDealerPortalQuantity).

testCases.title: Cart cannot exceed 200 distinct lines
testCases.preconditions: Cart already holds 200 distinct product lines.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /me/cart/items with a 201st distinct product.
2. POST /me/cart/items re-adding an existing product (merge).
testCases.testData: 201st new presentationId; then an existing one
testCases.expectedResult: New 201st distinct product rejected with 'A dealer cart cannot exceed 200 lines'; re-adding an existing product still succeeds (merges, no new line).

testCases.title: Add-to-cart rejects a presentation not visible in the dealer's catalog (anti-IDOR)
testCases.preconditions: Dealer A authenticated; presentationId belongs to another group's catalog or does not exist.
testCases.steps: 1. POST /me/cart/items { presentationId: foreignOrFake, quantity:1 }.
testCases.expectedResult: Rejected: foreign/unknown -> 'Product presentation is not visible in the current dealer catalog' (or '...active snapshot'); empty -> 'Product presentation id is required'. Server never trusts client product ids.

testCases.title: Accounting and Viewer dealer roles cannot add to cart (default-deny)
testCases.preconditions: DEALER_PORTAL_USER with accessRole=accounting (repeat viewer); valid visible presentationId.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /me/cart/items as accounting.
2. POST /me/cart/items as viewer.
testCases.expectedResult: Both blocked with AuthorizationError 'This dealer portal role cannot place orders' (assertDealerPortalCanManageOrders allows only ADMIN/PURCHASING).

testCases.title: Update and remove a cart line; removing a non-existent line errors
testCases.preconditions: Cart has at least one line owned by the current dealer user.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /me/cart/items/{lineId} { quantity:7, lineNote:'rush' }.
2. DELETE /me/cart/items/{lineId}.
3. PATCH/DELETE a random lineId not in the cart.
testCases.expectedResult: Quantity/lineNote update succeeds and is reflected; delete removes the line and recomputes counts; unknown line returns 'Cart line not found'.

testCases.title: Submit order succeeds with a PO number and at least one line (DRAFT->SUBMITTED)
testCases.preconditions: Purchasing/admin dealer with a non-empty cart.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/orders/submit { poNumber:'PO-1001' }.
2. GET /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/orders.
testCases.expectedResult: 201 Created; OrderDraft transitions to SUBMITTED with submittedAt/submittedByUserId and customerPoNumber set; source stays DEALER_SELF_SERVICE so it appears in the back-office triage queue tagged 'Dealer'; order now shows in order history.

testCases.title: Submit is rejected when PO number is missing/blank
testCases.preconditions: Dealer with a non-empty cart.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /me/orders/submit with no poNumber.
2. POST /me/orders/submit { poNumber:'   ' }.
testCases.expectedResult: Both rejected with 'A purchase order (PO) number is required to submit a dealer order' (trimmed-empty counts as missing); no transition occurs.

testCases.title: Submit is rejected when cart is empty
testCases.preconditions: Dealer with an empty DRAFT cart (no lines).
testCases.steps: 1. POST /me/orders/submit { poNumber:'PO-2002' }.
testCases.expectedResult: Rejected with 'Add at least one product to your cart before submitting an order'; lineCount<1 guard prevents an empty order.

testCases.title: Ship-to location must belong to the dealer's own account
testCases.preconditions: Dealer with a non-empty cart; one AccountLocation id belonging to the dealer's account and one belonging to a foreign account.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /me/orders/submit { poNumber, shipToLocationId: ownLocation }.
2. POST /me/orders/submit { poNumber, shipToLocationId: foreignLocation }.
testCases.expectedResult: Own location succeeds and is stored on the order; foreign location rejected with 'Ship-to location does not belong to this dealer account' (validated against portalUser.accountId, derived server-side, never client account).

testCases.title: Double-submit (double-click / concurrent) does not create a second submission
testCases.preconditions: Dealer with a non-empty cart.
testCases.steps:
1. Fire two near-simultaneous POST /me/orders/submit { poNumber:'PO-3003' } requests.
2. Re-submit the same cart after it is already SUBMITTED.
testCases.expectedResult: Exactly one transition succeeds; the loser/second gets 'This order was already submitted; reload your cart and try again' (atomic updateMany guarded on status=DRAFT & lineCount>=1); submittedAt fires once.

testCases.title: Concurrent first-add does not create two DRAFT carts for one dealer user
testCases.preconditions: Dealer user with no existing DRAFT cart.
testCases.steps:
1. Fire two concurrent POST /me/cart/items for the same user when no cart exists.
2. GET /me/cart and count DRAFT carts for the user.
testCases.testData: two concurrent adds, no prior cart
testCases.expectedResult: Only one DRAFT OrderDraft exists for the user (serializable find-or-create; Postgres SSI aborts the loser); both products land in the single cart.

testCases.title: Credit-hold submit block (server-side) — seam present, enforcement parked
testCases.preconditions: DEPENDENCY: requires an Acumatica-synced credit-hold flag in Pulse; today only Account.financeAuthorityMode exists (not a real-time credit signal). No enforcement is implemented.
testCases.steps:

2. POST /me/orders/submit { poNumber }.
3. Verify the order is blocked server-side regardless of client state.
testCases.expectedResult: When the signal lands: submit is rejected before the DRAFT->SUBMITTED transition with a message directing the dealer to contact Dynamic AQS. CURRENT BUILD: no credit-hold field exists; the guard seam is in place but submit proceeds — documented gap, not silent omission.

testCases.title: Credit-hold / past-due banner on dashboard with disabled ordering CTAs

testCases.expectedResult: Red credit-hold banner with explicit block message and disabled/hidden ordering CTAs; yellow past-due warning when only past-due; text labels accompany colors (NFR-DPO-011). Currently NOT BUILT.

testCases.title: Billing address is read-only; any POST changing it at order time is rejected

testCases.title: Requested delivery-date picker must NOT be exposed at checkout

testCases.title: Expedited shipping selection with estimated cost delta at checkout (parked)

testCases.title: Submitted order routes to back-office triage queue (Acumatica placement parked)

NOTE: company-wide cross-user visibility (FR-DPO-050) at parent-account level is the unbuilt enhancement; current scope returns the account's submitted orders.

testCases.title: Order history shows items/qty/date/status/total, date-range filter, and payment method

testCases.title: Internal preview requires lead.portal_setup and a valid role param; default-deny otherwise

testCases.expectedResult: Valid role returns a read-only internal preview with catalog diagnostics; invalid role -> 400 'Preview role must be one of: admin, purchasing, accounting, viewer'; actor lacking lead.portal_setup -> 403.

testCases.title: Unsupported HTTP methods and unicode/special-char ids are handled safely
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated dealer user.
testCases.steps:
1. Send PUT /api/v1/dealer-portal/me/cart/items.
2. PATCH /me/cart/items/{lineId} where lineId contains URL-encoded unicode/special chars (e.g. %E2%9C%93, ../, ' OR 1=1).
3. Observe responses.
testCases.expectedResult: Unsupported method returns 405 with allowed-methods list; decoded ids are treated as opaque values, matched against the user's own cart lines only (no traversal/injection), and a non-matching id returns 'Cart line not found' — no SQL injection (Prisma parameterized) and no cross-account access.

testCases.title: List base products returns all Acumatica-sourced fields

testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 200. Each item carries sku, acumaticaInventoryId, acumaticaItemClass, uom, itemStatus, lifecycleStatus, isSellable, isDealerVisible, sourceSystem, sourceOfTruthSystem and acumaticaLastSyncedAt (lowercased enums). total count is returned alongside items.

testCases.title: Product list limit is clamped to 1..200 (boundary and pagination)

testCases.preconditions: TM selects a group/brand (e.g. Service Experts) then shares an ARS price guide. Per PRD this is Partial: server publish-validation catches mismatch; interactive confirm dialog not yet built.
testCases.steps:
1. Select Service Experts group
2. Attempt to share an ARS-branded asset
3. Expect a confirmation prompt 'are you sure — these don't match'
testCases.expectedResult: Target: a visible double-check confirmation before send. Current build: brand mismatch is BLOCKED in runProductPublishValidation but the interactive share-flow confirmation is not yet implemented. Test confirms server enforcement and flags missing UI confirm.

testCases.title: Apex / Next Star / Service Experts resolve to correct catalog views (data setup)
testCases.preconditions: Catalog view kinds are built; the specific Next Star / Apex / Service Experts views require data setup. Acumatica/module-12 checkout owns the Apex line-item discount.
testCases.steps:
1. Configure affinity/ownership views for Next Star, Apex, Service Experts
2. Run rule preview against accounts in each group
3. Confirm each resolves to its intended view
testCases.testData: accounts in Apex, Next Star, Service Experts groups
testCases.expectedResult: Rule engine resolves each account to the configured catalog view (affinity/ownership). Apex shows standard pricing with line-item discount applied at checkout (module 12), not a differentiated catalog price. This is data setup over built code; discount logic is module 12 / Acumatica dependent.

testCases.title: Dealer portal resolves account catalog view via active rule set and serves active snapshot with account price
testCases.preconditions: An active catalog rule set, published snapshots per view, and Acumatica price-class integration. Dealer portal read path lives in module 12; price display depends on modules 12 + 15 (Acumatica). Not yet built here.
testCases.steps:
1. Dealer logs into the portal
2. System resolves their catalog view from the active rule set
3. Portal renders only the active snapshot's products/assets with the account's Acumatica price class
testCases.testData: dealer account in Next Star group
testCases.expectedResult: Dealer sees their tailored catalog (active snapshot for resolved view) with their assigned price (not a neutral price). Snapshot publish pipeline is built; the dealer-portal read path and Acumatica price display are NOT built in this module.

testCases.title: Dealer portal search/sort/filter, add-to-cart, locked billing, and past-due/credit-hold indicators
testCases.preconditions: Dealer portal UX, checkout, and accounts/credit integration. All Not-built in this module (module 12 + accounts/module 06 + Acumatica).
testCases.steps:
1. In dealer portal: search by name/SKU, filter by category, sort by price
2. Add to cart, change quantity, place order to Acumatica
3. Verify billing is locked and past-due (yellow) / credit-hold (red) indicators show
testCases.testData: dealer browsing/checkout; a past-due account; a credit-hold account
testCases.expectedResult: Target behaviour per Session 11. None of this is built in the product-management module: dealer portal search/sort/filter, cart/checkout with locked billing, and past-due/credit-hold severity indicators are module 12 / accounts / Acumatica deliverables. Tracked here for traceability only.

testCases.title: Product catalog data is governance-global, not territory-book-scoped (confirm no per-TM record filtering)
testCases.preconditions: Two TM users with different territory books, both holding product.view.
testCases.steps:
1. As TM-A: GET /products
2. As TM-B: GET /products
3. Compare result sets
testCases.testData: TM-A and TM-B in different territories
testCases.expectedResult: Both receive the same global product catalog (listProducts applies no owner/territory record-scoping — visibility is controlled at the dealer-catalog-view/snapshot layer, not per-TM). Confirms the access model is action-permission based, not book-of-business scoped, for the catalog admin surface.

testCases.title: Concurrent activations / publishes do not yield two active rule sets or two active snapshots
testCases.preconditions: Two clean draft rule sets ready to activate (or two publishes to the same view) issued near-simultaneously. Actor(s) have product.publish.
testCases.steps:
1. Fire POST activate on ruleSetA and ruleSetB concurrently
2. Fire two concurrent POST snapshots on the same catalog view
3. Query active rows
testCases.testData: two concurrent activate calls; two concurrent publish calls
testCases.expectedResult: Each activate/publish runs in a $transaction that retires/archives prior active rows then sets the new one. Verify final state has exactly one isActive rule set and exactly one isActive snapshot per view; version numbers are sequential (last-writer-wins). Flag if a race can leave two active rows (no unique partial index guard observed).

testCases.title: Create a digital asset with required title and verify secure defaults
testCases.preconditions: User authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS (has digital_asset.upload). digital_assets module enabled.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/digital-assets/assets with {title:'Spring Brochure 2026', kind:'document'}.
2. Inspect 201 response body.
3. GET the created asset detail by id.
testCases.expectedResult: 201 Created. Asset persisted with a generated stableSlug='spring-brochure-2026', status=draft, visibility=internal_only, reviewStatus=pending_review, audience='internal', sourceSystem=manual. An AuditEntry CREATE row is written for the actor.

testCases.title: Reject asset creation when title is missing or blank
testCases.preconditions: User authenticated with digital_asset.upload.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/digital-assets/assets with {title:'   ', kind:'image'}.
2. POST again with title omitted entirely.
testCases.expectedResult: Both return 400 Bad Request with message 'title is required'. No asset row and no audit entry are created.

testCases.title: Filter library by kind, status, visibility, brand/region scope
testCases.preconditions: At least one asset exists for each kind (image, document, video) with mixed visibility/brandScope.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/digital-assets/assets?kind=image.
2. GET ...?visibility=dealer_portal.
3. GET ...?brandScope=AQS&regionScope=west.
testCases.expectedResult: Each call returns only assets matching the filter; combined filters AND together. Results are ordered by updatedAt descending. Total count reflects the filtered set.

testCases.title: Case-insensitive full-text search across title, slug, legacy fields and searchable metadata
testCases.preconditions: Assets exist: one titled 'Excavator Photo', one with legacyFileName 'EXCAV-spec.pdf', one with a searchable legacy metadata field value 'excavator'.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/digital-assets/assets?search=excavator.
2. Review returned items.
testCases.expectedResult: All three assets are returned (match on title, legacyFileName, and isSearchable legacy metadata fieldValue), case-insensitively, ordered most-recently-updated first.

testCases.title: List limit is clamped between 1 and 200 with default 50
testCases.preconditions: 300+ assets exist in the library.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/digital-assets/assets (no limit).
2. GET ...?limit=500.
3. GET ...?limit=0.
4. GET ...?limit=-5.
testCases.expectedResult: Step1 returns 50 items. Step2 returns at most 200 (clamped). Step3 and Step4 return at least 1 (clamped to min 1), never 0 or negative. total reflects full unpaged count.

testCases.title: Create a version by external URL with no binary upload
testCases.preconditions: Asset exists. User has digital_asset.upload.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/digital-assets/assets/{assetId}/versions with {fileName:'promo.mp4', externalUrl:'https://cdn.example.com/promo.mp4'}.
2. Inspect the returned current version.
testCases.expectedResult: 201. Version created with externalUrl populated, storageKey null; publicUrl resolves to the external URL. Version is marked current.

testCases.title: Reject version create with neither storageKey, externalUrl, nor fileBase64
testCases.preconditions: Asset exists. User has digital_asset.upload.
testCases.steps:
1. POST .../versions with {fileName:'orphan.pdf'} (no storageKey/externalUrl/fileBase64).
2. POST .../versions with {externalUrl:'https://x/y'} and no fileName.
testCases.expectedResult: Step1 returns 400 'storageKey, externalUrl, or fileBase64 is required'. Step2 returns 400 'fileName is required'. No version row created.

testCases.title: Adding a new version updates currentVersionId and preserves prior versions
testCases.preconditions: Asset exists with version 1 (current). User has digital_asset.upload.
testCases.steps:
1. POST .../versions with {fileName:'v2.pdf', externalUrl:'https://cdn/v2.pdf'} (makeCurrent default).
2. GET asset detail.
3. Inspect versions list and currentVersionId.
testCases.expectedResult: Version 2 created and isCurrent=true; version 1 isCurrent flipped to false; asset.currentVersionId points to v2. Full version history (v1, v2) is returned in versionNumber-desc order. Audit CREATE for the new version with madeCurrent=true.

testCases.feature: Version Management — Stable URL / share continuity
testCases.title: Share link issued before a version replace still resolves to current version
testCases.preconditions: Approved dealer_portal asset with v1 (storageKey set, publicUrl resolvable). An active share link exists pinned to no specific version (resolves current).
testCases.steps:
1. Create share link for the asset (no assetVersionId).
2. Upload v2 with makeCurrent.
3. GET /api/v1/digital-assets/shares/{token}.
testCases.testData: share token from step 1; v2 file 'v2.pdf'
testCases.expectedResult: Share link is unchanged (same token/shareUrl). Step3 returns 302 to v2's public CDN URL (resolves the asset's current version since the link was not version-pinned). Link does not break across the replace.

testCases.title: Cannot share an asset that is pending_review
testCases.preconditions: Asset visibility=dealer_portal, reviewStatus=pending_review, status=draft. User has digital_asset.share.
testCases.steps: 1. POST /api/v1/digital-assets/assets/{assetId}/share-links with {}.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 Bad Request 'Asset must be approved before it can be shared externally'. No share link created, no audit entry.

testCases.title: Approve an asset and verify approver/approvedAt are stamped
testCases.preconditions: Asset in pending_review. User authenticated as ADMIN_CSR_OPS (has digital_asset.edit AND digital_asset.publish).
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH /api/v1/digital-assets/assets/{assetId} with {reviewStatus:'approved'}.
2. GET asset detail.
testCases.expectedResult: 200. reviewStatus=approved, approvedByUserId=actor.userId, approvedAt set to now. Audit UPDATE with before/after. Asset is now eligible for external share (if dealer_portal/public).

testCases.title: Edit-only grant cannot approve, publish, or archive an asset
testCases.preconditions: A role granted digital_asset.edit but NOT digital_asset.publish/archive (e.g. a custom edit-only role). Asset in pending_review, internal_only.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH asset {reviewStatus:'approved'}.
2. PATCH asset {visibility:'dealer_portal'}.
3. PATCH asset {status:'archived'}.
4. PATCH asset {description:'new copy'} (metadata-only).
testCases.expectedResult: Steps 1-3 each return 403 Forbidden (assertActionAccess digital_asset.publish / digital_asset.archive fails). Step4 succeeds (200) — metadata edit is allowed. Confirms governance acts are gated independently of edit.

testCases.title: Generate a share link for an approved dealer_portal asset and verify token hashing
testCases.preconditions: Asset approved, dealer_portal, has a current version with resolvable publicUrl. User has digital_asset.share.
testCases.steps:
1. POST .../assets/{assetId}/share-links with {recipientType:'prospect'}.
2. Inspect response shareUrl and DB share link row.
testCases.expectedResult: 201. shareUrl = {web.publicBaseUrl}/api/v1/digital-assets/shares/{token} where token is 64 hex chars (two UUIDs, hyphens stripped). Only tokenHash (SHA-256) is persisted; raw token never stored. expiresAt defaults to now+30 days. Audit CREATE written.

testCases.title: Cannot share an internal_only asset
testCases.preconditions: Asset approved but visibility=internal_only. User has digital_asset.share.
testCases.steps: 1. POST .../assets/{assetId}/share-links with {}.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'Only dealer portal or public assets can be shared externally'. No share link created.

testCases.title: Cannot share an archived or expired asset
testCases.preconditions: Asset approved, dealer_portal, but status=archived (repeat for status=expired). User has digital_asset.share.
testCases.steps:
1. POST .../assets/{assetId}/share-links with {} against the archived asset.
2. Repeat against an expired asset.
testCases.expectedResult: Both return 400 'Archived or expired assets cannot be shared'. No share link created.

testCases.title: Accessing a valid share token 302-redirects and increments access count
testCases.preconditions: Active, non-expired, non-revoked share link exists with accessCount=0 for an asset whose version has a publicUrl.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/digital-assets/shares/{token}.
2. Re-read the share link record.
3. GET the token a second time.
testCases.expectedResult: HTTP 302 with Location = the version's public CDN URL. accessCount increments to 1 then 2 across the two accesses; lastAccessedAt stamped to now each time.

testCases.title: Expiry days are clamped to 1..365 with default 30
testCases.preconditions: Shareable approved dealer_portal asset. User has digital_asset.share.
testCases.steps:
1. Create share link with expiresInDays=0.
2. Create with expiresInDays=1000.
3. Create with expiresInDays omitted.
4. Create with explicit expiresAt='2025-01-01' (past date).
testCases.expectedResult: Step1 clamps to 1 day; Step2 clamps to 365 days; Step3 defaults to 30 days; Step4 stores the explicit (past) expiresAt verbatim — and that link is then immediately treated as expired on resolve.

testCases.title: Expired share token returns an error and does not redirect
testCases.preconditions: Share link whose expiresAt is in the past (e.g. created with explicit past expiresAt).
testCases.steps: 1. GET /api/v1/digital-assets/shares/{token}.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'Digital asset share link has expired'. No 302 redirect; accessCount NOT incremented.

testCases.title: Revoke a share link, then confirm access is blocked
testCases.preconditions: Active share link exists, created by the current user. User has digital_asset.share.
testCases.steps:
1. DELETE /api/v1/digital-assets/share-links/{shareLinkId}.
2. GET /api/v1/digital-assets/shares/{token}.
testCases.testData: own active share link id; its token
testCases.expectedResult: Step1 returns 200 {revoked:true, revokedAt}; audit UPDATE written. Step2 returns 400 'Digital asset share link has been revoked'; no redirect, no access-count increment.

testCases.title: Share-only user cannot revoke another user's share link (enumeration-safe)
testCases.preconditions: Share link A created by user X. User Y is authenticated as TERRITORY_MANAGER (has digital_asset.share but NOT digital_asset.edit).
testCases.steps:
1. As user Y, DELETE /api/v1/digital-assets/share-links/{A.id}.
2. As an ADMIN_CSR_OPS (has digital_asset.edit), DELETE the same id.
testCases.testData: foreign share link id A; users Y (TM) and admin
testCases.expectedResult: Step1 returns 400 'Digital asset share link not found' (reported as not-found so others' links are not enumerable), and link A is NOT revoked. Step2 succeeds (edit grant may revoke any link).

testCases.title: Revoking an already-revoked link is idempotent and preserves original revokedAt
testCases.preconditions: Share link already revoked at time T1, created by the current user.
testCases.steps: 1. DELETE the same share-link id again at time T2.
testCases.expectedResult: 200 {revoked:true}; revokedAt remains T1 (before.revokedAt ?? new Date() keeps the original). No double-revoke side effects.

testCases.title: Unknown / malformed share token returns not-found without leaking existence
testCases.preconditions: No share link exists for the supplied token.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/digital-assets/shares/{random64hex}.
2. GET /api/v1/digital-assets/shares/' OR '1'='1.
testCases.testData: random 64-hex token; SQL-injection style token string
testCases.expectedResult: Both return 400 'Digital asset share link not found'. Token is SHA-256 hashed before the Prisma lookup (parameterized), so the injection string is treated as data, not SQL. No redirect.

testCases.title: Capture recipient type/name/email and CRM context on a share link
testCases.preconditions: Shareable approved asset. User has digital_asset.share.
testCases.steps:
1. POST .../share-links with {recipientType:'dealer', recipientName:'Acme Co', recipientEmail:'buyer@acme.com', contextType:'lead', contextId:'lead_123'}.
2. GET asset detail and inspect shareLinks.
testCases.expectedResult: 201; all optional fields stored verbatim and returned on the share link summary. recipientType defaults to 'prospect' when omitted on a separate call.

testCases.title: Recipient PII on share links is hidden from view-only actors in asset detail
testCases.preconditions: Asset has share links carrying recipientName/recipientEmail. User A has digital_asset.view but NOT digital_asset.share (e.g. EXECUTIVE). User B has digital_asset.share.
testCases.steps:
1. As EXECUTIVE, GET asset detail.
2. As ADMIN_CSR_OPS, GET the same asset detail.
testCases.expectedResult: Step1 returns the asset but shareLinks is an empty array (PII suppressed for view-only). Step2 returns the populated shareLinks list including recipient name/email.

testCases.title: Create a collection and upsert/remove an item respecting sort order
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.edit. An asset exists.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/digital-assets/collections {code:'RES-2026', name:'Residential 2026', visibility:'dealer_portal'}.
2. POST .../collections/{id}/items {assetId, sortOrder:10}.
3. POST same item again with sortOrder:5 (move).
4. DELETE .../collections/{id}/items/{assetId}.
testCases.expectedResult: Collection created (201). Item upserted at sortOrder 10, then updated in place to 5 (no duplicate row, composite key collectionId_assetId). Remove returns {removed:true}. Each op writes an audit entry.

testCases.title: Reject collection create with missing code or name
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.edit.
testCases.steps:
1. POST .../collections {name:'No Code'}.
2. POST .../collections {code:'NC'}.
testCases.expectedResult: Step1 returns 400 'code is required'. Step2 returns 400 'name is required'. No collection row created.

testCases.title: Upserting a collection item for a non-existent collection or asset is rejected
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.edit.
testCases.steps:
1. POST .../collections/{badCollectionId}/items {assetId: validAsset}.
2. POST .../collections/{validId}/items {assetId:'missing'}.
testCases.expectedResult: Step1 returns 400 'Digital asset collection not found'. Step2 returns 400 'Digital asset not found'. No membership row created.

testCases.title: Residential and commercial collections render their own assets without cross-contamination (UI surface)
testCases.preconditions: Two collections exist: one regionScope/dealerGroupType=residential, one=commercial, with distinct membership.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the Share Sets tab.
2. Select the residential collection and view its assets.
3. Select the commercial collection and view its assets.
testCases.expectedResult: Data model cleanly separates the two collections' items. NOTE: per PRD the dedicated UI surfacing of the residential/commercial split is NOT yet implemented — test verifies the data-model separation; the UI split assertion is expected to fail until built.

testCases.title: Assign an asset to a product presentation by role and surface it in productUsages
testCases.preconditions: User has product.asset_link (ADMIN_CSR_OPS or TRAINING_OPS). A product presentation and a digital asset exist.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/digital-assets/product-assignments {presentationId, assetId, role:'hero_image'}.
2. GET asset detail and inspect productUsages.
testCases.expectedResult: 201 assignment created; audit CREATE. Asset detail productUsages row shows productSku, productName, presentationName, and role='hero_image'.

testCases.title: Re-assigning the same presentation+asset+role+scope updates in place (no duplicate)
testCases.preconditions: An assignment already exists for presentationId+assetId+role with given dealerGroup/brand/region scope. User has product.asset_link.
testCases.steps:
1. POST product-assignments with the identical key but a new sortOrder/isRequired.
2. Inspect productUsages.
testCases.testData: same {presentationId, assetId, role, dealerGroupType, dealerGroupId, brandLabel, regionScope}, sortOrder=5, isRequired=true
testCases.expectedResult: Existing assignment is UPDATED (sortOrder/isRequired/assetVersionId changed); no second row created. Audit action is UPDATE, not CREATE.

testCases.title: Reject assignment when assetVersionId belongs to a different asset
testCases.preconditions: Asset A with version V_A; Asset B exists. User has product.asset_link.
testCases.steps:
1. POST product-assignments {presentationId, assetId: B, assetVersionId: V_A, role:'spec_sheet'}.
2. POST again with assetVersionId pointing to a non-existent version.
testCases.testData: assetId=B, assetVersionId=V_A (belongs to A); then assetVersionId='missing'
testCases.expectedResult: Step1 returns 400 'Digital asset version does not belong to the selected asset'. Step2 returns 400 'Digital asset version not found'. Transaction rolled back; no assignment created.

testCases.title: Unlink a product-asset assignment and audit the delete
testCases.preconditions: An assignment exists. User has product.asset_link.
testCases.steps:
1. DELETE /api/v1/digital-assets/product-assignments/{assignmentId}.
2. DELETE again (already removed).
testCases.expectedResult: Step1 returns 200 with the removed assignment; audit DELETE written. Step2 returns 400 'Product asset assignment not found'.

testCases.title: Library defaults to approved dealer_portal/public assets; admin toggle reveals all
testCases.preconditions: Library contains a mix: approved dealer_portal assets, internal_only drafts, pending_review assets. A TM (non-admin) and an admin user.
testCases.steps:
1. As TM, open the Digital Assets library (default view).
2. As admin, open library, then enable 'Review All Files' toggle.
testCases.expectedResult: TM default view shows only approved, dealer_portal/public, share-ready assets. Admin default also share-ready; enabling 'Review All Files' reveals internal_only and unapproved assets.

testCases.title: TM copies a customer share link in two steps from the library
testCases.preconditions: TM authenticated (has digital_asset.share). At least one approved dealer_portal asset with an existing or creatable share link. Mobile-width CRM-web browser.
testCases.steps:
1. Open Digital Assets module.
2. Select an asset and click 'Copy customer link'.
testCases.testData: approved dealer_portal asset on mobile viewport
testCases.expectedResult: Link is copied to clipboard within two interactions; the button is reachable without scrolling on mobile width. NOTE: a dedicated React Native mobile-app screen is NOT built (CRM-web mobile is the surface) — the native-app portion is Not-built per OQ-DAM-004.

testCases.feature: Dealer/TM Access — Copy customer link reuse
testCases.title: 'Copy customer link' reuses an existing active link instead of creating a duplicate
testCases.preconditions: Approved dealer_portal asset that already has exactly one active (non-revoked, non-expired) share link.
testCases.steps:
1. Click 'Copy customer link' on that asset.
2. Inspect the asset's share-link count.
3. Click on a different asset with no active link and click 'Copy customer link'.
testCases.testData: asset with 1 active link; asset with 0 links
testCases.expectedResult: Step1 copies the existing link's URL; share-link count stays at 1 (no duplicate). Step3 creates a new link and copies it.

testCases.title: Delivery Health surfaces missing-file, needs-review, and active-share assets with KPI counts
testCases.preconditions: Library seeded with: 1 asset with no current version file, 1 reviewStatus!=approved asset, 1 asset with an active share link.
testCases.steps:
1. Open the Delivery Health tab.
2. Inspect the four KPI cards and the flagged list.
3. Click 'Review Items'.
testCases.expectedResult: Tab lists the union of (no-file) + (not-approved) + (active-share) assets. Four KPI cards show ready/needs-review/missing-file/active-shares counts. 'Review Items' navigates to the first flagged asset in the Library.

testCases.title: Preview a Widen manifest returns summary and sample without writing records
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.sync (ADMIN_CSR_OPS or SUPER_ADMIN). A valid manifest of 60 rows.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/digital-assets/widen-manifest/preview with {rows:[...60...]}.
2. Inspect response and verify DB asset count unchanged.
testCases.expectedResult: 200 with sourceRecordCount=60, valid/invalid/warning/error counts, and sampleRows limited to first 50. Zero DigitalAsset/Version/Batch rows written.

testCases.title: Commit a valid JSON manifest creates assets, versions, aliases and a batch record
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.sync. Manifest rows each with widenAssetId, fileName, legacyUrl, externalUrl.
testCases.steps:
1. POST /api/v1/digital-assets/widen-manifest/commit with {rows:[...]}.
2. Inspect response counters and created batch.
3. Query alias by sourceSystem='widen'+legacyUrl.
testCases.testData: 3-row valid manifest with distinct widenAssetId and legacyUrl
testCases.expectedResult: 201. assetsCreated/versionsCreated/aliasesUpserted reflect the rows. Each migrated asset is created with status=needs_review, visibility=internal_only, reviewStatus=pending_review, sourceSystem=widen. Each legacyUrl has a DigitalAssetMigrationAlias with redirectStatus='pending'. A DigitalAssetMigrationBatch row is created and an IMPORT audit entry written.

testCases.title: Commit accepts JSON-array, JSON-object-with-rows, and CSV manifests
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.sync. Three equivalent manifests: a JSON array; a JSON object {rows:[...]}; a CSV with header row.
testCases.steps:
1. Commit via manifestPath pointing at a JSON-array file.
2. Commit a JSON object containing rows/assets/items.
3. Commit a CSV export.
testCases.testData: array file; {"rows":[...]}; CSV with headers assetId,fileName,url
testCases.expectedResult: All three parse to equivalent DigitalAsset+Version records. CSV first row is treated as headers; quoted fields with embedded commas/quotes parse correctly.

testCases.title: Row with neither Widen asset id nor legacy URL is skipped as an error without aborting batch
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.sync. Manifest of 3 rows where row 2 has no id and no URL.
testCases.steps:
1. POST .../widen-manifest/commit with the manifest.
2. Inspect issues, invalidRowCount, batch status.
testCases.expectedResult: Commit succeeds (201). Row 2 produces a 'missing_identity' error-severity issue and is skipped; invalidRowCount=1; valid rows still imported; batch status='imported_with_issues'.

testCases.title: Duplicate widenAssetId rows raise warnings and second row upserts the first
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.sync. Manifest with two rows sharing widenAssetId='W-100'.
testCases.steps:
1. POST .../widen-manifest/commit with the duplicate manifest.
2. Inspect issues and duplicateExternalAssetCount.
testCases.testData: two rows, both widenAssetId='W-100', differing titles
testCases.expectedResult: Both rows flagged 'duplicate_external_asset_id' (warning). Import continues; the two rows resolve to the same stableSlug so the second upserts/updates the first asset record (assetsCreated then assetsUpdated). duplicateExternalAssetCount=1.

testCases.title: Committing with no manifest rows is blocked
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.sync.
testCases.steps:
1. POST .../widen-manifest/commit with {} (no rows, no manifestPath, dryRun false).
2. Open the Migration tab preview with no rows.
testCases.expectedResult: Step1 returns 400 'Widen manifest rows are required before committing an import run'. Step2 UI shows warning 'No Widen manifest rows were supplied.' and the commit button is disabled.

testCases.title: Source-download ingestion rejects http, localhost, and private-network URLs
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.sync. Manifest rows with downloadUrl values targeting blocked hosts; ingestSourceDownloads=true.
testCases.steps:
1. Commit with a row downloadUrl='http://cdn/x' (non-https).
2. ...downloadUrl='https://localhost/x'.
3. ...downloadUrl='https://192.168.1.10/x'.
4. ...downloadUrl='https://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data'.
5. ...downloadUrl='https://10.0.0.5/x' and 'https://[::1]/x' and 'https://host.local/x'.
testCases.expectedResult: Every blocked URL fails the download (https-only + assertSafeSourceDownloadHost) and is recorded as a 'source_download_ingest_failed' warning issue without failing the whole batch. No outbound request reaches an internal address; the imported asset version retains externalUrl rather than a storageKey.

testCases.title: Source download exceeding 100 MB is aborted and does not OOM
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.sync. A reachable https endpoint serving a >100 MB body, tested both with an honest Content-Length and with a missing/zero Content-Length (chunked).
testCases.steps:
1. Commit with ingestSourceDownloads=true and downloadUrl to the oversized endpoint (declared length >cap).
2. Repeat with the chunked endpoint that omits Content-Length.
testCases.testData: endpoint returning 150 MB; endpoint with chunked transfer, no content-length
testCases.expectedResult: Both abort with 'sourceDownloadUrl payload is too large for asset ingestion'. The streaming reader aborts the request once cumulative bytes exceed 100 MB; Content-Length is never trusted alone. Failure is recorded as a migration issue; process does not run out of memory.

testCases.title: Source-download ingestion is capped per run (default 25, max 200) with a warning
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.sync. Manifest with 60 downloadable rows.
testCases.steps:
1. Commit with ingestSourceDownloads=true, maxSourceDownloads omitted.
2. Commit with maxSourceDownloads=500.
3. Commit with maxSourceDownloads=0.
testCases.expectedResult: Step1 ingests at most 25, with warning 'Widen source download ingestion limited to 25 files for this run.' Step2 clamps to 200. Step3 clamps to 1. Rows beyond the limit keep their externalUrl version unchanged.

testCases.title: manifestPath cannot escape the configured widen-manifests directory
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.sync. Local storage configured with PULSE_STORAGE_ROOT_DIR.
testCases.steps:
1. POST .../widen-manifest/commit with {manifestPath:'../../etc/passwd'}.
2. ...with {manifestPath:'/etc/passwd'}.
3. ...with {manifestPath:'../secrets.json'}.
testCases.expectedResult: All return 400 'Widen manifest path resolved outside the configured manifest directory'. Absolute inputs are stripped of leading separators and re-rooted under {rootDir}/widen-manifests; traversal outside that subdir is rejected. No file outside the subdir is read.

testCases.title: Local-disk upload rejects a storage key that resolves outside the storage root
testCases.preconditions: APP_STORAGE_PROVIDER != s3 (local mode). A fileBase64 upload whose computed key would traverse out of rootDir (e.g. via a crafted fileName).
testCases.steps:
1. Upload a version with fileBase64 and a fileName engineered to attempt traversal.
2. Confirm the write target stays under {rootDir}/digital-assets/{assetId}/v{n}/.
testCases.expectedResult: fileName is sanitised (slashes/backslashes replaced, disallowed chars stripped) so the key cannot traverse; if a resolved path still falls outside rootDir the write throws 'Digital asset storage key resolved outside the configured storage root'. No file is written outside the root.

testCases.title: S3 PUT uses the canonical key pattern and publicUrl is CloudFront-domain
testCases.preconditions: APP_STORAGE_PROVIDER=s3, PULSE_ASSET_S3_BUCKET and PULSE_ASSET_CLOUDFRONT_DOMAIN configured.
testCases.steps:
1. Upload version 2 of asset A with a base64 payload and fileName 'spec sheet.pdf'.
2. Inspect the stored storageKey and the version publicUrl.
testCases.expectedResult: Object PUT to S3 with key 'digital-assets/A/v2/spec-sheet.pdf' (filename sanitised, spaces→hyphens), correct ContentType and {assetId,versionNumber,sha256} metadata. publicUrl hostname equals the configured CloudFront domain (path-segments URL-encoded), not a Widen domain. sizeBytes and sha256 are computed server-side.

testCases.title: Reject an empty or whitespace-only base64 payload
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.upload. Local or s3 storage.
testCases.steps:
1. Upload a version with fileBase64='' (empty).
2. Upload with fileBase64 that decodes to zero bytes.
testCases.expectedResult: 400 'fileBase64 payload is empty'. No version/object written. Error surfaces as a 400-level response (not silently swallowed).

testCases.title: stableSlug is immutable; renaming title/file does not change slug or share path
testCases.preconditions: Asset created with stableSlug='hero-banner'; an active share link exists.
testCases.steps:
1. PATCH asset {title:'Hero Banner v2 Renamed'}.
2. Upload a new version with a different fileName.
3. Re-read the asset and re-resolve the share token.
testCases.expectedResult: stableSlug remains 'hero-banner' (PATCH has no slug field; update never writes stableSlug). The share token and shareUrl are unchanged and still resolve. Confirms slug/derived path stability across rename.

testCases.title: All DAM endpoints require an authenticated session
testCases.preconditions: No valid session token.
testCases.steps:
1. GET /api/v1/digital-assets/assets with no/invalid auth.
2. POST /api/v1/digital-assets/assets.
3. POST /api/v1/digital-assets/widen-manifest/commit.
testCases.expectedResult: Each returns 401 Unauthorized (isAuthenticationError → unauthorizedResponse). The public share-resolve route (GET /shares/{token}) is the only unauthenticated endpoint and behaves per its own token checks.

testCases.title: Roles without digital_assets module access are denied (FINANCE, DEALER_PORTAL_USER)
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as FINANCE (no digital_assets module), then as DEALER_PORTAL_USER.
testCases.steps:

2. As DEALER_PORTAL_USER, GET the same.
testCases.expectedResult: Both return 403 Forbidden (assertModuleAccess(actor.role,'digital_assets') fails). Default-deny holds for roles outside ROLE_DEFAULT_MODULE_ACCESS for digital_assets.

testCases.title: View/share-only roles cannot upload, edit, or run migration
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as TERRITORY_MANAGER (has view/download/share, NOT upload/edit/publish/archive/sync). Asset and collection exist.
testCases.steps:

2. PATCH an asset.
3. POST a collection.
4. POST /widen-manifest/commit.
5. GET /api/v1/digital-assets/assets (allowed control).
testCases.expectedResult: Steps 1-4 each return 403 Forbidden (missing digital_asset.upload/edit/sync). Step5 returns 200 (view is granted). Confirms TM can browse and share but not author or migrate.

testCases.title: EXECUTIVE can view but cannot create share links
testCases.preconditions: Authenticated as EXECUTIVE (view/download/usage_view only, no digital_asset.share). Shareable approved asset exists.
testCases.steps:
1. GET asset detail (allowed).
2. POST .../assets/{assetId}/share-links.
testCases.expectedResult: Step1 returns 200 but with shareLinks empty (no share grant → PII suppressed). Step2 returns 403 Forbidden (no digital_asset.share). Executive is oversight/read-only for DAM mutations.

testCases.title: Product-assignment endpoints require product.asset_link, not just digital_asset.edit
testCases.preconditions: A role with digital_asset.edit but WITHOUT product.asset_link; and TRAINING_OPS (has product.asset_link).
testCases.steps:

testCases.expectedResult: Step1 returns 403 Forbidden (assignProductAsset asserts product_management module + product.asset_link). Step2 succeeds (201). Confirms product-assignment routes are gated on the product_management permission set.

testCases.title: Create/update/import/delete actions each write an AuditEntry with actor and snapshots
testCases.preconditions: Admin user. Audit log queryable.
testCases.steps:
1. Create an asset, update it, create+revoke a share link, create+remove a collection item, assign+unlink a product asset, commit a manifest.
2. Query AuditEntry for each entityType.
testCases.testData: full lifecycle of one asset and its related entities
testCases.expectedResult: Each operation produces an AuditEntry: CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE/IMPORT with actorUserId set, and before/after data snapshots where applicable (UPDATE has both; CREATE has afterData; DELETE has beforeData; IMPORT carries batch summary). Covers DIGITAL_ASSET, DIGITAL_ASSET_VERSION, DIGITAL_ASSET_SHARE_LINK, DIGITAL_ASSET_COLLECTION, PRODUCT_ASSET_ASSIGNMENT, DIGITAL_ASSET_MIGRATION_BATCH.

testCases.title: Unicode title, max-length slug, and special characters are handled safely
testCases.preconditions: User has digital_asset.upload.
testCases.steps:
